function hashFarm(text){let h=2166136261;for(const ch of String(text)){h^=ch.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}return h>>>0;}
// Luck is based on the inherited projected power, not updated by training.
let migratedFarmLuck=false;
function farmLuckScore(h,variation=0){
 const stats=FARM_STAT_KEYS.map(k=>Number(h.baseMaximum?.[k]||0)+Number(h.uniquePts?.[k]||0));
 const power=stats.length?stats.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/stats.length:120;
 return Math.max(1,Math.min(99,Math.round(100-(power-65)*.62+variation)));
}
function farmSeededLuckOffset(id){return (hashFarm('luck|'+String(id||''))%1801)/100-9;}
function demoStat(h,key,variation){return hashFarm(`${h.sire||h.father||''}|${h.dam||h.mother||''}|${h.id||h.name}|${key}|${variation}`)%101;}
function ensurePointSets(h){
  // Old standalone saves did not contain real breeding/ability data: fill stable example values only once.
  // In real integration, preserve injected baseInitial/baseMaximum/uniquePts values unchanged.
  if(!h.baseInitial||typeof h.baseInitial!=='object')h.baseInitial={};
  if(!h.baseMaximum||typeof h.baseMaximum!=='object')h.baseMaximum={};
  if(!h.uniquePts||typeof h.uniquePts!=='object')h.uniquePts={};
   if(!h.classicClaims||typeof h.classicClaims!=='object')h.classicClaims={};
  for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS){
    const v=demoStat(h,key,'born');
    h.baseInitial[key]=safeNumber(h.baseInitial[key],30+(v%41),0,300);
    h.baseMaximum[key]=safeNumber(h.baseMaximum[key],Math.max(h.baseInitial[key],78+(demoStat(h,key,'potential')%53)),h.baseInitial[key],400);
    h.uniquePts[key]=Math.round(safeNumber(h.uniquePts[key],demoStat(h,key,'unique')%51,0,100000));
  }
  if(!Number.isInteger(h.luck)||h.luck<1||h.luck>99){
    h.luck=farmLuckScore(h,farmSeededLuckOffset(h.id));
    migratedFarmLuck=true;
  }
  return h;
}
function growthPercent(h){
 return window.DFSharedRules.growthFraction(h,state.calendarYear,state.calendarMonth);
}
function currentBase(h,key){ensurePointSets(h);return Math.round(h.baseInitial[key]+(h.baseMaximum[key]-h.baseInitial[key])*growthPercent(h));}
function currentPower(h,key){return currentBase(h,key)+h.uniquePts[key];}
function addUniqueBonus(h,key,amount,source){
 if(!FARM_STAT_KEYS.includes(key)||!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<=0)return;
 ensurePointSets(h);h.uniquePts[key]+=Math.floor(amount);
 emit('unique-point-awarded',{horseId:h.id,key,amount:Math.floor(amount),source});
}

/* Ver.32: mirror Ver.30 first-peak eligibility in the standalone farm.
   The parent racing engine tracks the full condition cycle.  Only the
   pre-first-peak upper bound is mirrored here, so farm care and old saves
   cannot display an impossible 100 at age two in spring. */
function df32FarmPrePeakCeiling(h,year,month){
 const id='farm-linked:'+String(h.id||h.name||'owner');
 const birth=Number(h.birthGameYear)||1;
 const growth=h.growth||'普通';
 const seedText=id+'|'+String(birth)+'|'+String(growth);
 let seed=2166136261;
 for(const ch of seedText)seed=Math.imul(seed^ch.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;
 const debut=birth+2; // Farm age 2 begins two calendar years after birth
 let peakYear=debut,peakMonth;
 if(growth==='早熟')peakMonth=6+seed%2;
 else if(growth==='晩成'){peakYear++;peakMonth=3+seed%2;}
 else if(growth==='持続'){peakYear++;peakMonth=1;}
 else peakMonth=10+seed%3;
 return Number(year)*12+Number(month)<peakYear*12+peakMonth?80:100;
}

  d.v43SeasonNotices=Array.isArray(c.v43SeasonNotices)?c.v43SeasonNotices.filter(x=>/^\d{1,4}-(?:[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:sale|breed|debut)$/.test(x)).slice(-100):[];
  d.horses=(Array.isArray(c.horses)?c.horses.slice(0,120):d.horses).map((h,i)=>ensurePointSets(normalizeHorse(h,i)));
  // Existing owner G1 wins unlock VS without inventing a new victory.
  if(d.horses.some(h=>Number(h.g1Wins)>0||(Array.isArray(h.df37G1History)&&h.df37G1History.length>0)))d.v43VsUnlocked=true;
  // Clamp old farm saves as soon as they are loaded or written through FarmHomeBridge.
  for(const h of d.horses)if(h.df160DrinkStamp!==d.calendarYear+'-'+d.calendarMonth)h.form=Math.min(h.form,df32FarmPrePeakCeiling(h,d.calendarYear,d.calendarMonth));
   // Ver.137: discontinued the retirement-record archive. Migrate any old qualifying
   // retired horses to breeding profiles, then keep only breeding/VS pedigree data.
   const legacyRetired=Array.isArray(c.retiredHorses)?c.retiredHorses:[];
  // Ver.21: battle entries are immutable snapshots, separate from the five active horses.
  // Keep them intact across state normalization, monthly updates and ordinary saves.
  d.battleHorses=Array.isArray(c.battleHorses)?c.battleHorses.filter(x=>x&&typeof x==='object'&&x.format==='derby-fantasy-battle-horse'&&x.schema===1&&x.snapshotId&&x.horse&&x.raceStats).slice(0,300).map(x=>clone(x)):[];
  d.barnHorseId=String(c.barnHorseId??d.horses[0]?.id??'');
  // Ver.164: retain the foal calculated at mating, including every inherited stat.
  // Pregnancies from Ver.163 and earlier have no frozenFoal and remain supported.
  d.pregnancies=Array.isArray(c.pregnancies)?c.pregnancies.slice(0,20).map(p=>{
   const entry={birthYear:Math.floor(safeNumber(p?.birthYear,d.calendarYear+1,1,9999)),
    birthMonth:Math.floor(safeNumber(p?.birthMonth,3,1,12)),
    sireId:asText(p?.sireId,'',100),damId:asText(p?.damId,'',100)};
   const unborn=p?.frozenFoal;
   if(unborn&&typeof unborn==='object'&&!Array.isArray(unborn)
      &&/^farm_foal_\d+_\d+$/.test(String(unborn.id||''))
      &&Number(unborn.birthGameYear)===entry.birthYear
      &&unborn.named===false&&typeof unborn.baseMaximum==='object'&&unborn.baseMaximum
      &&typeof unborn.baseInitial==='object'&&unborn.baseInitial
      &&typeof unborn.uniquePts==='object'&&unborn.uniquePts){
    entry.frozenFoal=ensurePointSets(normalizeHorse(unborn,0));
   }
   // Preserve the conception-time visible ancestor audit across save/load.
   // Do not silently reinterpret a frozen foal generated by an older version.
   if(Array.isArray(p?.visibleInbreedCrosses)){
    entry.visibleInbreedCrosses=p.visibleInbreedCrosses.filter(x=>x&&typeof x.ancestor==='string'&&Array.isArray(x.positions)).slice(0,16).map(x=>({
     ancestor:x.ancestor.slice(0,120),
     positions:x.positions.filter(v=>Array.isArray(v)&&v.length===2&&v.every(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=1&&n<=5)).slice(0,16).map(v=>[v[0],v[1]])
    }));
   }
   entry.pedigreeRuleVersion=Number.isInteger(p?.pedigreeRuleVersion)?p.pedigreeRuleVersion:0;
   return entry;
  }):[];
   d.breeding=initBreedingData(c.breeding);
   for(const entry of legacyRetired){
    const h=entry?.horse||entry;if(!h?.id)continue;
    const won=Math.max(Number(h.g1Wins)||0,Number(entry?.career?.fullRaceHorse?.g1Wins)||0);
    if(won<3||!['牡','牝'].includes(h.sex))continue;
    const id='bred:'+String(h.id);
    if(!d.breeding.customBreeders.some(b=>b.id===id)){
     const recovered=clone(h);recovered.g1Wins=won;
     if(!Object.keys(recovered.df37Titles||{}).length&&entry?.career?.fullRaceHorse?.df37Titles)
       recovered.df37Titles=clone(entry.career.fullRaceHorse.df37Titles);
     const candidate=promotedBreederFromHorse(recovered);
     candidate.breedUses=Math.max(0,Number(candidate.breedUses)||0);
     d.breeding.customBreeders.push(candidate);
    }
   }
  // Remember every previously assigned self-bred name, even after retirement.
  const used=new Set(Array.isArray(c.namedHorseNames)
    ?c.namedHorseNames.filter(n=>typeof n==='string'&&[...n].length<=9):[]);
  for(const h of d.horses)if(h.named&&String(h.id).startsWith('farm_foal_'))used.add(h.name);
   for(const item of legacyRetired){
     const h=item?.horse||item;
     if(h?.named!==false&&String(h?.id||'').startsWith('farm_foal_')&&h.name)used.add(h.name);
   }
  for(const h of d.breeding.customBreeders)if(h.customBred&&h.name)used.add(h.name);
  d.namedHorseNames=[...used];
  // Ver.34: retain the outcome of each real monthly draw across UI redraws and reloads.
  d.saleDraws=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(c.saleDraws&&typeof c.saleDraws==='object'?c.saleDraws:{})
    .filter(([key,ids])=>/^\d{1,4}-(?:[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:stallion|mare)$/.test(key)&&Array.isArray(ids)&&ids.length<=10&&ids.every(id=>typeof id==='string'&&id.length<50)).slice(-48));
  d.secretaryDraws=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(c.secretaryDraws&&typeof c.secretaryDraws==='object'?c.secretaryDraws:{})
    .filter(([key,message])=>/^\d{1,4}-(?:[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(key)&&typeof message==='string'&&message.length<=200).slice(-36));
  if(!d.horses.some(h=>h.id===d.barnHorseId))d.barnHorseId=d.horses[0]?.id||'';
  return d;
}

const FUNNY_HORSE_NAMES = window.DFSharedRules.funnyHorseNames;
function funnyHorseName(original){
  const key=breedCanonical(original);
  if(!key)return '';
  if(FUNNY_HORSE_NAMES[key])return FUNNY_HORSE_NAMES[key];
  // A newly introduced unnamed ancestor must not accidentally expose a real name.
  const z=hashFarm(key),parts=['モグモグ','ワクワク','ウマウマ','パクパク','ゴキゲン','ニコニコ','プリプリ','マンプク'];
  const tails=['プリン','ギョーザ','オムライス','コロッケ','ラーメン','ワッフル','おにぎり','カレー'];
  return parts[z%parts.length]+tails[Math.floor(z/8)%tails.length].replace('おにぎり','オニギリ')+['マル','ポン','リン','チャン','ピョン','ドン','ニャン','タン'][Math.floor(z/64)%8];
}
function horseById(id){
  return [...STALLION_CATALOG,...MARE_CATALOG].find(h=>h.id===id)
    ||(state?.breeding?.customBreeders||[]).find(h=>h.id===id)||null;
}

/* Ver.39: secret matching-honor matings, no list of unlocked/locked titles exposed. */
const DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES=Object.freeze({
 junior:'2歳G1全制覇',colt:'クラシック三冠',filly:'牝馬三冠',
 autumn:'古馬秋G1三連勝',grandprix:'グランプリ連勝',tenno:'天皇賞春秋連勝',
 arima:'有馬記念2年連覇',spring:'天皇賞春2年連覇',fall:'天皇賞秋2年連覇',
 japan:'ジャパンカップ2年連覇',five:'G1・5連勝',fiveage:'三歳五冠',triple:'三冠'
});
function df39CommonHonors(sire,dam){
 const a=sire?.df37Titles,b=dam?.df37Titles;
 if(!a||!b||typeof a!=='object'||typeof b!=='object')return [];
 // 三冠配合は父の牡馬三冠と母の牝馬三冠で成立する。
 const matches=Object.keys(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES).filter(id=>
  id!=='colt'&&id!=='filly'&&
  Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(a,id)&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,id));
 if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(a,'colt')&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,'filly'))matches.push('triple');
 return matches;
}
function df39PairingLabels(sire,dam){
 const matches=df39CommonHonors(sire,dam);
 return matches.length?`<div class="df39-pair-labels">${matches.map(id=>
   `<span class="df39-pair-label">${htmlEscape(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id])}配合成立！</span>`).join('')}</div>`:'';
}
function df39BreederEmblems(parent){
 const icons=window.DF39TitleEmblemIcons||{};
 const titles=parent?.df37Titles||{};
 const ids=Object.keys(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES).filter(id=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(titles,id));
 return ids.length?`<span class="df39-breeder-emblems">${ids.map(id=>icons[id]
  ?`<img src="${icons[id]}" alt="${htmlEscape(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id])}" title="${htmlEscape(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id])}">`
  :`<span>${htmlEscape(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id])}</span>`).join('')}</span>`:'';
}
function df39ApplyHonorBaseBonus(newborn,sire,dam){
 // Hidden: each matching title independently gives every stat 1..5 points.
 // Each stat separately chooses basic or innate; no reroll after the birth.
 for(const id of df39CommonHonors(sire,dam)){
  for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS){
   const basic=Math.random()<0.5;
   const points=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*5);
   if(basic){
    newborn.baseInitial[key]=Number(newborn.baseInitial[key]||0)+points;
    newborn.baseMaximum[key]=Number(newborn.baseMaximum[key]||0)+points;
   }else{
    newborn.uniquePts[key]=Number(newborn.uniquePts[key]||0)+points;
   }
  }
 }
}

function parentBreedingPointSets(parent){
 if(parent?.customBred)return {baseMaximum:parent.baseMaximum,uniquePts:parent.uniquePts};

function htmlEscape(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function initBreedingData(value){
  const b=value&&typeof value==='object'?value:{};
  // Keep each promoted parent's immutable full racing/breeding profile, including
  // replaced breeders needed to deliver already-conceived foals and ancestry.
  const customBreeders=(Array.isArray(b.customBreeders)?b.customBreeders:[])
    .filter(h=>h&&typeof h.id==='string'&&h.id.startsWith('bred:')&&h.customBred===true
       &&(h.sex==='牡'||h.sex==='牝')&&h.real==='dfb:'+h.id.slice(5))
    .map(h=>({...clone(h),breedUses:Math.max(0,Math.floor(safeNumber(h.breedUses,0,0,100000)))}));
  const valid=(id,sex)=>sex==='牡'
    ?STALLION_CATALOG.some(h=>h.id===id)||customBreeders.some(h=>h.id===id&&h.sex==='牡')
    :MARE_CATALOG.some(h=>h.id===id)||customBreeders.some(h=>h.id===id&&h.sex==='牝');
  const stallions=(Array.isArray(b.stallions)?b.stallions:[])
    .filter(x=>x&&valid(x.id,'牡')).slice(0,5)
    .map(x=>({id:x.id,startYear:Math.floor(safeNumber(x.startYear,1,1,9999))}));
  const mare=b.mare&&valid(b.mare.id,'牝')
    ?{id:b.mare.id,startYear:Math.floor(safeNumber(b.mare.startYear,1,1,9999))}:null;
  return {stallions,mare,customBreeders,selectedSire:String(b.selectedSire||''),
    bredYears:(Array.isArray(b.bredYears)?b.bredYears:[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isInteger).slice(-100),
    birthCount:Math.floor(safeNumber(b.birthCount,0,0,Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1))};
}
function saleSeason(){return [12,1,2,3].includes(state.calendarMonth)}
function breedingStartYear(){return state.calendarMonth===12?state.calendarYear+1:state.calendarYear}
function yearsLeft(entry){return entry?Math.max(0,entry.startYear+5-Math.max(state.calendarYear,entry.startYear)):0}
function df135BreederUsed(h){return h?.customBred?Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(h.breedUses)||0)):0;}
function df135BreederRemaining(h){return h?.customBred?Math.max(0,10-df135BreederUsed(h)):Infinity;}
function df135BreedingFee(h){return 0;}
function df135BreedingTotal(sire,dam){return df135BreedingFee(sire)+df135BreedingFee(dam);}
function df135CanUseBreeder(h){return !!h&&df135BreederRemaining(h)>0;}

function dropExpiredBreedingHorses(){
 const b=state.breeding;if(!b)return;
 b.stallions=b.stallions.filter(x=>yearsLeft(x)>0);
 if(b.mare&&yearsLeft(b.mare)<=0)b.mare=null;
 if(!b.stallions.some(x=>x.id===b.selectedSire))b.selectedSire=b.stallions[0]?.id||'';
}
function monthlySaleList(kind){
 if(!saleSeason())return [];
 const pool=kind==='stallion'?STALLION_CATALOG:MARE_CATALOG;
 const key=`${state.calendarYear}-${state.calendarMonth}-${kind}`;
 const expected=Math.min(10,pool.length);
 let ids=state.saleDraws?.[key];
 if(!Array.isArray(ids)||ids.length!==expected||new Set(ids).size!==expected||ids.some(id=>!pool.some(h=>h.id===id))){
   // Ver.34: draw each new sale once using real fresh randomness, then commit
   // the selected catalogue IDs. Reopening the same month's sale does not redraw.
   const entries=pool.slice();
   for(let i=entries.length-1;i>0;i--){
     const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
     [entries[i],entries[j]]=[entries[j],entries[i]];
   }
   ids=entries.slice(0,10).map(h=>h.id);
   if(!state.saleDraws)state.saleDraws={};
   state.saleDraws[key]=ids;
   const keys=Object.keys(state.saleDraws);
   if(keys.length>48)for(const old of keys.slice(0,keys.length-48))delete state.saleDraws[old];
   save();
 }
 const byId=new Map(pool.map(h=>[h.id,h]));
 return ids.map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
}
function isOwnedBreeder(h){if(!h)return false;return h.sex==='牡'?state.breeding.stallions.some(x=>x.id===h.id):state.breeding.mare?.id===h.id}
function breedMonthsUntil(p){return (Number(p.birthYear)-state.calendarYear)*12+(Number(p.birthMonth)-state.calendarMonth)}
function activePregnancy(){return state.pregnancies.find(p=>p.sireId&&p.damId&&breedMonthsUntil(p)>=0)||null}
function famousPair(sireName,damName){return HISTORIC_PAIRS.find(p=>p[0]===sireName&&p[1]===damName)||null}

/* 221頭の5代(62枠)祖先データ: ゲーム本体の能力・登録馬とは独立した内部参照のみ。 */
const GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN=window.DFSharedRules.pedigree5Gen;
function pedigreeRows(horseName){
 // ゲーム登録の実在馬名をキーに、各馬専用の5代62枠を優先する。
 const savedRows=GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN[horseName]||GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN[breedCanonical(horseName)];
 if(savedRows){
  const row=[];let offset=0;
  for(let g=1;g<=5;g++){
   const width=1<<g;
   row.push(savedRows.slice(offset,offset+width));offset+=width;
  }
  return row;
 }
   const row=[];let level=[horseName];
  for(let gen=1;gen<=5;gen++){
     level=level.flatMap(n=>{
       const custom=(state.breeding?.customBreeders||[]).find(h=>h.real===n);
       const parents=custom?[custom.sirePedigreeId||custom.sire,custom.damPedigreeId||custom.dam]
         :(PEDIGREE_RELATIONS[breedCanonical(n)]||[]);
       return [parents[0]||'',parents[1]||''];
     });
     row.push(level);
  }
 return row;
}
// Ver.25: the ONLY ancestors eligible for an inbreeding effect are the 8
// names actually shown in each half of the photo-style pedigree.
const DF_VISIBLE_PEDIGREE_PATHS=['','0','00','000','001','01','010','011'];
// Single source of truth for the exact eight cells displayed on each side.
function dfVisiblePedigreeEntries(horseName){
 const rows=pedigreeRows(horseName);
 return DF_VISIBLE_PEDIGREE_PATHS.map((path,row)=>{
  let index=0;
  for(const bit of path)index=index*2+Number(bit);
  const depth=path.length+1;
  const name=path.length?rows[path.length-1]?.[index]:horseName;
  return {name:name||'',key:name?breedCanonical(name):'',depth,path,row};
 });
}
function dfVisibleFoalEntries(sireName,damName){
 return [dfVisiblePedigreeEntries(sireName),dfVisiblePedigreeEntries(damName)];
}

function dfVisiblePedigreeCrosses(sire,dam){
 const sireName=typeof sire==='string'?sire:sire?.real||sire?.originalName;
 const damName=typeof dam==='string'?dam:dam?.real||dam?.originalName;
 if(!sireName||!damName)return [];
 const [a,b]=dfVisibleFoalEntries(sireName,damName);
 const keys=[...new Set(a.map(x=>x.key).filter(Boolean))];
 return keys.flatMap(key=>{
  const left=a.filter(x=>x.key===key),right=b.filter(x=>x.key===key);
  if(!right.length)return [];
  const positions=[...new Set(left.flatMap(x=>right.map(y=>`${x.depth+1},${y.depth+1}`)))].map(x=>x.split(',').map(Number));
  positions.sort((x,y)=>x[0]+x[1]-y[0]-y[1]||x[0]-y[0]);
  return [{ancestor:left[0].name,positions,custom:(typeof state!=='undefined'?state.breeding?.customBreeders||[]:[]).find(h=>h.customBred&&breedCanonical(h.real)===key)||null}];
 }).sort((x,y)=>x.positions[0][0]+x.positions[0][1]-y.positions[0][0]-y.positions[0][1]);
}
function dfVisiblePairIntensity(sire,dam,crosses=dfVisiblePedigreeCrosses(sire,dam)){
 return {close:crosses.some(c=>c.positions.some(([a,b])=>Math.min(a,b)<=2)),
 thin:crosses.some(c=>c.positions.some(([a,b])=>Math.min(a,b)>=4))};
}
// Ver.36: position-aware common ancestor occurrences (sire side x dam side).
function dfV36Crosses(sire,dam){
 return dfVisiblePedigreeCrosses(sire,dam);
}
function dfV36CrossName(match){
 return match.custom?.name||df53KanaAlias(match.ancestor);
}
function dfV36SpecialCross(sire,dam,crosses=dfV36Crosses(sire,dam)){
 const eligible=[];
 for(const match of crosses){
  if(!match.custom)continue;
  const patterns=match.positions.filter(([a,b])=>(a===3&&b===4)||(a===4&&b===3));
  if(patterns.length)eligible.push({...match,patterns});
 }
 // Only the strongest homebred 3x4 ancestor provides the special bonus;
 // avoid unlimited stacked bonuses in deep lineages.
 eligible.sort((a,b)=>dfV36AncestorScore(b.custom)-dfV36AncestorScore(a.custom));
 return eligible[0]||null;
}
function dfV36AncestorScore(h){
 return FARM_STAT_KEYS.reduce((sum,key)=>sum+Number(h.baseMaximum?.[key]||0)+Number(h.uniquePts?.[key]||0),0)/FARM_STAT_KEYS.length;
}
function dfV36ApplySpecialBonus(newborn,sire,dam,crosses=dfV36Crosses(sire,dam)){
 const cross=dfV36SpecialCross(sire,dam,crosses);
 if(!cross)return null;
 const ancestor=cross.custom;
 const g1=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(ancestor.g1Wins)||0));
 const avg=dfV36AncestorScore(ancestor);
 const abilityFactor=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(avg-75)/110));
 const g1Factor=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(g1-3)/9));
 const wins=Math.max(0,Number(ancestor.racingWins)||0);
 const starts=Math.max(wins,Number(ancestor.racingStarts)||0);
 const winRateFactor=starts?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,wins/starts)):0;
 const winsFactor=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,wins/25));
 const recordFactor=.55*g1Factor+.25*winRateFactor+.20*winsFactor;
 const points={};
 for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS){
  const raw=Number(ancestor.baseMaximum?.[key]||0)+Number(ancestor.uniquePts?.[key]||0);
  const individual=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(raw-60)/130));
  // Special game rule. Ancestor's original 7 stats and G1 record both matter.
  const increase=Math.round(14+40*(.50*individual+.20*abilityFactor+.30*recordFactor));
  const oldMax=Number(newborn.baseMaximum[key])||0;
  const delta=Math.max(0,Math.min(400-oldMax,increase));
  newborn.baseMaximum[key]=oldMax+delta;
  newborn.baseInitial[key]=Math.min(newborn.baseMaximum[key],(Number(newborn.baseInitial[key])||0)+Math.round(delta*.60));
  points[key]=delta;
 }
 const bonus={ancestorId:ancestor.real,ancestorName:ancestor.name,
  pattern:cross.patterns.map(p=>p.join('×')).join('・'),g1Wins:g1,
  racingWins:wins,racingStarts:starts,
  ancestorOriginalAverage:Math.round(avg),addedPoints:points};
 newborn.inbreedBonus=bonus;
 return bonus;
}
function pairFoalName(sire,dam){return sire&&dam?'配合予定の仔馬':''}
function pairDiagnosis(sire,dam){
 if(!sire||!dam)return '<div class="breed-placeholder">牡馬・牝馬を選択するとインブリード／ニックスを診断します。</div>';
 const k=pairFoalName(sire,dam),rows=pedigreeRowsForPair(sire,dam);
 const crosses=dfV36Crosses(sire,dam);
 const specials=dfV36SpecialCross(sire,dam);
 const complete=rows[4].every(Boolean);
 let crossText='<div class="breed-diagnostic"><strong>🧬 インブリード診断</strong>';
 if(!crosses.length)crossText+=`<p>確認できた祖先の範囲では共通祖先なし。${complete?'5代内にインブリードはありません。':'未確認の枝があるため、最終判定は保留です。'}</p>`;
 else {
  crossText+='<ul>'+crosses.map(c=>'<li>インブリード：<strong class="breed-red">'+htmlEscape(dfV36CrossName(c))+'</strong> <small>【'+htmlEscape(window.DFBreedingEffects.ancestorTraits(c.ancestor).map(k=>FARM_STAT_NAMES[k]).join('・'))+'】</small> '+htmlEscape(c.positions.map(p=>p.join('×')).join('・'))+'：'+(c.positions.some(p=>Math.min(...p)<=2)?'<span class="breed-danger">濃いインブリード・慎重に</span>':c.positions.some(p=>Math.min(...p)<=3)?'<span class="breed-caution">影響が強め・注意</span>':'比較的薄いインブリード')+'</li>').join('')+'</ul><p class="df72-inbreed-warning">※ 赤字のインブリードはおすすめ出来ないインブリードです。</p>';
  crossText+='<p class="breed-note">血統が濃く重なる場合は慎重に配合を検討してください。</p>';
 }
 if(crosses.length)crossText+=`<p class="breed-note">${htmlEscape(df76InbreedProfile(crosses).label)}：能力上限に小さなプラス、濃い場合は健康・気性にリスク（数値は種付け時に確定）。</p>`;
 if(specials)crossText+=`<p class="breed-good">✨ ${htmlEscape(dfV36CrossName(specials))}の${specials.patterns.map(p=>p.join('×')).join('・')}配合が確認できます。</p>`;
 crossText+='</div>';
 const nickInfo=df75NicksDetails(sire.real||sire,dam.real||dam);
 let nickText='<div class="breed-diagnostic"><strong>🤝 ニックス診断</strong>';
 if(nickInfo.count){
  nickText+=`<p class="breed-good">${htmlEscape(nickInfo.label)}成立（${nickInfo.count}系統）</p>`;
  nickText+='<p class="breed-note">父系と母方の各父系を双方向で判定。効果は出生時に一度だけ適用します。</p>';
 }else nickText+='<p>確認できた系統ではニックスなし（未確認の祖先は判定対象外）。</p>';
 nickText+='</div>';
 const famous=famousPair(sire,dam);
 let rec=crosses.some(c=>c.positions.some(p=>Math.min(...p)<=2))?'<span class="breed-danger">やめた方がいい（濃いインブリード）</span>':specials?'<span class="breed-good">自家生産馬の特別インブリード</span>':crosses.some(c=>c.positions.some(p=>Math.min(...p)<=3))?'<span class="breed-caution">注意（インブリードの影響が強め）</span>':famous?'<span class="breed-good">おすすめ（史実名馬配合）</span>':complete?'<span class="breed-good">おすすめ候補</span>':'<span class="breed-caution">要確認（祖先データが不足）</span>';
 const recommendationVisible=window.dfV129SaleScoreVisible===true;
 return (famous&&recommendationVisible?`<div class="breed-diagnostic"><strong>🏆 名馬配合</strong><p>${htmlEscape(funnyHorseName(sire))} × ${htmlEscape(funnyHorseName(dam))} → ${htmlEscape(funnyHorseName(famous[2]))}</p></div>`:'')+crossText+nickText+(recommendationVisible?`<div class="breed-diagnostic"><strong>総合おすすめ度：</strong>${rec}<p class="breed-note">確認が不十分な馬は安全性の断定をしません。</p></div>`:'');
}
function pedigreeRowsForPair(sire,dam){
 // 父の枝→母の枝の順で、双方の5代血統の祖先を正確な位置で継承。
 // 各父母の5代目は次の産駒では6代目に当たるので、配合判定は4代目まで参照。
 const sireRows=pedigreeRows(sire),damRows=pedigreeRows(dam);
 const rows=[[sire,dam]];
 for(let g=0;g<4;g++)rows.push([...sireRows[g],...damRows[g]]);
 return rows;
}
/* Copy Ver.5: dedicated owned-horse pairings view; calculation and purchase stay unchanged. */
function renderOwnedPairings(into){
 const b=state.breeding;
 const studs=b.stallions.map(item=>({item,horse:horseById(item.id)})).filter(p=>!!p.horse);
 const mother=b.mare?horseById(b.mare.id):null;
 const pregnancy=activePregnancy();
 const alreadyBred=b.bredYears.includes(state.calendarYear);
 const canBreedNow=state.calendarMonth===4&&!alreadyBred&&!pregnancy&&state.horses.length+state.pregnancies.length<5;
 const ownedLine=h=>htmlEscape(h.customBred?h.name:saleHorseFamilyName(h.real,h.name));
 const motherLine=mother?`${ownedLine(mother)}${df39BreederEmblems(mother)} ／ 残り${yearsLeft(b.mare)}年`:'未所有';
 into.innerHTML=`<section class="breed-panel df-v5-pair-head">
   <h3>🌱 所有馬の配合組み合わせ</h3>
   <p class="breed-note">所有している種牡馬と繁殖牝馬の組み合わせを確認できます。診断は予測であり、仔馬の能力が確定するものではありません。</p>
   <div class="df-v5-roster"><div><b>♂ 所有種牡馬 ${studs.length}頭</b><span>${studs.length?studs.map(p=>ownedLine(p.horse)+df39BreederEmblems(p.horse)).join('、'):'未所有'}</span></div>
   <div><b>♀ 所有繁殖牝馬 ${mother?'1':'0'}頭</b><span>${motherLine}</span></div></div>
 </section>`;
 if(!mother||!studs.length){
   const messages=[];
   if(!studs.length)messages.push('種牡馬がいません。');
   if(!mother)messages.push('繁殖牝馬がいません。');
   into.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<section class="breed-panel df-v5-empty" role="status"><h3>まだ配合の組み合わせがありません</h3><p>${htmlEscape(messages.join(' '))}</p><p class="breed-note">12月〜3月は牧場画面左側のセールボタンから購入できます。</p></section>`);
   return;
 }
 const status=pregnancy?`🌱 種付け済み。出産予定：${pregnancy.birthYear}年目3月`:alreadyBred?'今年の種付けは終了しています。':state.calendarMonth!==4?'診断はいつでも確認できます。実際の種付けは4月だけです。':'4月です。組み合わせを選んで種付けできます。';
 into.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<section class="breed-panel df-v5-status" role="status"><b>${htmlEscape(status)}</b><p class="breed-note">年1回。種付け料は無料です。</p></section>`);
 const unrankedStuds=v95Shuffle(studs.map(p=>({...p,v92Review:v92EvaluatePair(p.horse,mother)})));
 const cards=unrankedStuds.map(p=>{
   const can=canBreedNow&&df135CanUseBreeder(p.horse)&&df135CanUseBreeder(mother)&&state.walletCash>=df135BreedingTotal(p.horse,mother);
   const recommendation=window.dfV129SaleScoreVisible===true?(p.v92Review?.recommended?'<div class="v92-owned-badge">💗 おすすめ</div>':''):'';
   return `<section class="breed-panel df-v5-combination" data-v5-owned-sire="${htmlEscape(p.horse.id)}">
     <h3>🐴 配合候補</h3>
     <div class="df-v5-couple"><div><small>父・種牡馬</small><b>${ownedLine(p.horse)}${df39BreederEmblems(p.horse)}</b><small>使用可能 残り${yearsLeft(p.item)}年${p.horse.customBred?'・繁殖残り'+df135BreederRemaining(p.horse)+'回':''}</small></div><span class="df-v5-cross">×</span><div><small>母・繁殖牝馬</small><b>${ownedLine(mother)}${df39BreederEmblems(mother)}</b><small>使用可能 残り${yearsLeft(b.mare)}年${mother.customBred?'・繁殖残り'+df135BreederRemaining(mother)+'回':''}</small></div></div>
     ${recommendation}
     ${df39PairingLabels(p.horse,mother)}
     <details class="df-v5-diagnosis"><summary>🌳 この2頭から生まれる予定仔馬の血統表・配合診断</summary><div class="df-v5-diagnosis-body">${dfNewSalePedigree(p.horse,mother)}${salePairDiagnosis(p.horse,mother)}</div></details>
     <button class="breed-action df-v5-breed-now" type="button" data-v5-commit="${htmlEscape(p.horse.id)}" ${can?'':'disabled'}>🌱 種付けする（${money(df135BreedingTotal(p.horse,mother))}）</button>
   </section>`;
 }).join('');
 into.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',cards);
 into.querySelectorAll('[data-v5-commit]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   const chosen=button.dataset.v5Commit;
   const valid=b.stallions.some(s=>s.id===chosen)&&!!horseById(chosen);
   if(!valid||!b.mare||!horseById(b.mare.id))return;
   if(!df135CanUseBreeder(horseById(chosen))||!df135CanUseBreeder(horseById(b.mare.id))){toast('自家生産馬の繁殖回数は10回までです');return;}
   // Delegate the actual breeding operation to the original unchanged function.
   const prior=b.selectedSire;
   const count=b.bredYears.length;
   b.selectedSire=chosen;
   commitBreeding();
   const succeeded=b.bredYears.length>count;
   if(!succeeded)b.selectedSire=prior;
   renderBreedingScreen('pairings');
 }));
}

/* Ver.92: advice is read-only. Breeding, buying, drawing and saving remain in their existing functions. */
let v92Goal={distance:'中距離',surface:'芝',focus:'総合力'};
let v92GoalSubmitted=false;
const V92_DISTANCES=Object.freeze({'短距離':1200,'マイル':1600,'中距離':2100,'長距離':3000,'万能型':null});
const V92_FOCUS=Object.freeze({'総合力':null,'スピード':'sp','瞬発力':'kick','スタミナ':'sta','先行力':'early','勝負根性':'grit','安定性':'stability','最強馬':'all'});
// Read-only prospective pedigree heuristic. A new foal carries its parents' ancestors
// one generation deeper. Compare those paths against other existing breeding stock
// and favor choices that could later yield a homebred 3x4 or 4x3 match.
function df135FutureCrossOpportunity(sire,dam){
 const customIds=new Set((state?.breeding?.customBreeders||[])
  .filter(h=>h?.customBred===true&&h.real).map(h=>breedCanonical(h.real)));
 if(!customIds.size)return false;
 // Foal from sire+dam is the next generation's parent. On mating that foal,
 // its second-generation ancestors become third-generation ancestors;
 // its third-generation ancestors become fourth-generation ancestors.
 const futureFoalRows=pedigreeRowsForPair(sire.real,dam.real);
 const mates=[...state.breeding.stallions.map(x=>horseById(x.id)),
  horseById(state.breeding.mare?.id),
  ...(saleSeason()?[...monthlySaleList('stallion'),...monthlySaleList('mare')]:[])].filter(Boolean);
 for(const mate of mates){
  if(mate.id===sire.id||mate.id===dam.id)continue;
  // A mating partner's grandparents become generation three and its
  // great-grandparents generation four. Match ONLY (3,4) and (4,3).
  const mateRows=pedigreeRows(mate.real);
  for(const [foalRow,mateRow] of [[1,2],[2,1]]){
   const applicable=new Set((futureFoalRows[foalRow]||[]).map(breedCanonical)
    .filter(name=>name&&customIds.has(name)));
   if(applicable.size&&(mateRows[mateRow]||[]).some(name=>applicable.has(breedCanonical(name))))return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}
// Ver.75: unified, bidirectional lineage-nicks rule (game-specific tuning).
// These are candidate family compatibilities, NOT an official or statistically exhaustive list.
// One match per maternal generation; reversed paternal/maternal roles are allowed.
const DF75_NICKS_FAMILY_PAIRS=[
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ミスタープロスペクター系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ノーザンダンサー系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ロベルト系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','グレイソヴリン系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ダンジグ系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ストームキャット系'],
 ['ミスタープロスペクター系','ロベルト系'],
 ['ミスタープロスペクター系','ノーザンダンサー系']
];
function df75NicksDetails(sireReal,mareReal){
 const sire=salePaternalFamily(sireReal);
 const rows=pedigreeRows(mareReal);
 // Mother-father, mother-mother-father, and two further direct maternal-sire links.
 const names=[rows[0]?.[0],rows[1]?.[1],rows[2]?.[3],rows[3]?.[7]];
 const hits=[];
 if(!sire.verified)return {count:0,hits:[],label:'なし',bonus:0};
 for(let i=0;i<names.length;i++){
  if(!names[i])continue;
  const dam=salePaternalFamily(names[i]);
  if(!dam.verified||dam.family===sire.family)continue;
  const matched=DF75_NICKS_FAMILY_PAIRS.some(([a,b])=>{
   const x=df53LineageAlias(a),y=df53LineageAlias(b);
   return (sire.family===x&&dam.family===y)||(sire.family===y&&dam.family===x);
  });
  if(matched)hits.push({generation:i+1,sireFamily:sire.family,maternalFamily:dam.family});
 }
 const count=hits.length;
 const label=count>=4?'フォースニックス':count===3?'トリプルニックス':count===2?'ダブルニックス':count===1?(hits[0].generation===1?'シングルニックス':hits[0].generation+'次ニックス'):'なし';
 // One-time graduated unique-Pt birth award (+3/+5/+7/+9).
 // The existing shared breeding-point inheritance bonus remains independent.
 return {count,hits,label,bonus:count?Math.min(4,count):0,
         uniqueGain:window.DFBreedingEffects.nickGain({count})};
}
// Shared across the standalone farm and the stable engine (separate script scopes).
window.DF75NicksDetails=df75NicksDetails;
// Registered-horse evaluator is already initialized in parent; custom farm pedigrees remain local.
function df73IsNicksPair(sireReal,mareReal){return df75NicksDetails(sireReal,mareReal).count>0;}
function v92EvaluatePair(sire,dam,goal=null){
 if(!sire||!dam||sire.sex!=='牡'||dam.sex!=='牝')return null;
 const {thin,close}=dfVisiblePairIntensity(sire,dam);
 const ps=pedigreeRows(sire.real),pm=pedigreeRows(dam.real);
 const fatherKnown=Array.isArray(ps[0])&&ps[0].length===2&&ps[0].every(Boolean);
 const motherKnown=Array.isArray(pm[0])&&pm[0].length===2&&pm[0].every(Boolean);
 const nickDetails=df75NicksDetails(sire.real,dam.real);
 const nick=fatherKnown&&motherKnown&&nickDetails.count>0;
 const special=!!dfV36SpecialCross(sire,dam),famous=!!famousPair(sire.real,dam.real);
 const honors=df39CommonHonors(sire,dam).length;
 const sets=window.DFSharedRules.balancedPointSets(parentBreedingPointSets(sire),parentBreedingPointSets(dam),
  {nick,thin,close,special,famous,honors},()=>0.5);
 // Apply existing deterministic newborn awards to a TEMPORARY predicted foal only.
 // No birth, save, purchase, random draw, or shared horse object is modified.
 const predicted={baseMaximum:{...sets.baseMaximum},baseInitial:{...sets.baseInitial},uniquePts:{...sets.uniquePts}};
 if(close)predicted.baseMaximum.stability=Math.max(35,predicted.baseMaximum.stability-10);
 if(special)dfV36ApplySpecialBonus(predicted,sire,dam);
 const stats=Object.fromEntries(FARM_STAT_KEYS.map(key=>[key,
  Math.round(predicted.baseMaximum[key]+Number(predicted.uniquePts[key]||0)+(nick?nickDetails.uniqueGain:0)+(thin?2:0)+honors*3)]));
 const mean=FARM_STAT_KEYS.reduce((sum,key)=>sum+stats[key],0)/FARM_STAT_KEYS.length;
 const ranked=FARM_STAT_KEYS.slice().sort((a,b)=>stats[b]-stats[a]);
 const sireDist=parentDistanceAptitude(sire),damDist=parentDistanceAptitude(dam);
 const distMin=sireDist&&damDist?Math.max(1000,Math.round((sireDist[0]+damDist[0])/200)*100):null;
 const distMax=sireDist&&damDist?Math.min(4000,Math.round((sireDist[1]+damDist[1])/200)*100):null;
 const desired=goal&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(V92_DISTANCES,goal.distance)?V92_DISTANCES[goal.distance]:null;
 const distanceFit=!goal?true:
  goal.distance==='万能型'?(distMin!==null&&distMax!==null&&distMax-distMin>=1400):
  (distMin!==null&&distMax!==null&&desired!==null&&desired>=distMin&&desired<=distMax);
 const sireSurface=sire.surface||dfV10ParentRaceProfile(sire).surface;
 const damSurface=dam.surface||dfV10ParentRaceProfile(dam).surface;
 const acceptsSurface=(value,target)=>value===target||value==='両方';
 // A newborn inherits one parent's surface; if the player wants both,
 // at least one parent must actually carry the dual-surface trait.
 const surfaceFit=!goal||(
   goal.surface==='両方'?(sireSurface==='両方'||damSurface==='両方'):
   acceptsSurface(sireSurface,goal.surface)||acceptsSurface(damSurface,goal.surface));
 const key=goal?V92_FOCUS[goal.focus]:null;
 const objective=key&&key!=='all'?(mean*.45+stats[key]*.55):mean;
 const rows=pedigreeRowsForPair(sire.real,dam.real);
 const pedigreeComplete=!!(rows[4]&&rows[4].length===32&&rows[4].every(Boolean));
 const futureOpportunity=df135FutureCrossOpportunity(sire,dam);
 const recommended=!close&&pedigreeComplete&&distanceFit&&surfaceFit&&(objective>=97||futureOpportunity);
 const effects=[];
 if(special)effects.push('自家生産馬の特別3×4');
 if(nick)effects.push(`${nickDetails.label}成立（固有Pt各+${nickDetails.uniqueGain}）`);
 if(thin)effects.push('薄いインブリード');
 if(famous)effects.push('名馬配合');
 if(honors)effects.push('称号一致'+honors+'件');
 if(close)effects.push('濃いインブリードに注意');
 if(!effects.length)effects.push('能力の組み合わせが良好');
 return {sire,dam,stats,mean,objective,recommended,close,nick,thin,special,distMin,distMax,
  distanceFit,surfaceFit,effects,top:ranked.slice(0,2).map(k=>FARM_STAT_NAMES[k]),honors};
}
function v92OwnedAndSalePairs(includeSale=true){
 const b=state.breeding;
 const ownSires=b.stallions.map(item=>horseById(item.id)).filter(Boolean);
 const ownMare=b.mare?horseById(b.mare.id):null;
 const saleSires=includeSale&&saleSeason()?monthlySaleList('stallion'):[];
 const saleMares=includeSale&&saleSeason()?monthlySaleList('mare'):[];
 const seen=new Set(),pairs=[];
 function add(sire,dam){
  if(!sire||!dam)return;
  const key=sire.id+'|'+dam.id;
  if(seen.has(key))return;
  seen.add(key);
  pairs.push({sire,dam,buySire:!isOwnedBreeder(sire),buyDam:!isOwnedBreeder(dam)});
 }
 for(const sire of ownSires)if(ownMare)add(sire,ownMare);
 for(const sire of saleSires)for(const dam of saleMares)add(sire,dam);
 for(const sire of saleSires)if(ownMare)add(sire,ownMare);
 for(const sire of ownSires)for(const dam of saleMares)add(sire,dam);
 return pairs;
}
function v95Shuffle(items){
 const result=items.slice();
 for(let i=result.length-1;i>0;i--){
  const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
  [result[i],result[j]]=[result[j],result[i]];
 }
 return result;
}
// Rank each AVAILABLE pairing on the deterministic predicted foal's seven abilities.
// No newborn is generated and no sale/parent records are changed.
function v129PredictedFoalStrength(report){
 if(!report)return -Infinity;
 const values=FARM_STAT_KEYS.map(key=>Number(report.stats[key])||0).sort((a,b)=>b-a);
 const bestTwo=(values[0]+values[1])/2;
 // Predicted all-round ability is dominant; extreme inbreeding is risky.
 return report.mean*.84+bestTwo*.16-(report.close?16:0);
}
function v92Candidates(goal=null,saleOnly=false){
 const pairs=v92OwnedAndSalePairs(!saleOnly||saleSeason())
  .filter(p=>!saleOnly||p.buySire||p.buyDam)
  .map(p=>({...p,report:v92EvaluatePair(p.sire,p.dam,goal)}))
  .filter(p=>p.report&&p.report.recommended)
  .map(p=>({...p,offspringStrength:v129PredictedFoalStrength(p.report)})); // keep catalog/owner order, NOT score order
 // 1..100 is a comparative rating among the available combinations.
 const highest=pairs.length?Math.max(...pairs.map(p=>p.offspringStrength)):0;
 const lowest=pairs.length?Math.min(...pairs.map(p=>p.offspringStrength)):0;
 return pairs.map(p=>({...p,score:highest===lowest?100:
  Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Math.round(1+99*(p.offspringStrength-lowest)/(highest-lowest))))}));
}

 return `<article class="v92-pair-card">

  <p class="v92-desc">${htmlEscape(kind)} ｜ 期待できる能力：${htmlEscape(r.top.join('・'))}</p>

  </div><div class="v92-pair-detail" hidden></div>
 </article>`;
}
/* Ver.95: a two-horse sale purchase is validated and committed atomically.
   Individual one-horse purchase and existing replacement rules are untouched. */
function v95BulkEligibility(sireId,damId,replaceId=''){
 const sire=df41SaleCandidate(sireId),dam=df41SaleCandidate(damId),b=state.breeding;
 if(!sire||!dam||sire.sex!=='牡'||dam.sex!=='牝'||sire.id===dam.id)
  return {ok:false,message:'販売中の2頭を確認できません。セールを開き直してください。'};
 const total=df134SalePrice(sire)+df134SalePrice(dam);
 if(state.walletCash<total)
  return {ok:false,message:`購入資金が${money(total-state.walletCash)}不足しています。`};
 if(b.stallions.length>=5&&(!replaceId||!b.stallions.some(item=>item.id===replaceId)))
  return {ok:false,message:'種牡馬の登録枠が満杯です。交換する種牡馬を選択してください。'};
 return {ok:true,sire,dam,b,replaceId};
}
function v95CommitBulkPurchase(sireId,damId,replaceId=''){
 // Revalidate at commitment time: the sale month, available horses, budget and
 // owner capacity may have changed while the confirmation was displayed.
 const v=v95BulkEligibility(sireId,damId,replaceId);
 if(!v.ok){toast(v.message);return false;}
 const {sire,dam,b}=v,startYear=breedingStartYear();
 const nextStallions=b.stallions.length>=5?b.stallions.filter(item=>item.id!==replaceId):b.stallions.slice();
 nextStallions.push({id:sire.id,startYear});
 // Both horses + money are updated together; only then notify/save once.
 b.stallions=nextStallions;
 b.selectedSire=sire.id;
 b.mare={id:dam.id,startYear};
 state.walletCash-=df134SalePrice(sire)+df134SalePrice(dam);
 change('sale-purchase-pair');
 renderBreedingScreen(breedTab);
 toast(`${sire.name}と${dam.name}を合計${money(df134SalePrice(sire)+df134SalePrice(dam))}で購入しました`);
 return true;
}

 df41SalePanelClear();
 const b=state.breeding,oldMare=b.mare&&horseById(b.mare.id);

function v92RenderGoal(into){
 const d=Object.keys(V92_DISTANCES).map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${v92Goal.distance===k?'selected':''}>${k}</option>`).join('');
 const surface=['芝','ダート','両方'].map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${v92Goal.surface===k?'selected':''}>${k}</option>`).join('');
 const focus=Object.keys(V92_FOCUS).map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${v92Goal.focus===k?'selected':''}>${k}</option>`).join('');
 into.innerHTML=`<section class="v92-intro"><h3>💗 秘書の理想馬づくり相談</h3><p>「どんな馬を作りたいですか？」希望を教えてください。手持ち馬と開催中のセール馬から探します。</p></section>
 <section class="breed-panel v92-goal-form"><label>① 目指す距離<select id="v92GoalDistance">${d}</select></label>
 <label>② 得意にしたい馬場<select id="v92GoalSurface">${surface}</select></label>
 <label>③ 重視したい能力<select id="v92GoalFocus">${focus}</select></label>
 <button type="button" id="v92GoalSearch" class="breed-action">🔍 おすすめ配合を探す</button></section>
 <div id="v92GoalResults"></div>`;
 into.querySelector('#v92GoalSearch').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  v92Goal={distance:into.querySelector('#v92GoalDistance').value,surface:into.querySelector('#v92GoalSurface').value,
   focus:into.querySelector('#v92GoalFocus').value};
  v92GoalSubmitted=true;v92RenderGoal(into);
 });
 if(!v92GoalSubmitted)return;
 const candidates=v92Candidates(v92Goal);
 const shown=candidates.slice(0,5);
 const head=into.querySelector('#v92GoalResults');
 head.innerHTML=`<section class="breed-panel"><h3>🔎 ${htmlEscape(v92Goal.surface)}・${htmlEscape(v92Goal.distance)}・${htmlEscape(v92Goal.focus)}の診断</h3>
 <p class="breed-note">おすすめは参考情報です。仔馬の適性と能力は種付け時に確定し、出産後に確認できます。</p></section>`+
 (shown.length?shown.map(v92PairCard).join(''):
 '<section class="v92-no-match" role="status"><h3>希望に合うおすすめ配合はありません</h3><p>条件を変えるか、次のセールで相性の良い繁殖馬を探してみましょう。</p></section>');
 v92InstallAdviceActions(head);
}


/* DBF NEW SALE MODULE: standalone UI, replaceable without modifying the legacy sale.
   Existing inventory, price, purchase confirmations and diagnosis event handlers are reused. */
const dfNewSaleUI={sex:'stallion',index:0,mateId:'',homeIndex:0};
/* DBF new sale pedigree viewer. Independent of legacy sale presentation. */
function dfNewSalePedigree(h, mate){
 // When a mate is selected, display the prospective foal's paternal and maternal halves.
 const sire=mate?(h.sex==='牡'?h:mate):null;
 const dam=mate?(h.sex==='牝'?h:mate):null;
 const matches=mate?dfV36Crosses(sire,dam):[];
 const severity=new Map();
 // Highlight ancestors common to both visible halves of THIS horse.
 const [sireRoot,damRoot]=mate?[sire.real||sire.name,dam.real||dam.name]:(pedigreeRows(h.real||h.name)[0]||[]);
 const [left,right]=dfVisibleFoalEntries(sireRoot,damRoot);
 const own=new Map();
 for(const [side,entries] of [[0,left],[1,right]]){
  for(const item of entries){
   if(!item.key)continue;
   if(!own.has(item.key))own.set(item.key,{sire:[],dam:[]});
   own.get(item.key)[side===0?'sire':'dam'].push(item.depth);
  }
 }
 for(const [key,v] of own){
  if(v.sire.length&&v.dam.length)severity.set(key,Math.min(...v.sire.flatMap(x=>v.dam.map(y=>x+y+2))));
 }
 // V83: visual-only lineage-nicks markers; never alter mating calculations.
 // The displayed pedigree uses a compact eight-cell tree. Maternal generation 4
 // is not a visible cell; disclose that match below rather than marking a wrong horse.
 const nickInfo=mate?df75NicksDetails(sireRoot,damRoot):{count:0,hits:[]};
 const nickColors=['#1574d4','#168b48','#e58a00','#8b47c6'];
 const nickRowByGeneration={1:1,2:5,3:7};
 const nickFrameByRow=new Map();
 for(let i=0;i<(nickInfo.hits||[]).length;i++){
  const hit=nickInfo.hits[i],row=nickRowByGeneration[hit.generation];
  if(row!==undefined)nickFrameByRow.set(row,nickColors[i%nickColors.length]);
 }
 const sireNickColors=(nickInfo.hits||[]).map((_,i)=>nickColors[i%nickColors.length]);
 const nickSireFrame=sireNickColors.length
  ?`box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px ${sireNickColors[0]},${sireNickColors.slice(1).map((c,i)=>`inset 0 0 0 ${5+2*i}px ${c}`).join(',')};`
  :'';
 const nickLegend=(nickInfo.hits||[]).map((hit,i)=>{
  const shown=nickRowByGeneration[hit.generation]!==undefined;
  return `<span style="display:inline-block;margin:3px 5px 3px 0;padding:3px 6px;border:2px solid ${nickColors[i%nickColors.length]};border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:#222;font-weight:700">${hit.generation}次ニックス${shown?'':'（該当祖先は省略表示）'}</span>`;
 }).join('');
 const displayName=n=>df53KanaAlias(n);
 // Display-only repair: use explicit inline grid layout so the pedigree cannot
 // collapse into an unstyled vertical list in Android WebView.
 const cells=[];
 const sides=[left,right];
 const bandGeometry=[
  [1,1,8,'sire'],
  [2,2,4,'sire'],[2,6,3,'dam'],
  [3,3,2,'sire'],[3,5,1,'dam'],[3,6,2,'sire'],[3,8,1,'dam'],
  [4,4,1,'sire'],[4,5,1,'sire'],[4,7,1,'sire'],[4,8,1,'sire']
 ];
 const nameColumns=[2,3,4,5,5,4,5,5];
 const bandStyle=(kind,col,row,span)=>`grid-column:${col};grid-row:${row}/span ${span};display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding-top:3px;box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0;border:1px solid #777;color:white;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;line-height:1.15;text-shadow:0 1px #333;background:${kind==='dam'?'linear-gradient(90deg,#900033,#d40061)':'linear-gradient(90deg,#1230a4,#075bfa)'};`;
 const nameStyle=(col,row,risk,unknown)=>`grid-column:${col}/6;grid-row:${row};display:flex;align-items:center;box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid #777;font-size:14px;font-weight:${unknown?500:900};color:${unknown?'#888':risk===undefined?'#111':risk<=6?'#b0002a':'#087a38'};background:${risk===undefined?'linear-gradient(#fff,#e5e5e5)':risk<=6?'#ffe6e9':'#e6f6e8'};`;
 for(let side=0;side<2;side++){
  const offset=side*8;
  for(const [column,first,span,kind] of bandGeometry){
   const row=offset+first;
   const actualKind=side===1&&column===1?'dam':kind;
   cells.push(`<div class="dfns-photo-band ${actualKind}" style="${bandStyle(actualKind,column,row,span)}" aria-label="${actualKind==='sire'?'父':'母'}">${actualKind==='sire'?'父':'母'}</div>`);
  }
  sides[side].forEach((item,j)=>{
   const row=offset+j+1,column=nameColumns[j];
   const n=item.name,risk=n?severity.get(item.key):undefined;
   const name=n?htmlEscape(displayName(n)):'―';
   const matchedCross=n&&mate&&severity.has(item.key)?matches.find(c=>breedCanonical(c.ancestor)===item.key):null;
   const effect=matchedCross?(matchedCross.custom?.customBred
    ?window.DFBreedingEffects.homebredTraits(matchedCross.custom)
    :window.DFBreedingEffects.ancestorTraits(matchedCross.ancestor)).map(k=>FARM_STAT_NAMES[k]).join('・'):'';
   const effectLabel=effect?`<small class="df85-ancestor-trait" style="display:block;font-size:9px;line-height:1.1;color:#70429c;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-weight:700">${htmlEscape(effect)}</small>`:'';
   const frame=mate&&n?(side===0&&j===0?nickSireFrame:side===1&&nickFrameByRow.has(j)?`box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px ${nickFrameByRow.get(j)};`:''):'';
   cells.push(`<div class="dfns-photo-name" style="${nameStyle(column,row,risk,!n)}${frame}" title="${n?htmlEscape(displayName(n)):'祖先不明'}"><span style="display:block;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">${name}${effectLabel}</span></div>`);
  });
 }
 const ownCrosses=[...own].filter(([k,v])=>v.sire.length&&v.dam.length).map(([k,v])=>({name:k,score:Math.min(...v.sire.flatMap(x=>v.dam.map(y=>x+y+2)))}));
 const showCrosses=ownCrosses;
 const crosses=showCrosses.length?showCrosses.map(m=>`<span class="${m.score<=6?'dfns-risk':'dfns-safe'}">${htmlEscape(displayName(m.name))}（${m.score<=6?'注意':'比較的遠い'}）</span>`).join(' ／ '):([ ...left,...right ].some(x=>!x.key)?'確認できた範囲では重複なし（祖先不明あり）':'表示祖先に重複なし');
 const crossGenerations=mate
  ?matches.flatMap(m=>m.positions.map(([a,b])=>({name:m.ancestor,a,b})))
  :[...own].flatMap(([name,v])=>v.sire.flatMap(a=>v.dam.map(b=>({name,a:a+1,b:b+1}))));
 crossGenerations.sort((x,y)=>x.a+x.b-y.a-y.b||x.a-y.a);
 const crossSummary=crossGenerations.length
  ?[...new Set(crossGenerations.map(x=>`${displayName(x.name)}の${x.a}×${x.b}`))].map(htmlEscape).join(' ／ ')
  :'確認できた共通祖先なし';
 const mateCrosses=mate?matches.map(m=>`<span class="${Math.min(...m.positions.map(([a,b])=>a+b))<=6?'dfns-risk':'dfns-safe'}">${htmlEscape(displayName(m.ancestor))}</span>`).join(' ／ '):'';
 return `<section class="dfns-pedigree" aria-label="階段状の血統表">
 <div class="dfns-stair-table" data-dbf-photo-pedigree="v34" style="overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;border:2px solid #68717b;background:#eee;margin:10px 0"><div class="dfns-photo-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,34px) minmax(160px,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(16,32px);width:100%;min-width:320px;box-sizing:border-box;gap:0;background:#ddd">${cells.join('')}</div></div>
 ${nickLegend?`<div class="dfns-nicks-legend" style="margin:5px 0 8px"><strong>🤝 ニックス成立：</strong>${nickLegend}</div>`:''}
 ${crossGenerations.length?`<p class="dfns-ped-result" data-dfns-cross-summary>${[...new Set(crossGenerations.map(x=>`${htmlEscape(displayName(x.name))} ${x.a}×${x.b}`))].join(' ／ ')}</p>`:''}</section>`;
}
/* Ver57: sale display only; honor effects are calculated by the existing pairing rules. */
function df57PairParent(h,role){
 if(!h)return '';
 const family=salePaternalFamily(h.real||h.sireReal||h.sire||'').family||'系統未確認';
 return `<div class="df57-parent"><b>${role}　${htmlEscape(df53DisplayedHorse(h))}（${htmlEscape(family)}）</b>${h.customBred?df39BreederEmblems(h):''}</div>`;
}
function df57PairSummary(sire,dam){
 if(!sire||!dam)return '';
 const honors=(sire.customBred||dam.customBred)?df39CommonHonors(sire,dam):[];
 return `<div class="dfns-ped-result" data-dfns-pair="true">${df57PairParent(sire,'父')}${df57PairParent(dam,'母')}${honors.length?`<div class="df57-honor-effects"><b>配合効果のある称号</b><div>${honors.map(id=>`<span class="df39-pair-label">${htmlEscape(id==='triple'?'三冠配合':DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id]+'配合')}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>`:''}</div>`;
}
function dfNewSaleRender(into){
 const ui=dfNewSaleUI;
 const saleOrOwned=kind=>{
  const owned=kind==='stallion'?state.breeding.stallions.map(x=>horseById(x.id)).filter(Boolean):[horseById(state.breeding.mare?.id)].filter(Boolean);
  if(!saleSeason())return owned;
  const offered=monthlySaleList(kind);
  // Keep the 10 current offers, then append owned sale horses not offered this month.
  const ids=new Set(offered.map(h=>h.id));
  return [...offered,...owned.filter(h=>!h.customBred&&!ids.has(h.id))];
 };
 const isOwned=h=>!!h&&(state.breeding.stallions.some(x=>x.id===h.id)||state.breeding.mare?.id===h.id);
 const canPair=(sire,dam)=>state.calendarMonth===4&&!!sire&&!!dam&&isOwned(sire)&&isOwned(dam)&&!state.breeding.bredYears.includes(state.calendarYear)&&!activePregnancy()&&state.horses.length+state.pregnancies.length<5&&df135CanUseBreeder(sire)&&df135CanUseBreeder(dam)&&state.walletCash>=df135BreedingTotal(sire,dam);
 const breedFooter=(sire,dam)=>`<div class="dfns-breed-footer" style="margin:14px 0 4px;text-align:center"><button type="button" class="breed-action" data-dfns-breed ${canPair(sire,dam)?'':'disabled'}>🌱 配合する</button><p class="breed-note">${state.calendarMonth!==4?'配合できるのは4月だけです。':state.breeding.bredYears.includes(state.calendarYear)?'今年の配合は終了しています。':activePregnancy()?'種付け済みです。':!isOwned(sire)||!isOwned(dam)?'配合するには牡馬・牝馬の両方を所有している必要があります。':!canPair(sire,dam)?'配合条件を満たしていません。':'4月・年1回。確認後に配合します。'}</p></div>`;
 // Buy the currently displayed sale horse and its selected opposite-sex sale partner together.
 // Validate both before changing any saved breeding data; do not silently replace owned horses.
 const buyPair=(first,second)=>{
  if(!saleSeason()||!first||!second||first.id===second.id||first.sex===second.sex){toast('購入する2頭を選択してください');return;}
  const sire=first.sex==='牡'?first:second,dam=first.sex==='牝'?first:second;
  if(!df41SaleCandidate(sire.id)||!df41SaleCandidate(dam.id)){toast('セール対象の2頭を確認できません');return;}
  if(isOwnedBreeder(sire)||isOwnedBreeder(dam)){toast('購入済みの馬は2頭同時購入できません');return;}
  if(state.breeding.stallions.length>=5||state.breeding.mare){toast('繁殖馬の所有枠が足りません。所持馬を確認してください');return;}
  const total=df134SalePrice(sire)+df134SalePrice(dam);
  if(state.walletCash<total){toast('2頭分の購入資金が足りません');return;}
  if(!confirm(`${sire.name} と ${dam.name} を2頭購入しますか？\n合計：${money(total)}`))return;
  // Revalidate before the single state change.
  if(!saleSeason()||state.walletCash<total||state.breeding.stallions.length>=5||state.breeding.mare||isOwnedBreeder(sire)||isOwnedBreeder(dam))return;
  const startYear=breedingStartYear();
  state.breeding.stallions.push({id:sire.id,startYear});
  state.breeding.mare={id:dam.id,startYear};
  state.breeding.selectedSire=sire.id;
  state.walletCash-=total;
  change('sale-purchase');renderBreedingScreen('dfNewSale');
  toast('2頭を購入しました');
 };
 const attachBreed=(target,sire,dam)=>target.querySelector('[data-dfns-breed]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!canPair(sire,dam))return;commitBreeding(sire.id,dam.id);});
 into.innerHTML=`<section class="dfns" aria-label="セール">
 
 <nav class="dfns-tabs" aria-label="馬の種類"><button type="button" data-dfns-sex="stallion">${saleSeason()?'🐎 牡馬10頭':'🐎 所有馬牡'}</button><button type="button" data-dfns-sex="mare">${saleSeason()?'🎀 牝馬10頭':'🎀 所有馬牝'}</button><button type="button" data-dfns-sex="home-stallion">🐴 自家製牡</button><button type="button" data-dfns-sex="home-mare">🌸 自家製牝</button></nav>
 <div class="dfns-status"></div><div class="dfns-pager"><button type="button" data-dfns-prev>◀ 前の馬</button><strong class="dfns-counter"></strong><button type="button" data-dfns-next>次の馬 ▶</button></div>
 <button type="button" class="dfns-list-toggle">☰ 全頭一覧を見る</button><div class="dfns-list" hidden></div><div class="dfns-display"></div><section class="dfns-pedigree-panel"><div class="dfns-ped-content"></div></section></section>`;
 const root=into.querySelector('.dfns'),display=root.querySelector('.dfns-display'),status=root.querySelector('.dfns-status'),counter=root.querySelector('.dfns-counter'),listBox=root.querySelector('.dfns-list');
 const host=document.createElement('div');host.className='dfns-original-host';root.appendChild(host);
 const pedContent=root.querySelector('.dfns-ped-content');
 function refreshPedigree(){
  const h=saleOrOwned(ui.sex)[ui.index];
  if(!h){pedContent.textContent='該当する所持馬・出品馬がありません';return;}
  const saleMates=saleOrOwned(ui.sex==='stallion'?'mare':'stallion');
  const oppositeSex=ui.sex==='stallion'?'牝':'牡';
  const mates=saleMates.map(h=>({horse:h,homebred:false}));
  // Keep the selected partner stable across redraws and use the original
  // breeding horse object, including homebred pedigree, for all calculations.
  const selected=mates.some(m=>m.horse.id===ui.mateId)?ui.mateId:(mates[0]?.horse.id||'');
  ui.mateId=selected;
  const mate=mates.find(m=>m.horse.id===selected)?.horse||null;
  const father=mate?(h.sex==='牡'?h:mate):null;
  const mother=mate?(h.sex==='牝'?h:mate):null;
  const pairLabel=mate?df57PairSummary(father,mother):'<p class="dfns-ped-note">配合相手を選ぶと、父と母を組み合わせた予定仔馬の血統表を表示します。</p>';
  pedContent.innerHTML=`<div class="dfns-mate-controls" style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;margin:10px 0">
   <label class="dfns-mate-label" style="flex:1;min-width:0;margin:0">配合相手を選択
    <select data-dfns-mate>${mates.map(m=>`<option value="${htmlEscape(m.horse.id)}" ${m.horse.id===selected?'selected':''}>${htmlEscape(m.homebred?'【自家生産】'+m.horse.name:saleHorseFamilyName(m.horse.real,m.horse.name))}</option>`).join('')}</select>
   </label>
   </div>`+pairLabel+dfNewSalePedigree(h,mate)+breedFooter(father,mother)+`<div data-dfns-diagnosis aria-live="polite"></div>`;
  attachBreed(pedContent,father,mother);
  // New SALE only: remove the explanatory paragraph below the pedigree.
  pedContent.querySelector('.dfns-ped-note:last-child')?.remove();
  pedContent.querySelector('[data-dfns-mate]').addEventListener('change',e=>{ui.mateId=e.target.value;refresh()});
  const diagnosis=pedContent.querySelector('[data-dfns-diagnosis]');
  if(father&&mother){try{diagnosis.innerHTML=df39PairingLabels(father,mother)+salePairDiagnosis(father,mother);}catch(err){diagnosis.textContent='配合診断を表示できません: '+(err?.message||err);console.error(err);}}else diagnosis.textContent='配合相手を選択してください';
 }
 function refreshHomebred(){
  const isMale=ui.sex==='home-stallion';
  const horses=(state.breeding.customBreeders||[]).filter(h=>h&&h.customBred===true&&h.sex===(isMale?'牡':'牝'));
  const opposite=(state.breeding.customBreeders||[]).filter(h=>h&&h.customBred===true&&h.sex===(isMale?'牝':'牡'));
  const otherSale=saleOrOwned(isMale?'mare':'stallion');
  const homeMates=opposite;
  const saleMates=otherSale.filter(h=>!opposite.some(o=>o.id===h.id));
  const mates=[...homeMates,...saleMates];
  host.replaceChildren();display.replaceChildren();listBox.replaceChildren();
  ui.homeIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(ui.homeIndex,Math.max(0,horses.length-1)));
  status.textContent=`${state.calendarYear}年目 ${state.calendarMonth}月 ｜ ${isMale?'自家製牡':'自家製牝'} ${horses.length}頭`;
  counter.textContent=horses.length?`${ui.homeIndex+1} / ${horses.length}頭`:'登録馬なし';
  horses.forEach((h,i)=>{
   const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='dfns-roster-btn';
   b.innerHTML=`${i+1}. ${htmlEscape(h.name)} ${df39BreederEmblems(h)}`;b.classList.toggle('active',i===ui.homeIndex);
   b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ui.homeIndex=i;ui.mateId='';refresh()});listBox.appendChild(b);
  });
  const h=horses[ui.homeIndex];
  if(!h){display.innerHTML='<p class="breed-placeholder">該当する自家生産馬はまだいません。</p>';pedContent.replaceChildren();}
  else{
   const owned=state.breeding.stallions.some(x=>x.id===h.id)||state.breeding.mare?.id===h.id;
   display.innerHTML=`<section class="breed-panel"><h3>${htmlEscape(h.name)} ${df39BreederEmblems(h)}（${h.sex}）</h3><p>自家生産馬${owned?' ／ 繁殖登録中':''}</p><p>父：${htmlEscape(df53KanaAlias(h.sireReal||h.sire||'―'))} ／ 母：${htmlEscape(df53KanaAlias(h.damReal||h.dam||'―'))}</p></section>`;
   const mateGroup=mates.some(x=>x.id===ui.mateId)?(homeMates.some(x=>x.id===ui.mateId)?'home':'sale'):(homeMates.length?'home':'sale');
   const chosenGroup=ui.homeMateGroup==='home'||ui.homeMateGroup==='sale'?ui.homeMateGroup:mateGroup;
   ui.homeMateGroup=chosenGroup;
   const groupMates=()=>ui.homeMateGroup==='home'?homeMates:saleMates;
   if(!groupMates().some(x=>x.id===ui.mateId))ui.mateId=groupMates()[0]?.id||'';
   const mate=groupMates().find(x=>x.id===ui.mateId);
   pedContent.innerHTML=`<div class="dfns-mate-controls" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0"><button type="button" data-dfns-home-group="home" class="${ui.homeMateGroup==='home'?'active':''}">自家製の相手を選択</button><button type="button" data-dfns-home-group="sale" class="${ui.homeMateGroup==='sale'?'active':''}">セール馬の相手を選択</button></div><label class="dfns-mate-label">配合相手<select data-dfns-home-mate>${groupMates().map(x=>`<option value="${htmlEscape(x.id)}" ${x.id===ui.mateId?'selected':''}>${htmlEscape(x.customBred?'【自家製】'+x.name:df53DisplayedHorse(x))}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><div data-dfns-home-report></div>`;
   const report=pedContent.querySelector('[data-dfns-home-report]');
   const renderReport=()=>{
    const selected=groupMates().find(x=>x.id===ui.mateId);
    if(!selected){report.textContent='配合相手がいません';return;}
    const sire=h.sex==='牡'?h:selected,dam=h.sex==='牝'?h:selected;
    report.innerHTML=df57PairSummary(sire,dam)+dfNewSalePedigree(h,selected)+breedFooter(sire,dam)+`<div data-dfns-home-diagnosis></div>`;
    attachBreed(report,sire,dam);
    report.querySelector('[data-dfns-home-diagnosis]').innerHTML=df39PairingLabels(sire,dam)+salePairDiagnosis(sire,dam);
   };
   pedContent.querySelectorAll('[data-dfns-home-group]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ui.homeMateGroup=b.dataset.dfnsHomeGroup;ui.mateId='';refreshHomebred()}));
   pedContent.querySelector('[data-dfns-home-mate]').addEventListener('change',e=>{ui.mateId=e.target.value;renderReport()});

   renderReport();
  }
  root.querySelector('[data-dfns-prev]').disabled=ui.homeIndex===0;
  root.querySelector('[data-dfns-next]').disabled=ui.homeIndex>=horses.length-1;
 }
 function refresh(){
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-dfns-sex]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.dfnsSex===ui.sex));
  if(ui.sex.startsWith('home-')){refreshHomebred();return;}
  host.replaceChildren();
  // Reuse original, proven sale renderer, including purchase/diagnosis listeners.
  if(saleSeason())renderSalePage(ui.sex,host,saleOrOwned(ui.sex));
  else{
   saleOrOwned(ui.sex).forEach(h=>{
    const card=document.createElement('section');card.className='breed-sale-card breed-panel';
    card.innerHTML=`<h4>${htmlEscape(df53DisplayedHorse(h))}</h4><p>所持している${ui.sex==='stallion'?'種牡馬':'繁殖牝馬'}</p>`;
    host.appendChild(card);
   });
  }
  // New SALE only: the original renderer is reused but its extra detail button is not needed.
  host.querySelectorAll('.df149-detail-open').forEach(button=>button.remove());
  const cards=[...host.querySelectorAll('.breed-sale-card')];
  ui.index=Math.max(0,Math.min(ui.index,cards.length-1));
  display.replaceChildren();listBox.replaceChildren();
  status.textContent=`${state.calendarYear}年目 ${state.calendarMonth}月　｜　所持金 ${funds(state.walletCash)}　｜　${ui.sex==='stallion'?'牡馬':'牝馬'}${saleSeason()?'セール':'所持馬'}`;
  counter.textContent=cards.length?`${ui.index+1} / ${cards.length}頭`:'所持馬なし';
  cards.forEach((card,i)=>{
   const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='dfns-roster-btn';b.textContent=`${i+1}. ${card.querySelector('h4')?.textContent||'販売馬'}`;
   b.classList.toggle('active',i===ui.index);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ui.index=i;refresh()});listBox.appendChild(b);
   if(i===ui.index){display.appendChild(card);card.classList.add('dfns-featured');}
  });
  if(saleSeason())display.querySelectorAll('[data-df61-buy-pair]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   const shown=saleOrOwned(ui.sex)[ui.index];
   const other=saleOrOwned(ui.sex==='stallion'?'mare':'stallion').find(x=>x.id===ui.mateId);
   buyPair(shown,other);
  }));
  refreshPedigree();
  root.querySelector('[data-dfns-prev]').disabled=ui.index===0;
  root.querySelector('[data-dfns-next]').disabled=ui.index>=cards.length-1;
 }
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-dfns-sex]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ui.sex=b.dataset.dfnsSex;ui.index=0;ui.homeIndex=0;ui.mateId='';refresh()}));
 root.querySelector('[data-dfns-prev]').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(ui.sex.startsWith('home-')){if(ui.homeIndex>0){ui.homeIndex--;refresh()}}else if(ui.index>0){ui.index--;refresh()}});
 root.querySelector('[data-dfns-next]').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(ui.sex.startsWith('home-'))ui.homeIndex++;else ui.index++;refresh()});
 root.querySelector('.dfns-list-toggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{listBox.hidden=!listBox.hidden;root.querySelector('.dfns-list-toggle').textContent=listBox.hidden?'☰ 全頭一覧を見る':'▲ 一覧を閉じる'});
 refresh();
}
