function saleDiagnosisHorseName(original,fallback){
 return df53KanaAlias(original)||String(fallback||'');
}
/* Ver.53: unified display-only game aliases. Never use these in pedigree lookups. */
function df53KanaAlias(original){
 const key=breedCanonical(original);
 if(!key)return '';
 const registered=SALE_221_GAME_NAMES[key]||FUNNY_HORSE_NAMES[key];
 if(registered)return String(registered).replace(/[^ァ-ヶー]/g,'');
 const h=hashFarm(key)>>>0;
 const a=['モグモグ','ワクワク','ウマウマ','パクパク','ゴキゲン','ニコニコ','プリプリ','マンプク'];
 const b=['プリン','ギョーザ','オムライス','コロッケ','ラーメン','ワッフル','オニギリ','カレー'];
 const c=['マル','ポン','リン','チャン','ピョン','ドン','ニャン','タン'];
 return a[h%8]+b[(h>>>3)%8]+c[(h>>>6)%8];
}
function df53LineageAlias(family){
 const f=String(family||'');
 if(!f||f==='系統未確認')return '系統未確認';
 const root=f.replace(/系$/,'');
 // 系統名だけを元の名前から必ず1文字置換する。馬名や系統判定は変更しない。
 const chars=Array.from(root);
 const kana={'ス':'ズ','ト':'ド','タ':'ダ','カ':'ガ','サ':'ザ','シ':'ジ','テ':'デ','ハ':'バ','ヒ':'ビ','フ':'ブ','ヘ':'ベ','ホ':'ボ','ク':'グ','チ':'ヂ','ツ':'ヅ','キ':'ギ','コ':'ゴ','セ':'ゼ','ソ':'ゾ','ナ':'ニ','ニ':'ヌ','ヌ':'ネ','ネ':'ノ','ノ':'ナ','ラ':'リ','リ':'ル','ル':'レ','レ':'ロ','ロ':'ラ','ン':'ム','ム':'ン','ー':'ッ'};
 let i=chars.length-1;
 while(i>=0&&!/[ァ-ヶA-Za-z]/.test(chars[i]))i--;
 if(i<0)return root+'系';
 const c=chars[i];
 chars[i]=kana[c]||(/[A-Za-z]/.test(c)?(c==='a'?'b':c==='A'?'B':'a'):'ア');
 return chars.join('')+'系';
}
function df53DisplayedHorse(h){
 if(!h)return '';
 return h.customBred?String(h.name||''):df53KanaAlias(h.real||h.name);
}
/* Ver.115: Sale-only paternal lineage labels, based exclusively on the fixed 221 pedigree rows. */
function saleLineageKey(name){return breedCanonical(name).toLocaleLowerCase('en-US').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
const SALE_221_FATHER_LINKS=(()=>{
 const found=new Map(),ambiguous=new Set();
 for(const [name,ped] of Object.entries(GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN)){
  if(!Array.isArray(ped)||ped.length!==62)continue;
  const paternal=[name,ped[0],ped[2],ped[6],ped[14],ped[30]];
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
   const child=saleLineageKey(paternal[i]),parent=saleLineageKey(paternal[i+1]);
   if(!child||!parent||child===parent)continue;
   if(found.has(child)&&saleLineageKey(found.get(child))!==parent)ambiguous.add(child);
   else if(!found.has(child))found.set(child,paternal[i+1]);
  }
 }
 for(const name of ambiguous)found.delete(name);
 return found;
})();
/* Recognized male-line ancestor names actually present in this game's pedigree data. */
const SALE_LINEAGE_ANCESTORS=[
 ['サンデーサイレンス','サンデーサイレンス'],['Roberto','ロベルト'],
 ['Mr. Prospector','ミスタープロスペクター'],['Northern Dancer','ノーザンダンサー'],
 ['Grey Sovereign','グレイソヴリン'],['Blushing Groom','ブラッシンググルーム'],
 ['Never Bend','ネヴァーベンド'],['パーソロン','パーソロン'],
 ['Native Dancer','ネイティヴダンサー'],['Princely Gift','プリンスリーギフト'],
 ['Nasrullah','ナスルーラ'],['テスコボーイ','テスコボーイ'],
 ['Hail to Reason','ヘイルトゥリーズン'],['Turn-to','ターントゥー'],
 ['Storm Cat','ストームキャット'],['Danzig','ダンジグ'],
 ['Hyperion','ハイペリオン'],['Ribot','リボー'],
 ['In Reality','インリアリティ'],['Royal Charger','ロイヤルチャージャー'],
 ['Nearco','ネアルコ']
];
const SALE_LINEAGE_CACHE=new Map();
function salePaternalFamily(real){
 const key=saleLineageKey(real);
 if(SALE_LINEAGE_CACHE.has(key))return SALE_LINEAGE_CACHE.get(key);
 const rows=pedigreeRows(real);
 const chain=[real,...rows.map(row=>row[0]).filter(Boolean)];
 const seen=new Set(chain.map(saleLineageKey));
 // Extend only with male-line links attested in the 221 registered pedigrees.
 for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
  const last=chain[chain.length-1],father=SALE_221_FATHER_LINKS.get(saleLineageKey(last));
  if(!father||seen.has(saleLineageKey(father)))break;
  chain.push(father);seen.add(saleLineageKey(father));
 }
 const keys=new Set(chain.map(saleLineageKey));
 let family='';
 for(const [ancestor,label] of SALE_LINEAGE_ANCESTORS){
  if(keys.has(saleLineageKey(ancestor))){family=label+'系';break;}
 }
 // If no named major line appears, use a verified paternal ancestor, never a guessed category.
 if(!family&&chain.length>1)family=breedCanonical(chain[Math.min(3,chain.length-1)])+'系';
 const result={family:df53LineageAlias(family),verified:!!family};
 SALE_LINEAGE_CACHE.set(key,result);return result;
}
function saleHorseFamilyName(real,displayName){
 const fam=salePaternalFamily(real).family||'系統未確認';
 return df53KanaAlias(real||displayName)+'（'+fam+'）';
}
function saleRegisteredPedigreeMatches(sire,mare){
 const ck=x=>breedCanonical(x);
 const sireName=ck(sire.real),mareName=ck(mare.real);
 const selectedFamily=salePaternalFamily(sire.real);
 const exact=[],similar=[];
 // Only the fixed 221 registered horses can ever appear in either section.
 for(const [originalName,ped] of Object.entries(GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN)){
  if(!Array.isArray(ped)||ped.length!==62)continue;
  const officialName=SALE_221_GAME_NAMES[originalName];
  if(!officialName)continue;
  const registeredSire=ped[0],registeredDam=ped[1];
  if(!registeredSire||!registeredDam)continue;
  const rs=ck(registeredSire),rd=ck(registeredDam);
  const horse={name:officialName};
  if(rs===sireName&&rd===mareName){exact.push(horse);continue;}
  // Similar: precisely the same mother, a different sire, and the same VERIFIED sire line.
  if(rd!==mareName||rs===sireName||!selectedFamily.verified)continue;
  const family=salePaternalFamily(registeredSire);
  if(!family.verified||family.family!==selectedFamily.family)continue;
  similar.push({horse,score:1,reason:'母が同じ・父馬の系統が同じ（'+family.family+'）'});
 }
 similar.sort((a,b)=>a.horse.name.localeCompare(b.horse.name,'ja'));
 return {exact:exact.slice(0,6),similar:similar.slice(0,4)};
}
function salePairDiagnosis(sire,mare){
 const rows=pedigreeRowsForPair(sire.real,mare.real);
 const crossesV36=dfV36Crosses(sire,mare),specialV36=dfV36SpecialCross(sire,mare);
 const pedigreeComplete=!!(rows[4]&&rows[4].length===32&&rows[4].every(Boolean));
 // Match the same paternal-vs-maternal crosses used for conception, health,
 // special bonuses and the displayed pedigree. Repeats within one side alone
 // must not be classified as an inbreeding cross.
 const {thin,close}=dfVisiblePairIntensity(sire,mare,crossesV36);
 const paternalKnown=(pedigreeRows(sire.real)[0]||[]).length===2&&(pedigreeRows(sire.real)[0]||[]).every(Boolean);
 const maternalKnown=(pedigreeRows(mare.real)[0]||[]).length===2&&(pedigreeRows(mare.real)[0]||[]).every(Boolean);
 const nick=paternalKnown&&maternalKnown&&df73IsNicksPair(sire.real,mare.real);
 const famous=!!famousPair(sire.real,mare.real);
 const match=saleRegisteredPedigreeMatches(sire,mare);
 const sireBranch=new Set([sire.real,...pedigreeRows(sire.real).slice(0,4).flat()].filter(Boolean).map(breedCanonical));
 const damBranch=new Set([mare.real,...pedigreeRows(mare.real).slice(0,4).flat()].filter(Boolean).map(breedCanonical));
 const shared=[...sireBranch].filter(n=>damBranch.has(n));
 const scan={count:shared.length,matches:shared.map(ancestor=>({ancestor})),complete:pedigreeComplete};
 let grade,reason;
 if(specialV36&&!close){grade='特別配合';reason='自家生産馬の3×4（または4×3）インブリードで、祖先の元能力と戦績に応じた特別効果が適用されます。';}
 else if(close){grade='おすすめしません';reason='濃い血統の重なりにより、仔馬の安定性に悪影響が出るためです。';}
 else if(!pedigreeComplete){grade='判定保留';reason='祖先情報が不足しているため、配合の良し悪しを断定できません。';}
 else if(famous||nick||thin){grade='おすすめします';reason='血統の組み合わせによる良い効果が期待できます。ただし生まれる仔馬には個体差があります。';}
 else if(v92EvaluatePair(sire,mare)?.recommended){grade='おすすめします';reason='7能力の予測評価が高く、濃いインブリードも検出されません。出生結果には個体差があります。';}
 else {grade='まずまずの配合です';reason='確認できた範囲では、特別に良い効果や大きな問題は見つかりませんでした。';}
 const effects=[];
 if(specialV36){
  const a=specialV36.custom;
  effects.push(`✨ 自家生産馬の${specialV36.patterns.map(p=>p.join('×')).join('・')}特別インブリード：${a.name}の元能力とGⅠ${a.g1Wins}勝の実績に応じて仔馬の7能力を大幅強化。上昇量は種付け時に確定します。`);
 }
 if(famous)effects.push('🏆 名馬配合：高い素質を持つ仔馬が生まれることが期待できます。');
 if(nick){const n=df75NicksDetails(sire.real,mare.real);effects.push(`🤝 ${n.label}：出生時の固有Pt各+${n.uniqueGain}（一度だけ適用）。`);}
 if(thin)effects.push('🧬 薄いインブリード：スピードに良い影響が期待できます。');
 if(close)effects.push('⚠️ 濃いインブリード：仔馬の安定性に悪影響が出ます。');
  if(crossesV36.length)effects.push('🩺 インブリード：血統が濃いほど、誕生時の健康に最大25Ptの減点が生じます。');
 if(!effects.length)effects.push('確認できた範囲では、特別な配合効果は見つかりませんでした。');
 const distS=parentDistanceAptitude(sire),distM=parentDistanceAptitude(mare);
 if(distS||distM){
  const dS=distS||distM,dM=distM||distS;
  const lo=Math.max(1000,Math.min(3600,Math.round((dS[0]+dM[0])/200)*100)),hi=Math.max(lo+200,Math.min(4000,Math.round((dS[1]+dM[1])/200)*100));
  effects.push(`🏇 距離適性：およそ${lo}〜${hi}mを基準に、出生時に前後最大200m変動します。`);
 }else effects.push('🏇 距離適性：両親の適性が未登録のため予測できません。');
 effects.push('📈 仔馬の能力や成長タイプは種付け時に内部確定し、出産後に確認できます。');
 const horseNames=arr=>arr.map(h=>`<li><strong>${htmlEscape(h.name)}</strong></li>`).join('');
 const similarNames=match.similar.map(v=>`<li><strong>${htmlEscape(v.horse.name)}</strong> <small>（${htmlEscape(v.reason)}）</small></li>`).join('');
 const cross=crossesV36.length?`${crossesV36.length}件：${crossesV36.map(m=>
   `${dfV36CrossName(m)} ${m.positions.map(p=>p.join('×')).join('・')}`).map(htmlEscape).join('、')}`:
   (scan.complete?'5代以内の共通祖先なし':'確認できた範囲では未検出');
 // Ver.159: report verified paternal lines from the existing pedigree catalog.
 const df159FatherFamily=salePaternalFamily(sire.real).family||'系統未確認';
 const df159MotherFather=(pedigreeRows(mare.real)[0]||[])[0]||'';
 const df159MotherFatherFamily=df159MotherFather
   ?(salePaternalFamily(df159MotherFather).family||'系統未確認'):'系統未確認';
 const df159LineageHtml=`<div class="df159-lineage-info">
   <p><strong>父馬の父系：</strong>${htmlEscape(df159FatherFamily)}</p>
   <p><strong>母馬の母父系：</strong>${htmlEscape(df159MotherFatherFamily)}</p>
   </div>`;
 return `<article class="v111-pair">
  <h5>🐴 ${htmlEscape(sire.customBred?sire.name:saleHorseFamilyName(sire.real,saleDiagnosisHorseName(sire.real,sire.name)))} × 🎀 ${htmlEscape(mare.customBred?mare.name:saleHorseFamilyName(mare.real,saleDiagnosisHorseName(mare.real,mare.name)))}</h5>
  ${df159LineageHtml}
  ${nick?`<p class="df159-nicks">🤝 ${htmlEscape(df75NicksDetails(sire.real,mare.real).label)}成立！</p>`:''}
  ${window.dfV129SaleScoreVisible===true?`<p class="v111-verdict ${close?'v111-not-recommended':grade==='おすすめします'?'v111-recommended':''}">${htmlEscape(grade)}</p>`:''}
  ${window.dfV129SaleScoreVisible===true&&df39CommonHonors(sire,mare).length?`<p class="v92-owned-badge">おすすめ理由：${df39CommonHonors(sire,mare).map(id=>htmlEscape(DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id])+'配合あり').join('・')}</p>`:''}
  <p class="v111-ancestry">インブリード：${cross}${!pedigreeComplete?'（一部祖先未確認）':''}</p>
  ${crossesV36.length?'<p class="df72-inbreed-warning">※ 赤字のインブリードはおすすめ出来ないインブリードです。</p>':''}
  <h6>血統の特徴</h6><ul>
   ${specialV36?'<li>特徴的なインブリードの組み合わせが見つかりました。</li>':''}
   ${famous?'<li>登録された名馬の血統と関係する配合です。</li>':''}
   ${nick?'<li>系統相性に特徴が見られます。</li>':''}
   ${thin?'<li>薄いインブリードが見られます。</li>':''}
   ${close?'<li>濃いインブリードです。配合時は注意が必要です。</li>':''}
   ${!specialV36&&!famous&&!nick&&!thin&&!close?'<li>確認できた範囲では特別な血統の重なりはありません。</li>':''}
   <li>距離適性や能力は種付け時に内部確定し、仔馬の誕生後に確認できます。</li>
  </ul>
  <h6>同じ父・母の登録馬</h6>${match.exact.length?`<ul>${horseNames(match.exact)}</ul>`:'<p>該当する登録馬はいません。</p>'}
  <h6>似た配合の登録馬</h6>${match.similar.length?`<ul>${similarNames}</ul>`:'<p>該当する登録馬はいません。</p>'}
 </article>`;
}
/* Ver.41: sale purchases use an in-page confirmation, independent of native JS dialogs.
   The original optional pairing diagnosis remains available on each sale card. */
function df41SalePanelClear(){
 document.querySelectorAll('#breedScreenContent .v111-preview, #breedScreenContent .v41-confirm').forEach(n=>n.remove());
}
function df41SaleCandidate(id){
 const h=horseById(id);
 return h&&saleSeason()&&!isOwnedBreeder(h)
   &&monthlySaleList(h.sex==='牡'?'stallion':'mare').some(x=>x.id===h.id)?h:null;
}
function showSalePurchaseConfirm(id){
 const h=df41SaleCandidate(id);
 if(!h)return;
 if(state.walletCash<df134SalePrice(h)){toast('購入資金が足りません');return;}
 const card=[...document.querySelectorAll('#breedScreenContent .breed-sale-card')].find(n=>n.dataset.saleHorse===id);
 if(!card)return;
 df41SalePanelClear();
 const b=state.breeding;
 const old=b.mare&&horseById(b.mare.id);
 const atLimit=h.sex==='牡'&&b.stallions.length>=5;
 const chooser=atLimit?`<label class="v41-choose-label">交換する種牡馬を選択してください
 <select class="v41-replace"><option value="">選択してください</option>${b.stallions.map(item=>{
  const entry=horseById(item.id);
  return `<option value="${htmlEscape(item.id)}">${htmlEscape(entry?.name||item.id)}</option>`;
 }).join('')}</select></label>`:'';
 const explanation=h.sex==='牝'&&old?`<p>現在の繁殖牝馬「${htmlEscape(old.name)}」と交換します。</p>`:atLimit?'<p>種牡馬は5頭までです。交換する1頭を指定してください。</p>':'';
 const panel=document.createElement('div');panel.className='v41-confirm';panel.setAttribute('role','region');
 panel.setAttribute('aria-label','セール購入確認');
 panel.innerHTML=`<h4>購入確認</h4><p>「${htmlEscape(h.name)}」（GⅠ${df134SaleG1Wins(h)}勝）を${money(df134SalePrice(h))}で購入しますか？</p>${explanation}${chooser}
 <div class="v41-actions"><button type="button" class="v41-accept">購入を確定する</button><button type="button" class="v41-cancel">やめる</button></div>`;
 card.appendChild(panel);
 panel.querySelector('.v41-accept').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const replacement=panel.querySelector('.v41-replace')?.value||'';
  if(atLimit&&!replacement){toast('交換する種牡馬を選択してください');return;}
  attemptSalePurchase(id,replacement);
 });
 panel.querySelector('.v41-cancel').addEventListener('click',()=>panel.remove());
 panel.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'});
}
function renderSalePage(kind,into,listOverride){
 if(!saleSeason()){into.innerHTML='<div class="breed-placeholder">セールは毎年12月〜翌年3月に開催します。</div>';return}
 const studs=kind==='stallion', list=listOverride||monthlySaleList(kind),b=state.breeding;
 const owned=studs?b.stallions:b.mare?[b.mare]:[];
 const cheapest=list.length?Math.min(...list.map(df134SalePrice)):0;
 const shortfall=Math.max(0,cheapest-state.walletCash);
 const shortageGuide=shortfall>0?`<p class="breed-note" role="status">購入資金が${money(shortfall)}不足しています。</p>`:'';
 into.innerHTML=`<section class="breed-panel"><h3>${studs?'🐴 牡馬セール':'🎀 牝馬セール'}　${state.calendarYear}年目 ${state.calendarMonth}月</h3>
 <p class="breed-note">毎月10頭紹介・価格はGⅠ勝利数×1,500万円。${studs?'最大5頭・購入から5回の種付けシーズン使用可能。':'1頭のみ・購入から5回の種付けシーズン使用可能。'}</p>
 <div class="breed-roster">所持：${owned.length}頭　${owned.map(x=>{const h=horseById(x.id);return `<span>${htmlEscape(h?(h.customBred?h.name:saleHorseFamilyName(h.real,h.name)):'')} 残り${yearsLeft(x)}年</span>`}).join('')}</div>
 ${shortageGuide}</section>
 <div class="breed-sale-list">${list.map(h=>`<section class="breed-sale-card" data-sale-horse="${h.id}"><h4>${htmlEscape(saleHorseFamilyName(h.real,h.name))}${isOwnedBreeder(h)?' <span class="df70-owned-mark" style="font-weight:bold;color:#1b7041;white-space:nowrap">✓ 所有中</span>':''}</h4>
 <p>GⅠ ${df134SaleG1Wins(h)}勝 ｜ 価格 ${money(df134SalePrice(h))} ｜ ${studs?'種牡馬':'繁殖牝馬'}</p>
 <div class="v41-sale-actions"><button type="button" class="breed-action" data-sale-buy="${h.id}" ${state.walletCash>=df134SalePrice(h)&&!isOwnedBreeder(h)?'':'disabled'}>${isOwnedBreeder(h)?'購入済み':state.walletCash<df134SalePrice(h)?'資金不足':'購入する'}</button>
 ${isOwnedBreeder(h)?'':`<button type="button" class="breed-action df61-buy-pair" data-df61-buy-pair="${htmlEscape(h.id)}">2頭買う</button>`}
 </div>
 </section>`).join('')}</div>`;
 into.querySelectorAll('[data-sale-buy]').forEach(bt=>bt.addEventListener('click',()=>showSalePurchaseConfirm(bt.dataset.saleBuy)));

}
function attemptSalePurchase(id,replaceId=''){
 const h=df41SaleCandidate(id),b=state.breeding;
 if(!h){toast('購入対象を確認できません');return;}
 if(state.walletCash<df134SalePrice(h)){toast('購入資金が足りません');return;}
 const startYear=breedingStartYear();
 if(h.sex==='牝'){
  b.mare={id,startYear};
 }else{
  if(b.stallions.length>=5){
   if(!replaceId||!b.stallions.some(x=>x.id===replaceId)){
    toast('交換する種牡馬を選択してください');return;
   }
   b.stallions=b.stallions.filter(x=>x.id!==replaceId);
  }
  b.stallions.push({id,startYear});b.selectedSire=id;
 }
 state.walletCash-=df134SalePrice(h);
 change('sale-purchase');renderBreedingScreen(breedTab);
 toast(`${h.name}を購入しました（残り5年）`);
}
// Ver.176: shared success presentation for normal, homebred and legacy mating routes.
let df176MatingSuccessTimer=null;
function df176ShowMatingSuccess(){
 try{
  let layer=document.getElementById('df176MatingSuccess');
  if(!layer){
   layer=document.createElement('div');layer.id='df176MatingSuccess';
   layer.setAttribute('role','status');layer.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
   layer.innerHTML='<div class="df176-mating-panel"><div class="df176-mating-sparkles" aria-hidden="true">✨ ✦ ✨</div><strong class="df176-mating-title">種付けしました！</strong><div class="df176-mating-bottom" aria-hidden="true">✦ ✨ ✦</div></div>';
   document.body.appendChild(layer);
  }
  clearTimeout(df176MatingSuccessTimer);
  layer.classList.remove('df176-show');
  void layer.offsetWidth; // Restart the celebratory entrance if a second mating succeeds.
  layer.classList.add('df176-show');
  df176MatingSuccessTimer=setTimeout(()=>layer.classList.remove('df176-show'),2900);
 }catch(err){console.warn('種付け完了表示を作成できません',err);}
}

function commitBreeding(sireOverride,damOverride){
 const b=state.breeding;
  const sire=horseById(typeof sireOverride==='string'?sireOverride:b.selectedSire)||horseById(b.stallions[0]?.id);
  const mare=horseById(typeof damOverride==='string'?damOverride:b.mare?.id);
  const isHomebredPair=!!(sire?.customBred||mare?.customBred);
  if(!sire||!mare||sire.sex!=='牡'||mare.sex!=='牝')return false;
  if(state.calendarMonth!==4||b.bredYears.includes(state.calendarYear)||activePregnancy())return false;
 if(state.horses.length+state.pregnancies.length>=5){toast('所有馬は最大5頭です。引退後に種付けできます');return false;}
 if(!df135CanUseBreeder(sire)||!df135CanUseBreeder(mare)){toast('自家生産馬の種付けは牡馬・牝馬とも累計10回までです');return;}
 const fee=df135BreedingTotal(sire,mare);
 if(state.walletCash<fee){toast('種付け資金が不足しています');return;}
  const honors=df39CommonHonors(sire,mare).map(id=>`${DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id]}配合成立！`);
 if(!confirm(`${sire.name} × ${mare.name}\n${honors.length?honors.join('\n')+'\n':''}種付け料：無料\n種付けしますか？${isHomebredPair?'':'（年1回）'}`))return false;
 // Re-check, then compute the hidden foal before charging or saving this mating.
 if(state.walletCash<fee||!df135CanUseBreeder(sire)||!df135CanUseBreeder(mare))return;
 const birthYear=state.calendarMonth<3?state.calendarYear:state.calendarYear+1;
 const nextBirthCount=state.breeding.birthCount+1;
 // Ver.164: draw all inherited stats, health, growth, sex and distance just once.
 let frozenFoal;
 try{frozenFoal=ensurePointSets(normalizeHorse(
   df164CreateFoal(sire,mare,birthYear,nextBirthCount),state.horses.length));}
 catch(err){console.error('仔馬の能力確定に失敗',err);toast('種付けの能力計算に失敗しました。もう一度お試しください');return false;}
 state.walletCash-=fee;
 if(sire.customBred)sire.breedUses=df135BreederUsed(sire)+1;
 if(mare.customBred)mare.breedUses=df135BreederUsed(mare)+1;
 b.bredYears.push(state.calendarYear);
 state.breeding.birthCount=nextBirthCount;
 state.pregnancies.push({birthYear,birthMonth:3,sireId:sire.id,damId:mare.id,frozenFoal,pedigreeRuleVersion:33,visibleInbreedCrosses:frozenFoal.visibleInbreedCrosses});
  change('breed-success');renderBreedingScreen('dfNewSale');toast(`種付け完了！${birthYear}年目3月に出産予定`);
  df176ShowMatingSuccess();
  return true;
}
function inheritCoat(sire,mare){
 const coat=DF_V19_COATS;
 const coatLookup={'キングカメハメハ':'鹿毛','シーザリオ':'青毛','シンボリクリスエス':'黒鹿毛','アドマイヤグルーヴ':'鹿毛','ディープインパクト':'鹿毛','ロードカナロア':'鹿毛'};
 const candidates=[coatLookup[sire?.real],coatLookup[mare?.real]].filter(Boolean);
 return candidates.length&&Math.random()<.65?candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)]:coat[Math.floor(Math.random()*coat.length)];
}

/* 血統・能力計算を変更しない独立した仔馬誕生表示 */
const foalEventQueue=[];
const FOAL_EVENT_IMAGES=["data:image/webp;base64,","data:image/webp;base64,","data:image/webp;base64,"];
function foalEventArtFor(coat){
 const c=String(coat||'');
 return FOAL_EVENT_IMAGES[/芦|白|粕/.test(c)?1:/月|河原|パロミノ|金|クリーム/.test(c)?2:0];
}
function renderFoalEventArt(h){
 const price=window.DFSharedRules.foalSalePrice(h);
 $('foalBirthSalePrice').textContent=price===null?'査定できません':`${money(price)}円`;
 $('foalBirthSell').disabled=price===null;
 $('foalBirthPicture').src=foalEventArtFor(h.coatType);
 $('foalBirthDetails').textContent=`${h.sex||'仔馬'} ・ ${h.coatType||'鹿毛'}　♡ ようこそ牧場へ ♡`;
 $('foalBirthName').value='';
 $('foalBirthError').textContent='※名前欄をタップして入力（カタカナ9文字以内）';
 const hearts=$('foalBirthHearts');hearts.replaceChildren();
 for(let i=0;i<27;i++){
  const sp=document.createElement('span');sp.textContent=['💗','💖','💕','♥','💓'][i%5];
  sp.style.setProperty('--x',`${3+(i*39%93)}%`);
  sp.style.setProperty('--s',`${15+(i*7%20)}px`);
  sp.style.setProperty('--dur',`${2.7+(i%5)*.37}s`);
  sp.style.setProperty('--delay',`${(i%9)*-.38}s`);
  sp.style.setProperty('--drift',`${(i*17%80)-40}px`);
  sp.style.setProperty('--y',`${8+(i*23%85)}%`);
  hearts.append(sp);
 }
 $('foalBirthEvent').hidden=false;
}

function showNextFoalBirth(){
 const h=foalEventQueue.map(id=>state.horses.find(x=>x.id===id)).find(x=>x&&!x.named);
 if(!h){foalEventQueue.length=0;$('foalBirthEvent').hidden=true;return;}
 if(window.df43FoalReveal)window.df43FoalReveal(()=>renderFoalEventArt(h));
 else renderFoalEventArt(h);
}
function sellNewbornFoal(){
 const id=foalEventQueue[0],h=state.horses.find(x=>x.id===id&&!x.named);
 if(!h){foalEventQueue.shift();showNextFoalBirth();return;}
 const price=window.DFSharedRules.foalSalePrice(h);
 if(price===null){$('foalBirthError').textContent='売却価格を算定できません。';return;}
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(state.walletCash+price)||state.walletCash+price>10000000000000){
  $('foalBirthError').textContent='所持金の保存上限を超えるため売却できません。';return;
 }
 if(!confirm(`この仔馬を${money(price)}円で売却しますか？\n売却した仔馬は育成できません。`))return;
 // The newborn has never been named/imported into the parent race roster.
 // Remove only this foal, keep all pedigrees, parents, and other owned horses untouched.
 state.horses.splice(state.horses.indexOf(h),1);
 if(state.barnHorseId===id)state.barnHorseId=state.horses[0]?.id||'';
 state.walletCash+=price;
 change('sell-newborn-foal');
 foalEventQueue.shift();showNextFoalBirth();
}
function confirmFoalBirthName(){
 const id=foalEventQueue[0],h=state.horses.find(x=>x.id===id&&!x.named);
 if(!h){foalEventQueue.shift();showNextFoalBirth();return;}
 const input=$('foalBirthName');
 const name=input.value.trim();
 if(!name){$('foalBirthError').textContent='名前を入力してください。';return;}
 if([...name].length>9){$('foalBirthError').textContent='名前はカタカナ9文字以内で入力してください。';return;}
 if(!katakanaOnly(name)){$('foalBirthError').textContent='名前はカタカナのみで入力してください。';return;}
 if(state.namedHorseNames.includes(name)||state.horses.some(x=>x!==h&&x.named&&x.name===name)){
  $('foalBirthError').textContent='この馬名はすでに使用されています。別の名前を入力してください。';return;
 }
 h.name=name;h.named=true;state.namedHorseNames.push(name);state.barnHorseId=id;
 change('name-new-foal');emit('foal-named',{horseId:id,name});
 foalEventQueue.shift();showNextFoalBirth();
}
// Distance aptitude is determined once, on birth, from both actual parents.
// Do not change historic registered horses or silently retrofit previously born foals.
function parentDistanceAptitude(parent){
 if(!parent)return null;
 if(Number.isFinite(parent.aptMin)&&Number.isFinite(parent.aptMax))
   return [parent.aptMin,parent.aptMax];
 const d=FARM_DISPLAY_DISTANCE[parent.real||''];
 return Array.isArray(d)&&d.length===2&&d.every(Number.isFinite)?d:null;
}
function inheritFoalDistance(sire,mare){
 const sp=parentDistanceAptitude(sire),mp=parentDistanceAptitude(mare);
 if(!sp&&!mp)return null;
 // If one parent has no recorded aptitude, inherit the known parent's range.
 const sireApt=sp||mp, mareApt=mp||sp;
 // Parent midpoint/width inheritance plus small birth-time variation (100m units).
 const min=Math.round((sireApt[0]+mareApt[0])/200)*100;
 const max=Math.round((sireApt[1]+mareApt[1])/200)*100;
 const variation=Math.floor(Math.random()*5)-2;
 const shift=variation*100;
 const lo=Math.max(1000,Math.min(3600,min+shift));
 const hi=Math.max(lo+200,Math.min(4000,max+shift));
 return [lo,hi];
}

// Ver.10: prepare parental racing profiles before the farm birth is recorded.
function dfV10ParentRaceProfile(parent){
  if(parent?.customBred){
    const stat=k=>Number(parent.baseMaximum?.[k]||0)+Number(parent.uniquePts?.[k]||0);
    return {surface:parent.surface,tactic:parent.tactic,bestDistance:parent.bestDistance,
      goingAptitude:clone(parent.goingAptitude||{}),temperament:parent.temperament,
      health:parent.health,constitution:parent.constitution,recovery:parent.recovery,
      formStability:parent.formStability,sp:stat('sp'),sta:stat('sta')};
  }
  try{
  const get=window.parent?.DFGetBreedingParent;
  if(typeof get==='function'){
   const actual=get(parent.real);
   if(actual)return actual;
  }
 }catch(_){ /* The farm remains playable without a parent race window. */ }
 const value=window.DFSharedRules.breedingParentPoints(parent.real,parent.id);
 const stat=key=>Number(value.baseMaximum?.[key]||80)+Number(value.uniquePts?.[key]||0);
 const hash=key=>hashFarm('df-v10-parent|'+String(parent.real||parent.id)+'|'+key);
 const dist=parentDistanceAptitude(parent)||[600,3600];
 return {surface:'芝',tactic:['逃げ','先行','差し','追込'][hash('tactic')%4],
  bestDistance:Math.round(((dist[0]+dist[1])/2)/200)*200,
  goingAptitude:Object.fromEntries(['良','稍重','重','不良'].map(k=>[k,90+hash(k)%21])),
  temperament:60+hash('temperament')%36,health:60+hash('health')%36,
  constitution:60+hash('constitution')%36,recovery:60+hash('recovery')%36,
  formStability:60+hash('formStability')%36,sp:stat('sp'),sta:stat('sta')};
}
// Breeding record bonus: independently normalized G1 wins and prize share equal weight.
// Prize must be stored actual earnings, never sale price or fabricated catalog estimates.
function df144ParentRecordScore(parent){
 const g1=parent?.customBred?Number(parent.g1Wins):df134SaleG1Wins(parent);
 const prize=Number(parent?.earnedPrize??parent?.prize??0);
 const g1Score=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(g1)?g1:0)/10);
 const prizeScore=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(prize)?prize:0)/1000000000);
 return .5*g1Score+.5*prizeScore;
}
function df144ApplyBreedingRecord(newborn,sire,dam){
 const total=(df144ParentRecordScore(sire)+df144ParentRecordScore(dam))/2;
 const bonus=Math.round(6*total);
 if(!bonus)return 0;
 for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS){
  const ceiling=Number(newborn.baseMaximum[key])||0;
  const add=Math.max(0,Math.min(400-ceiling,bonus));
  newborn.baseMaximum[key]=ceiling+add;
  newborn.baseInitial[key]=Math.min(newborn.baseMaximum[key],(Number(newborn.baseInitial[key])||0)+Math.round(add*.6));
 }
 return bonus;
}
// Ver.148: one health draw per distinct common ancestor, strongest cross only.
// Multiple distinct ancestors add up to a maximum 25Pt deduction at birth.
// All calculations use the same pedigree matches as the existing pairing UI.
// Ver.76: shared inbreeding model for diagnosis, forecasts and conception.
// The numbers are original game balancing, not real-world genetic probabilities.
function df76InbreedProfile(crosses){
 const p=window.DFBreedingEffects.profile(crosses);
 return {...p,label:!p.valid?'インブリードなし':`${p.tier}インブリード（血量目安${p.intensity.toFixed(2)}%${p.special34?'・3×4を含む':''}）`};
}
function df148InbreedHealthPenalty(crosses,random=Math.random){
 return window.DFBreedingEffects.healthLoss(df76InbreedProfile(crosses),random);
}
function df76InbreedTemperPenalty(profile,random=Math.random){
 return window.DFBreedingEffects.temperLoss(profile,random);
}
function df76ApplyInbreedAbility(newborn,profile){
 window.DFBreedingEffects.awardInbreed(newborn,profile,FARM_STAT_KEYS);
}
// Ver.164: this is the original foal-generation calculation, now performed at mating.
// Legacy pregnancies still call this once at birth because no saved foal existed.
// Generation 1 starts with a foal of two foundation breeders.
// The greater parental generation determines the next foal's generation.
function dfV17Generation(parent){
 return parent?.customBred?Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(parent.breedingGeneration)||1)):0;
}
function dfV17FillyProbability(generation){
 return generation>=5?.01:generation===4?.05:generation===3?.45:.50;
}
function df164CreateFoal(sire,mare,birthYear,birthCount){
 const famous=!!famousPair(sire.real,mare.real);
 const breedingGeneration=1+Math.max(dfV17Generation(sire),dfV17Generation(mare));
 const id=`farm_foal_${birthYear}_${birthCount}`;
 const inheritedDistance=inheritFoalDistance(sire,mare);
  // Ver.91: check the actual pairing BEFORE creating the foal's point sets.
  // The existing parent, ancestry, race-trait and save mechanisms are kept.
  const otherTraits=window.DFSharedRules.inheritRaceTraits(
    dfV10ParentRaceProfile(sire),dfV10ParentRaceProfile(mare),inheritedDistance);
 const df75BirthNicks=df75NicksDetails(sire.real,mare.real);
 const df40NickBonus=df75BirthNicks.count>0;
  // V32: one immutable set of VISIBLE ancestors for every inbreeding effect at conception.
  const df148BirthCrosses=dfV36Crosses(sire,mare);
 const df76CrossProfile=df76InbreedProfile(df148BirthCrosses);
 const df148HealthLoss=df148InbreedHealthPenalty(df148BirthCrosses);
 const df76TemperLoss=df76InbreedTemperPenalty(df76CrossProfile);
 const {thin,close}=dfVisiblePairIntensity(sire,mare,df148BirthCrosses);
 // Actual pedigree combinations have four times the weight of randomness.
 // The exceptional 3x4 ancestor and common awards are rare, deterministic
 // bonuses; their historical game effects below remain unchanged.
 const dfV91Pair={nick:df40NickBonus,thin,close,famous,
   special:!!dfV36SpecialCross(sire,mare,df148BirthCrosses),honors:df39CommonHonors(sire,mare).length};
 const pointSets=window.DFSharedRules.balancedPointSets(
   parentBreedingPointSets(sire),parentBreedingPointSets(mare),dfV91Pair);
 const newborn={id,name:`仔馬${birthCount}`,named:false,breedingGeneration,sex:Math.random()<dfV17FillyProbability(breedingGeneration)?'牝':'牡',coatType:inheritCoat(sire,mare),growth:['早熟','普通','晩成','持続'][Math.floor(Math.random()*4)],birthGameYear:birthYear,form:75,fatigue:0,
   sire:sire.customBred?sire.name:sire.real,dam:mare.customBred?mare.name:mare.real,
   sireBreederId:sire.real,damBreederId:mare.real,
   ...(inheritedDistance?{aptMin:inheritedDistance[0],aptMax:inheritedDistance[1]}:{}),...otherTraits,...pointSets};
  // Health is fixed at conception, after both parents' inherited-health draw.
  // No old/active horse or existing racing stat is recalculated.
  newborn.inbreedHealthLoss=df148HealthLoss;
  newborn.health=Math.max(35,Math.min(100,Math.round(Number(newborn.health)||75)-df148HealthLoss));
  newborn.temperament=Math.max(35,Math.min(100,Math.round(Number(newborn.temperament)||75)-df76TemperLoss));
  newborn.inbreedTemperLoss=df76TemperLoss;
  // Record strength is evaluated once at mating (G1 wins 50%, earned prize 50%).
  df144ApplyBreedingRecord(newborn,sire,mare);
 // Apply the existing pedigree-related bonuses after inheriting full unique Pt.
 if(close)newborn.baseMaximum.stability=Math.max(35,newborn.baseMaximum.stability-10);
 df76ApplyInbreedAbility(newborn,df76CrossProfile);
 const df85AncestorEffects=window.DFBreedingEffects.awardAncestorEffects(newborn,df148BirthCrosses,FARM_STAT_KEYS);
 // The special 3x4 cross affects only newly born foals. The original ancestor
 // record (innate abilities + final G1 tally) is immutable after promotion.
 dfV36ApplySpecialBonus(newborn,sire,mare,df148BirthCrosses);
 // Keep 100% of the inherited unique Pt separate from growth-based basic Pt.
 // Race snapshots alone combine the two values; never merge birth values.
 for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS)newborn.uniquePts[key]=Math.round(newborn.uniquePts[key]);
 // Ver.40: apply fixed ordinary awards in full after inheritance.
 window.DFBreedingEffects.awardNick(newborn,df75BirthNicks,FARM_STAT_KEYS);
 if(thin)for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS)newborn.uniquePts[key]+=2;
  // One-time mating assignment after all inheritance and cross adjustments.
 df39ApplyHonorBaseBonus(newborn,sire,mare);
  // Ver.142: record the actual effects triggered at THIS birth; not estimates
  // reconstructed years later from mutable parents or racing achievements.
  const effects=[];
  if(newborn.inbreedBonus?.pattern)effects.push(`${newborn.inbreedBonus.ancestorName||'自家生産馬'}の${newborn.inbreedBonus.pattern}：成長能力に好影響`);
  const shownCrosses=df148BirthCrosses.flatMap(c=>c.positions.filter(([a,b])=>a<=5&&b<=5).slice(0,1).map(([a,b])=>`${dfV36CrossName(c)}の${a}×${b}`)).slice(0,4);
  if(shownCrosses.length)effects.unshift('インブリード：'+shownCrosses.join('、')+'／'+df76CrossProfile.label);
  else effects.unshift('インブリード：なし');
  for(const entry of df85AncestorEffects.entries)effects.push('祖先固有：'+(df148BirthCrosses.find(c=>c.ancestor===entry.ancestor)?.custom?.name||df53KanaAlias(entry.ancestor))+'（'+entry.traits.map(k=>FARM_STAT_NAMES[k]).join('・')+'）');
  if(close)effects.push('近い血統の重なり：安定性に注意');
   if(thin)effects.push('遠い世代のインブリード：血統効果あり');
   if(df148BirthCrosses.length){
    effects.push(`インブリードによる基本能力上限：各+${df76CrossProfile.bonus}Pt（種付け時確定）`);
    effects.push(`インブリードによる健康への影響：-${df148HealthLoss}Pt（種付け時確定）`);
    effects.push(`インブリードによる気性への影響：-${df76TemperLoss}Pt（種付け時確定）`);
   }
   effects.push(df40NickBonus?`ニックス：${df75BirthNicks.label}（${df75BirthNicks.count}系統・固有Pt各+${df75BirthNicks.uniqueGain}・出生時に一度だけ反映）`:'ニックス：なし');
  for(const id of df39CommonHonors(sire,mare))effects.push(`${DF39_HONOR_PAIR_NAMES[id]}配合成立！：戦歴による継承効果`);
  newborn.inbreedAncestorTraits=window.DFBreedingEffects.homebredTraits(newborn);
 newborn.visibleInbreedCrosses=df148BirthCrosses.map(c=>({ancestor:c.ancestor,positions:c.positions.map(p=>[...p])}));
 newborn.pedigreeRuleVersion=33;
 newborn.birthPairEffects=effects;
  newborn.birthSalePrice=window.DFSharedRules.foalSalePrice(newborn);
  newborn.luck=farmLuckScore(newborn,(Math.random()-.5)*20);
 newborn.potential=Math.round(FARM_STAT_KEYS.reduce((sum,k)=>sum+Number(newborn.baseMaximum[k]||0)+Number(newborn.uniquePts[k]||0),0)/FARM_STAT_KEYS.length);
 newborn.overallRank=newborn.potential>=120?'S':newborn.potential>=100?'A':newborn.potential>=80?'B':'C';
 newborn.g1Wins=0;
 newborn.v10RacingTraitsStored=true;
 return newborn;
}
function produceFoal(p){
 if(state.horses.length>=5)return null; // Preserve an undelivered pregnancy.
 const sire=horseById(p.sireId),mare=horseById(p.damId);
 // Frozen foals can be delivered even if a sale has removed the old parents.
 if(!p.frozenFoal&&(!sire||!mare))return null;
 let newborn;
 if(p.frozenFoal){
  newborn=clone(p.frozenFoal); // No birth-time RNG or fresh parental calculation.
 }else{
  // Compatibility: pregnancies conceived on Ver.163 or earlier.
  state.breeding.birthCount++;
  newborn=df164CreateFoal(sire,mare,state.calendarYear,state.breeding.birthCount);
 }
 const id=newborn.id;
 state.horses.push(ensurePointSets(normalizeHorse(newborn,state.horses.length)));
 state.barnHorseId=id;
 emit('foal-born',{horseId:id,sire:p.frozenFoal?.sireBreederId||sire?.real,
   dam:p.frozenFoal?.damBreederId||mare?.real,
   historic:!!famousPair(p.frozenFoal?.sireBreederId||sire?.real,
    p.frozenFoal?.damBreederId||mare?.real)});
 return id;
}
function advanceBreedingCalendar(){
 dropExpiredBreedingHorses();
 const due=state.pregnancies.filter(p=>p.sireId&&p.damId&&breedMonthsUntil(p)<=0);
 const delivered=[];
 for(const p of due){const id=produceFoal(p);if(id){foalEventQueue.push(id);delivered.push(p);}}
 if(delivered.length){state.pregnancies=state.pregnancies.filter(p=>!delivered.includes(p));change('foal-born');toast('🐣 仔馬が誕生しました！')}
 if(due.length>delivered.length)toast('所有馬5頭のため出産待ちです。引退後の月送りで出産します');
}

function dfFormatAmount(yen){
 const amount=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(yen)||0));
 const billion=Math.floor(amount/100000000);
 const rem=amount%100000000;
 const fraction=rem/10000;
 const formatMan=x=>Number(x.toFixed(4)).toString();
 return billion?`${billion}億${rem?formatMan(fraction)+'万':''}`:`${formatMan(amount/10000)}万`;
}
function money(n){return dfFormatAmount(n);}
function funds(n){return dfFormatAmount(Math.floor(Math.max(0,Number(n)||0)/10000)*10000);}

let currentGesture='neck',poseFrom=performance.now(),poseUntil=0,nextGestureAt=0,lastGestureHorse='';
let motionPaused=false;
function chooseGesture(force=false,key=null){
 const h=selected();if(!h)return;
 if(force)motionPaused=false;
 const now=performance.now();
 if(!force&&now<nextGestureAt)return;
 let choices=['blink','ear','tail','neck','shake','graze','yawn'];
 if(h.fatigue>=45) choices.push('yawn','yawn','tail');
 if(h.health<60) choices.push('graze','graze');
 if(h.form>=75) choices.push('ear','neck');
 const selectedKey=key||choices[Math.floor(Math.random()*choices.length)];
 currentGesture=selectedKey;poseFrom=now;poseUntil=now+FARM_GESTURES[selectedKey].duration;
 nextGestureAt=now+(force?7700:5600+Math.random()*5000);
 emit('gesture',{horseId:h.id,gesture:selectedKey});
}

const HORSE_ASSET_FAMILIES=[
  {side:'data:image/webp;base64,',front:'data:image/webp;base64,'},
  {side:'data:image/webp;base64,',front:'data:image/webp;base64,'},
  {side:'data:image/webp;base64,',front:'data:image/webp;base64,'}

/* Ver.44: added test horses receive varied coat colors rather than fixed 栗毛. */
const HORSE_COAT_POOL=['栗毛','栃栗毛','鹿毛','黒鹿毛','青鹿毛','青毛','芦毛','白毛','月毛','河原毛','尾花栗毛'];

const COAT_FAMILY_RULES=[
  {family:'gray', words:['芦毛','白毛','粕毛','葦毛','灰毛','ダップルグレー','グレー','白']},
  {family:'gold', words:['月毛','河原毛','パロミノ','金','クリーム','尾花栗毛']},
  {family:'chestnut', words:['栃栗毛','栗毛','鹿毛','黒鹿毛','青鹿毛','青毛','赤鹿毛','鹿','栗']}
];
function normalizeCoatType(value){
  return String(value||'').trim();
}
function coatFamilyFor(coatType){
  const text = normalizeCoatType(coatType);
  for(const rule of COAT_FAMILY_RULES){
    if(rule.words.some(word=>text.includes(word)))return rule.family;
  }
  return 'chestnut';
}
function assetFamilyIndexForHorse(horse){
  const family=coatFamilyFor(horse&&horse.coatType);
  if(family==='gray')return 1;
  if(family==='gold')return 2;
  return 0;
}

function selectedIndex(){
  return Math.max(0,state.horses.findIndex(h=>h.id===state.barnHorseId));
}
function currentView(){
  return state.barnView==='front'?'front':'side';
}
function horseAssetByFamily(familyIndex,view){
  return HORSE_ASSET_FAMILIES[familyIndex % HORSE_ASSET_FAMILIES.length][view==='front'?'front':'side'];
}
function updateHorseSprite(){
  const sprite=$('horseCanvas');
  const h=selected();
  if(!sprite)return;
  if(!h){sprite.hidden=true;return;}
  const familyIndex=assetFamilyIndexForHorse(h);
  const view=currentView();
  const stage=$('horseStage');if(stage)stage.dataset.view=view;
  sprite.hidden=false;
  const asset=horseAssetByFamily(familyIndex,view);
  if(window.FarmGestureArt)window.FarmGestureArt.load(asset,h.coatType);

  sprite.setAttribute('aria-label',`${h.name}の${view==='front'?'正面':'横向き'}イラスト`);
}
function initPanorama(){ updateHorseSprite(); }
function selectHorseNow(id){
 if(state.barnHorseId===id)return;
 state.barnHorseId=id;emit('select-horse',{horseId:id});change('select-horse');
}
function chooseHorse(id){
 const idx=state.horses.findIndex(h=>h.id===id);
 if(idx<0)return;
 selectHorseNow(id);
 state.barnView='side';
 render();
}
function moveHorse(dir){
 const n=state.horses.length;if(n<2)return;
 const i=selectedIndex();
 const next=i+dir;
 if(next<0 || next>=n)return;
 chooseHorse(state.horses[next].id);
}
function toggleHorseView(){
 const h=selected();if(!h)return;
 state.barnView=currentView()==='side'?'front':'side';
 updateHorseSprite();
  // Switching view needs no speech bubble across the horse's face.
 change('toggle-horse-view');
}
function nextMonth(){
 state.calendarMonth++;
 if(state.calendarMonth>12){state.calendarMonth=1;state.calendarYear++;}
 const feePeriod=`${state.calendarYear}-${state.calendarMonth}`;
 let operatingFee=0;
 if(state.lastOperatingFeeMonth!==feePeriod){
  const balance=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.walletCash)||0));
  operatingFee=Math.floor(balance/100);
  state.walletCash=balance-operatingFee;
  state.lastOperatingFeeMonth=feePeriod;
 }
 for(const h of state.horses){h.fatigue=Math.max(0,h.fatigue-2);}
 advanceBreedingCalendar();
 const v43AlertKinds=[];
 const yr=state.calendarYear, mo=state.calendarMonth;
 const plans=[];
 if(mo===12)plans.push('sale');
 if(mo===4)plans.push('breed');
 if(mo===6&&state.horses.some(h=>h.named!==false&&yr-Number(h.birthGameYear)===2))plans.push('debut');
 if(!Array.isArray(state.v43SeasonNotices))state.v43SeasonNotices=[];
 for(const kind of plans){const id=`${yr}-${mo}-${kind}`;if(!state.v43SeasonNotices.includes(id)){state.v43SeasonNotices.push(id);v43AlertKinds.push(kind);}}
 state.v43SeasonNotices=state.v43SeasonNotices.slice(-100);
 emit('next-month',{year:state.calendarYear,month:state.calendarMonth,operatingFee});
 change('next-month');
 if(v43AlertKinds.length)window.df43SeasonalAnnounce?.(v43AlertKinds);
  // The horse's bubble reports the deduction; secretary's normal seasonal announcement is unaffected.
 if(breedView==='home')say('運営費用引かれました');
 refreshBreedHomeUI();
 if(foalEventQueue.length)showNextFoalBirth();
}

  const wasCalendar=!modal.hidden&&$('dialogTitle').textContent==='📅 牧場カレンダー';
  modal.hidden=true;
  if(wasCalendar)document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('df-v20-calendar-closed'));
}

function actionButton(text,cb){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=text;b.addEventListener('click',cb);$('dialogActions').append(b);return b;}
function addInput(label,value,onSave){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='farm-field';const lbl=document.createElement('label');lbl.textContent=label;const input=document.createElement('input');input.type='text';input.maxLength=30;input.value=value;row.append(lbl,input);$('dialogContent').append(row);actionButton('保存する',()=>{onSave(input.value.trim());closeModal();});}
// Ver.45: two distinct actions: return to the 3 demo horses, or clear ALL horses.
// A blank saved state is written after removal so a subsequent reload cannot
// recreate the initial sample horses or re-import the legacy v1 data.
function resetFarmStorage(makeEmpty){
  const blank=normalizeState({...freshDemo(),horses:[],barnHorseId:'',pregnancies:[]});
  const next=makeEmpty?blank:normalizeState(freshDemo());
  next.barnView='side';
  let stored=false;
  try{
    localStorage.removeItem(STORE_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(OLD_STORE_KEY);
    localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY,JSON.stringify(next));
    const readBack=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY));
    stored=Array.isArray(readBack?.horses)&&readBack.horses.length===next.horses.length;
  }catch(_){stored=false;}
  state=next;
  // Do not leave a previous horse frame or speech bubble on the empty home.
  $('barnBubble').classList.remove('visible');
  const sprite=$('horseCanvas');if(sprite&&makeEmpty){
    const ctx=sprite.getContext('2d');if(ctx)ctx.clearRect(0,0,sprite.width,sprite.height);
  }
  change(makeEmpty?'erase-farm-save':'reset-demo');
  requestAnimationFrame(initPanorama);
  closeModal();
  if(stored){toast(makeEmpty?'牧場のセーブデータを消去しました（所有馬0頭）':'初期状態の3頭に戻しました');}
  else{
    alert('画面上のデータは初期化しましたが、この開き方ではスマホの保存領域へ書き込めません。アプリを開き直すと戻る可能性があります。');
  }
}
function confirmFarmReset(makeEmpty){
  $('dialogContent').replaceChildren();$('dialogActions').replaceChildren();
  $('dialogTitle').textContent=makeEmpty?'保存データを全消去':'初期状態に戻す';
  if(makeEmpty){
    addP('この牧場ホームだけの所有馬・能力ポイント・月日のセーブを消します。所有馬は0頭になります。');
    addP('元には戻せません。競馬ゲーム本体やほかのアプリのデータは対象外です。','farm-hint');
  }else{
    addP('この牧場ホームの追加馬の記録をリセットし、最初の3頭に戻します。');
  }
  actionButton(makeEmpty?'完全に消去する':'3頭の初期状態に戻す',()=>resetFarmStorage(makeEmpty));
  actionButton('キャンセル',()=>openSection('management'));
}

function farmHorseDistanceText(h){
 if(Number.isFinite(h.aptMin)&&Number.isFinite(h.aptMax))return `${h.aptMin}～${h.aptMax}m`;
 if(String(h.id||'').startsWith('farm_foal_'))return '未設定';
 const d=FARM_DISPLAY_DISTANCE[h.real||''];
 if(d)return `${d[0]}～${d[1]}m`;
 return '未設定';
}

function bind(){
  $('foalBirthConfirm').addEventListener('click',confirmFoalBirthName);
  $('foalBirthSell').addEventListener('click',sellNewbornFoal);
  const foalNameInput=$('foalBirthName');
  let foalNameComposing=false;
  const finishFoalNameInput=()=>{
   const raw=foalNameInput.value;
   const katakana=raw.normalize('NFKC').replace(/[ぁ-ゖ]/g,ch=>String.fromCharCode(ch.charCodeAt(0)+96));
   const cleaned=[...katakana].filter(ch=>katakanaOnly(ch)).slice(0,9).join('');
   if(raw!==cleaned)foalNameInput.value=cleaned;
   $('foalBirthError').textContent='※名前はカタカナ9文字以内です';
  };
  foalNameInput.addEventListener('compositionstart',()=>{foalNameComposing=true;});
  foalNameInput.addEventListener('compositionend',()=>{foalNameComposing=false;finishFoalNameInput();});
  foalNameInput.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(!foalNameComposing&&!e.isComposing)finishFoalNameInput();});
  foalNameInput.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(foalNameComposing||e.isComposing||e.keyCode===229)return;if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();confirmFoalBirthName();}});
  $('horseStage').addEventListener('click',toggleHorseView);
  $('horseStage').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggleHorseView();}});
  $('barnPrev').addEventListener('click',()=>moveHorse(-1));$('barnNext').addEventListener('click',()=>moveHorse(1));
  $('barnNextMonth').addEventListener('click',nextMonth);
  const actions={barnBtnCalendar:'calendar',barnHomeBtn:'home',barnStableBtn:'stable',barnBreedBtn:'breed',barnAbilities:'abilities',barnToRace:'race',barnMenuBtn:'management'};
  for(const [id,type] of Object.entries(actions))$(id).addEventListener('click',()=>openSection(type));
  $('farmMareSaleBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>openBreedingPage('dfNewSale'));

   $('dialogClose').addEventListener('click',closeModal);
  modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)closeModal();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&!modal.hidden)closeModal();});
}
function applyClassicReward(entry){
  if(!entry||typeof entry!=='object'||!entry.raceId)return false;
  const mapping={'ディープインパクト':'sp','イクイノックス':'sta','アーモンドアイ':'kick'};
  const key=mapping[entry.champion];if(!key)return false;
  const h=state.horses.find(x=>x.id===entry.horseId);if(!h)return false;
  ensurePointSets(h);
  const claim=String(entry.raceId).slice(0,120)+'|'+entry.champion;
  if(h.classicClaims[claim])return false;
  const rank=Number(entry.placing),margin=Number(entry.margin);
  const pts=rank===1?3:(rank===2&&Number.isFinite(margin)&&margin>=0&&margin<=2?1:0);
  if(pts<=0)return false;
  for(const stat of FARM_STAT_KEYS)addUniqueBonus(h,stat,pts,'クラシック強豪馬');
  h.classicClaims[claim]=pts;
  change('classic-unique-reward');
  return true;
}
function df137RetireOwnedHorse(id,career){
 const h=state.horses.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!h)return {ok:false};
 const wins=Math.max(0,Number(h.g1Wins)||0,Number(career?.fullRaceHorse?.g1Wins)||0);
 let b=state.breeding;
 if(wins>=3&&['牡','牝'].includes(h.sex)){
  const archived=clone(h);archived.g1Wins=wins;
  if(!Object.keys(archived.df37Titles||{}).length&&career?.fullRaceHorse?.df37Titles)
    archived.df37Titles=clone(career.fullRaceHorse.df37Titles);
  archived.racingWins=Number(career?.wins??career?.totalWins??h.totalWins)||0;
  archived.racingStarts=Number(career?.starts??career?.totalStarts??h.totalStarts)||0;
  archived.prize=Math.max(Number(archived.prize)||0,Number(career?.prize)||0);
   archived.racingCareer={starts:archived.racingStarts,wins:archived.racingWins,
     prize:archived.prize,monthlyHistory:clone(career?.monthlyHistory||career?.fullRaceHorse?.monthlyHistory||h.monthlyHistory||[])};
   const breeder=promotedBreederFromHorse(archived);
  breeder.breedUses=0;
  if(!b.customBreeders.some(x=>x.id===breeder.id))b.customBreeders.push(breeder);
 }
  for(const item of state.df153Items){if(item.holderType==='owner'&&item.holderId===String(h.id)){item.holderType='';item.holderId='';}}
  state.horses=state.horses.filter(x=>x.id!==h.id);
 if(state.barnHorseId===h.id)state.barnHorseId=state.horses[0]?.id||'';
 change('retire-owned-horse');
 return {ok:true,breeding:wins>=3&&['牡','牝'].includes(h.sex),wins};
}
function df137PairingData(){
 const custom=state.breeding.customBreeders.filter(x=>x.customBred);
 const purchased=[...state.breeding.stallions.map(x=>horseById(x.id)),state.breeding.mare?horseById(state.breeding.mare.id):null].filter(Boolean);
 const map=h=>{
   // Display-only breeding profile. Use the same breeding-point source as mating;
   // never fabricate a number or mutate the original horse/save data.
   const pts=h.customBred?{baseMaximum:h.baseMaximum||{},uniquePts:h.uniquePts||{}}:
     window.DFSharedRules.breedingParentPoints(h.real,h.id);
   const overview={};
   for(const key of ['sp','sta','kick','grit']){
     const base=pts.baseMaximum?.[key],unique=pts.uniquePts?.[key];
     overview[key]=Number.isFinite(Number(base))&&base!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(unique))&&unique!=null?
       Math.round(Number(base)+Number(unique)):null;
   }
   return {id:h.id,name:h.name,sex:h.sex,breedUses:df135BreederUsed(h),remaining:df135BreederRemaining(h),g1Wins:h.g1Wins,df37Titles:clone(h.df37Titles||{}),
     sire:h.sire||'',dam:h.dam||'',birthSalePrice:h.birthSalePrice,
     birthPairEffects:clone(h.birthPairEffects||[]),
     growth:h.growth||'',tactic:h.tactic||'',
     aptMin:h.aptMin??null,aptMax:h.aptMax??null,
     abilityOverview:overview,
     racingCareer:clone(h.racingCareer||{}),racingStarts:h.racingStarts,racingWins:h.racingWins,earnedPrize:h.earnedPrize};
 };
 return {custom:custom.map(map),purchased:purchased.map(map),sale:saleSeason()?[...monthlySaleList('stallion'),...monthlySaleList('mare')].map(map):[],season:saleSeason(),pregnancy:!!activePregnancy(),month:state.calendarMonth};
}
function df137PairingDiagnosis(sireId,mareId){
 const sire=horseById(sireId),mare=horseById(mareId);
 if(!sire||!mare||sire.sex!=='牡'||mare.sex!=='牝')return '';
 return df39PairingLabels(sire,mare)+salePairDiagnosis(sire,mare);
}

// Ver.153: inventory is stored in one authoritative farm save. Each item has one UID.
// Item types and drop conditions are data-driven; future items can be added here.
// Ver.172: consumables are available on G1 wins and non-G1 BLACK wins as specified below.
// Equipment: all three independent bonuses are determined at award time.
const DF160_GOLD_HOOF_KIND='gold_horseshoe';
const DF160_GOLD_HOOF_LIMIT=4;
function df160MakeGoldHorseshoe(){
 const roll=()=>1+Math.floor(Math.random()*5);
 return {uid:'df160-gold-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+(++df160ItemCounter).toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,11),
  kind:DF160_GOLD_HOOF_KIND,name:'金の蹄鉄',bonus:{sp:roll(),sta:roll(),form:roll()},holderType:'',holderId:''};
}
const DF160_CONSUMABLES=Object.freeze({
 stamina_drink:{name:'スタミナドリンク',description:'調子を30回復（上限100）'},
 tactic_ticket:{name:'脚質変更券',description:'次の1レースだけ脚質変更'}
});
const DF160_TACTICS=Object.freeze(['逃げ','先行','差し','追込']);
let df160ItemCounter=0;
function df160MakeConsumable(kind){
 const rule=DF160_CONSUMABLES[kind];if(!rule)return null;
 return {uid:'df160-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+(++df160ItemCounter).toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,11),
  kind,name:rule.name,bonus:{},holderType:'',holderId:''};
}
function df160UseConsumable(uid,horseId,tactic){
 const item=state.df153Items.find(x=>x.uid===uid);
 if(!item||item.holderType||!DF160_CONSUMABLES[item.kind])return {ok:false,message:'使用できるアイテムがありません。'};
 const horse=state.horses.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(horseId));
 if(!horse)return {ok:false,message:'現役所有馬を選んでください。'};
  if(horse.df173ConsumableUsed)return {ok:false,message:'この馬は生涯1個の消費アイテムを使用済みです。'};
 let message='';
 if(item.kind==='stamina_drink'){
  const before=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(horse.form)||0));
  if(before>=100)return {ok:false,message:'調子100の馬には使用できません。'};
  horse.form=Math.min(100,before+30);
  horse.df160DrinkStamp=state.calendarYear+'-'+state.calendarMonth;
  message=horse.name+'の調子が'+before+' → '+horse.form+'に回復しました。';
 }else{
  if(!DF160_TACTICS.includes(tactic))return {ok:false,message:'変更する脚質を選んでください。'};
  if(horse.df160PendingTactic)return {ok:false,message:'すでに次走用の脚質変更が予約されています。'};
  horse.df160PendingTactic=tactic;
  message=horse.name+'の次の1レースの脚質を「'+tactic+'」に予約しました。';
 }
 horse.df173ConsumableUsed=true;
  state.df153Items=state.df153Items.filter(x=>x.uid!==uid);
 change('df160-consumable-used');
 return {ok:true,message};
}
function df160FinishRaceConsumables(entries){
 if(!Array.isArray(entries)||!entries.length)return false;
 const raced=new Map(entries.filter(x=>x&&typeof x.id==='string').map(x=>[x.id.replace(/^farm-linked:/,''),x.tactic]));
 let used=false;
 for(const horse of state.horses){
  if(horse.df160PendingTactic&&raced.has(String(horse.id))&&raced.get(String(horse.id))===horse.df160PendingTactic){
   horse.df160PendingTactic='';used=true;
  }
 }
 if(used)change('df160-tactic-one-race-finished');
 return used;
}
const DF153_SS_REAL=new Set(['ディープインパクト','アーモンドアイ','イクイノックス']);
function df153StatBonus(type,id,key){return (state.df153Items||[]).reduce((sum,it)=>sum+(it.holderType===type&&it.holderId===String(id)?Number(it.bonus?.[key]||0):0),0);}
function df153Equipped(type,id){return (state.df153Items||[]).filter(it=>it.holderType===type&&it.holderId===String(id));}
function df153Equip(uid,type,id){
 const item=state.df153Items.find(x=>x.uid===uid);
  if(!item||['secretary_charm','speed_hoof'].includes(item.kind)||item.holderType||DF160_CONSUMABLES[item.kind])return {ok:false,message:'このアイテムは装着できません。'};
 if(!['owner','vs'].includes(type))return {ok:false,message:'装着先が不正です。'};
 const valid=type==='owner'?state.horses.some(h=>String(h.id)===String(id)):state.battleHorses.some(h=>String(h.snapshotId)===String(id));
 if(!valid)return {ok:false,message:'馬が見つかりません。'};
 const worn=df153Equipped(type,id);
 if(worn.length>=10)return {ok:false,message:'装備枠は10個までです。'};
 if(item.kind===DF160_GOLD_HOOF_KIND&&worn.filter(x=>x.kind===DF160_GOLD_HOOF_KIND).length>=DF160_GOLD_HOOF_LIMIT)
  return {ok:false,message:'金の蹄鉄は1頭につき4個まで装備できます。'};
 item.holderType=type;item.holderId=String(id);change('df153-item-equipped');
 return {ok:true,message:'装着しました。補正を反映しました。'};
}
function df153Unequip(uid){
 const item=state.df153Items.find(x=>x.uid===uid);
 if(!item||!['owner','vs'].includes(item.holderType))return {ok:false,message:'取り外せる装備アイテムが見つかりません。'};
 item.holderType='';item.holderId='';change('df153-item-unequipped');
 return {ok:true,message:'アイテムを倉庫へ戻しました。'};
}
// Ver.173: equipment can be discarded from the warehouse or an attached horse.
function df173DiscardEquipment(uid){
  const index=state.df153Items.findIndex(x=>x.uid===uid);
  if(index<0)return {ok:false,message:'アイテムが見つかりません。'};
  const item=state.df153Items[index];
  if(DF160_CONSUMABLES[item.kind])return {ok:false,message:'消費アイテムは破棄対象ではありません。'};
  state.df153Items.splice(index,1);
  change('df173-equipment-discarded');
  return {ok:true,message:item.name+'を捨てました。'};
}
function df153RemoveVs(id){
 if(!state.battleHorses.some(x=>x.snapshotId===id))return {ok:false,message:'VS登録馬が見つかりません。'};
 state.df153Items.forEach(x=>{if(x.holderType==='vs'&&x.holderId===id){x.holderType='';x.holderId='';}});
 state.battleHorses=state.battleHorses.filter(x=>x.snapshotId!==id);
 change('df153-vs-unregistered');return {ok:true,message:'VS登録を抹消し、装備アイテムを倉庫へ戻しました。'};
}
// Ver.188: a VS snapshot stores its registration-time BASE stats only. Compute
// the equipped view on a clone for the list, race and exported JSON alike.
// Recompute rather than accumulating over a prior item/total to avoid double bonuses.
function df153BattleWithBonuses(entry){
 const copy=clone(entry);
 const stats=copy.raceStats||{};
 const worn=df153Equipped('vs',entry.snapshotId);
 for(const key of FARM_STAT_KEYS){
  if(!stats[key])continue;
  const original=entry.raceStats[key]||{};
  const base=Number(original.base),unique=Number(original.unique);
  const originalTotal=Number(original.total);
  const frozen=Number.isFinite(base)&&Number.isFinite(unique)?base+unique:(Number.isFinite(originalTotal)?originalTotal:0);
  const bonus=worn.reduce((v,it)=>v+(Number(it.bonus?.[key])||0),0);
  stats[key].item=bonus;
  stats[key].total=frozen+bonus;
 }
 const formBonus=worn.reduce((v,it)=>v+(Number(it.bonus?.form)||0),0);
 if(formBonus){
  const baseForm=Number(entry.raceContext?.form);
  copy.raceContext={...(copy.raceContext||{}),form:Math.min(100,Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(baseForm)?baseForm:75)+formBonus)};
 }
 copy.df153Equipment=worn.map(x=>({uid:x.uid,name:x.name,kind:x.kind,bonus:clone(x.bonus)}));
 return copy;
}
// Ver.156: unlocked tiers and the actively selected tier are deliberately separate.
// Winning GⅠ races in normal mode never counts as the second (BLACK MODE) collection.
function df155SwitchMode(mode){
 if(!['normal','black','black2'].includes(mode))return {ok:false};
 if(mode==='black'&&!state.df153BlackMode||mode==='black2'&&!state.df155Black2Unlocked)return {ok:false};
 if(state.df155SelectedMode!==mode){state.df155SelectedMode=mode;change('df155-mode-switched');}
 return {ok:true,mode:state.df155SelectedMode};
}
// Ver.172: Keep Black 2 G1 wins distinct from the wins that unlock Black 2.
// The guaranteed gold item and its claimed flag are committed together with the final G1 win.
function df153RegisterWin(raceName,needed){
 const n=String(raceName||'');const req=Array.isArray(needed)?[...new Set(needed.filter(x=>typeof x==='string'))]:[];
 if(!n||!req.includes(n))return {justUnlocked:false,justUnlocked2:false,guaranteedItems:[]};
 let justUnlocked=false,justUnlocked2=false;
 const guaranteedItems=[];
 if(state.df155SelectedMode==='normal'&&!state.df153BlackMode){
  if(!state.df153WonG1Names.includes(n))state.df153WonG1Names.push(n);
  justUnlocked=req.length>0&&req.every(x=>state.df153WonG1Names.includes(x));
  if(justUnlocked){state.df153BlackMode=true;state.df155SelectedMode='black';}
 }else if(state.df155SelectedMode==='black'&&state.df153BlackMode&&!state.df155Black2Unlocked){
  if(!state.df155BlackG1Names.includes(n))state.df155BlackG1Names.push(n);
  justUnlocked2=req.length>0&&req.every(x=>state.df155BlackG1Names.includes(x));
  if(justUnlocked2){state.df155Black2Unlocked=true;state.df155SelectedMode='black2';}
 }else if(state.df155SelectedMode==='black2'&&state.df155Black2Unlocked){
  if(!state.df172Black2G1Names.includes(n))state.df172Black2G1Names.push(n);
  if(!state.df172Black2GoldClaimed&&req.length>0&&req.every(x=>state.df172Black2G1Names.includes(x))){
   const rewards=[df160MakeGoldHorseshoe()];
   for(const kind of ['stamina_drink','tactic_ticket']){
    const count=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++)rewards.push(df160MakeConsumable(kind));
   }
   state.df153Items.push(...rewards);
   state.df172Black2GoldClaimed=true;
   guaranteedItems.push(...rewards.map(clone));
  }
 }
 change(justUnlocked?'df153-black-unlocked':justUnlocked2?'df155-black2-unlocked':'df155-g1-win');
 return {justUnlocked,justUnlocked2,guaranteedItems,mode:state.df155SelectedMode,
  blackMode:state.df153BlackMode,won:state.df153WonG1Names.length,wonBlack:state.df155BlackG1Names.length,total:req.length};
}
// Ver.172 per-race rolls. Separate rolls mean multiple kinds may be awarded at once.
// Unspecified Black 2 non-G1 behavior (OP 20% legacy roll) is deliberately preserved.
function df153ClaimDrop(input){
 if(!state.df153BlackMode)return {ok:false};
 const raceId=String(input?.raceId||'');
 if(!raceId||state.df153DropClaims.includes(raceId))return {ok:false};
 state.df153DropClaims.push(raceId);state.df153DropClaims=state.df153DropClaims.slice(-2000);
 const mode=['normal','black','black2'].includes(input?.modeAtStart)?input.modeAtStart:state.df155SelectedMode;
 if(!['black','black2'].includes(mode)){change('df172-no-item-mode');return {ok:true,items:[]};}
 const wonItems=[];
 function addConsumable(kind){
  const item=df160MakeConsumable(kind);
  if(item){state.df153Items.push(item);wonItems.push(item);}
 }
 if(input.grade!=='GⅠ'){
  if(Math.random()<0.02)addConsumable('stamina_drink');
  if(Math.random()<0.02)addConsumable('tactic_ticket');
  change('df172-non-g1-item-drop');
  return {ok:true,item:wonItems[0]?clone(wonItems[0]):null,items:wonItems.map(clone)};
 }
 // A G1 win in either Black mode: gold 2%, consumables 4% each.
 // Completion of all Black 2 G1s awards its own gold, never twice on the final race.
 if(!input.black2GoldAwarded&&Math.random()<0.02){
  const gold=df160MakeGoldHorseshoe();state.df153Items.push(gold);wonItems.push(gold);
 }
 if(Math.random()<0.04)addConsumable('stamina_drink');
 if(Math.random()<0.04)addConsumable('tactic_ticket');
 change('df172-g1-item-drop');
 return {ok:true,item:wonItems[0]?clone(wonItems[0]):null,items:wonItems.map(clone)};
}

 getBreedingDiagnosis:df137PairingDiagnosis,
 breedWithPair:(sireId,mareId)=>commitBreeding(sireId,mareId)===true,
 awardClassicResult:applyClassicReward,

    }));

 resetDemo:()=>resetFarmStorage(false),
 showHome:()=>{closeModal();render();}
});

// Approximate additional coat shades on the same normalized horse artwork.
// Base side/front images and alpha (including muzzle and socks) are retained.
function tintHorseCoat(pixels,coatType){
  const coat=String(coatType||'');
  if(['栗毛','芦毛','月毛','パロミノ'].includes(coat))return;
  for(let i=0;i<pixels.length;i+=4){
    if(pixels[i+3]<12)continue;
    const r=pixels[i],g=pixels[i+1],b=pixels[i+2];
    const lum=.299*r+.587*g+.114*b;
    const cmax=Math.max(r,g,b),cmin=Math.min(r,g,b);
    // Preserve white markings on brown horses rather than coloring socks black.
    const whiteMark=(cmin>100 && cmax-cmin<38 && (coat!=='白毛'));
    if(whiteMark && coat!=='河原毛')continue;
    let R=r,G=g,B=b;
    switch(coat){
      case '栃栗毛': R=r*.78;G=g*.70;B=b*.65;break;
      case '鹿毛': R=r*.77;G=g*.64;B=b*.59;break;
      case '赤鹿毛': R=r*.92;G=g*.69;B=b*.64;break;
      case '黒鹿毛': {const v=18+lum*.52;R=v*1.25;G=v*.96;B=v*.82;break;}
      case '青鹿毛': {const v=16+lum*.46;R=v*.94;G=v*1.02;B=v*1.12;break;}
      case '青毛': {const v=12+lum*.42;R=v*.96;G=v;B=v*1.09;break;}
      case '白毛': R=Math.min(254,r*.48+134);G=Math.min(254,g*.48+134);B=Math.min(254,b*.48+134);break;
      case '粕毛': R=r*.92+22;G=g*.92+22;B=b*.92+22;break;
      case '河原毛': R=r*.85+10;G=g*.82+9;B=b*.74+12;break;
      case '尾花栗毛': R=r*1.02;G=g*.79;B=b*.74;break;
      default: return;
    }
    pixels[i]=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(R)));
    pixels[i+1]=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(G)));
    pixels[i+2]=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(B)));
  }
}
// ===== Ver.31 translucent 2D horse sprite animation (applies to every horse PNG) =====
// No static spring background changes; deform transparent horse pixels only.
(function(){
 const canvas=$('horseCanvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});
 const W=360,H=480;
 canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;
 let cacheAsset='',cacheCoat='',loaded=null,base=null,frame=ctx.createImageData(W,H),lastPaint=0;
 const img=new Image();
 const premiumFarmOverlay=document.getElementById('premiumFarmSkin');
 window.FarmGestureArt={load(url,coatType){
   const coat=String(coatType||'');
   if(url===cacheAsset&&coat===cacheCoat)return;
   cacheAsset=url;cacheCoat=coat;loaded=null;base=null;
   img.onload=()=>{
     if(cacheAsset!==url||cacheCoat!==coat)return;
     const off=document.createElement('canvas');off.width=W;off.height=H;
     const c=off.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});c.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
     c.drawImage(img,0,0,W,H);
     const imageData=c.getImageData(0,0,W,H);
     tintHorseCoat(imageData.data,coat);
     base=imageData.data;
     loaded=url;lastPaint=0;
   };
   img.onerror=()=>{loaded=null;};img.src=url;
 }};
 function smooth(v){v=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));return v*v*(3-2*v);}
 function pulse(p){return Math.max(0,Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p))));}
 function renderAnimated(t){
   requestAnimationFrame(renderAnimated);
   if(!base||!selected()||motionPaused||t-lastPaint<45)return;
   lastPaint=t;
   if(!lastGestureHorse||lastGestureHorse!==selected().id){lastGestureHorse=selected().id;chooseGesture(false,'neck');}
   if(t>nextGestureAt)chooseGesture(false);
   // While premium farm home covers the sprite, all these canvas pixels are invisible.
   // CSS hides that overlay for the breeding view: canvas painting resumes then.
   if(premiumFarmOverlay&&getComputedStyle(premiumFarmOverlay).display!=='none')return;
   const side=currentView()==='side';
   const age=(t-poseFrom)/Math.max(1,FARM_GESTURES[currentGesture].duration);
   const active=t<poseUntil,p=active?pulse(age):0;
   const move=Math.sin(t/970)*2.7;
   let headX=move,headY=0,tailX=0,earX=0;
   if(currentGesture==='shake'&&active)headX+=Math.sin(age*12*Math.PI)*22*p;
   if(currentGesture==='neck'&&active)headX+=Math.sin(age*2*Math.PI)*10*p;
   if(currentGesture==='graze'&&active){headY=60*p;headX=-8*p;}
   if(currentGesture==='yawn'&&active){headY=-14*p;headX=5*p;}
   if(currentGesture==='tail'&&active)tailX=Math.sin(age*7*Math.PI)*27*p;
   if(currentGesture==='ear'&&active)earX=Math.sin(age*9*Math.PI)*12*p;
   // Offsets are spatially feathered; the torso and legs remain stationary.
   const src=base,out=frame.data;
   for(let y=0;y<H;y++){
     const ny=y/H;
     const headYFactor=1-smooth((ny-.34)/.34);
     const tailYFactor=smooth((ny-.38)/.19)*(1-smooth((ny-.94)/.1));
     const earsYFactor=1-smooth((ny-.07)/.14);
     for(let x=0;x<W;x++){
       const nx=x/W,j=(y*W+x)*4;
       const headRegion=(side?(1-smooth((nx-.27)/.36)):(1-smooth((Math.abs(nx-.5)-.11)/.38)));
       const head=headYFactor*headRegion;
       const tailRegion=side?smooth((nx-.73)/.19):smooth((Math.abs(nx-.5)-.22)/.24);
       const dx=headX*head+(tailX*tailRegion*tailYFactor)+earX*earsYFactor*(side? (1-smooth((nx-.22)/.2)): (1-smooth((Math.abs(nx-.5)-.17)/.23)));
       const dy=headY*head;
       const sx=x-dx,sy=y-dy;
       const x0=Math.floor(sx),y0=Math.floor(sy);
       if(x0<0||x0>=W-1||y0<0||y0>=H-1){out[j]=out[j+1]=out[j+2]=out[j+3]=0;continue;}
       const a=sx-x0,b=sy-y0;
       const n=(y0*W+x0)*4,m=n+W*4;
       for(let k=0;k<4;k++){
         out[j+k]=(src[n+k]*(1-a)+src[n+4+k]*a)*(1-b)+(src[m+k]*(1-a)+src[m+4+k]*a)*b;
       }
     }
   }
   ctx.putImageData(frame,0,0);
   if(side){
     const blink=currentGesture==='blink'&&active&&Math.sin(age*6*Math.PI)>0;
     if(blink){
       ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#6b352a';ctx.lineWidth=3.5;
       ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(58,83);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(65,87,70,82);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
     }
     if(currentGesture==='yawn'&&active){
       ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#51221d';ctx.globalAlpha=.78*p;
       ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(40,137,7,2+8*p,-.22,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
     }
   }
 }
 requestAnimationFrame(renderAnimated);
})();

 // Gentle, AUTOMATIC and randomly timed portrait motion. No animation buttons.
 const sceneImage=$('exactSceneImage');
 const motionCanvas=$('exactHorseMotion');
 const motionContext=motionCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});
 let activeScene=base;
 let idleTimer=0,frameRequest=0,ongoingMotion=null;
 const reducedMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 const motionPalette={gray:'#a1a1a4',white:'#deddd9',gold:'#a77734',black:'#302d2d',bay:'#654433',red:'#8b583d'};
 function motionVisible(){return !document.hidden&&secDialog.hidden&&skin.getBoundingClientRect().width>0&&!reducedMotion}
 function scheduleNaturalMotion(){
   clearTimeout(idleTimer);
   idleTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
     if(!motionVisible()){scheduleNaturalMotion();return}
     const kinds=['blink','blink','blink','blink','ear','ear','neck','breath'];
     const kind=kinds[Math.floor(Math.random()*kinds.length)];
     const dur=kind==='blink'?180:kind==='ear'?690:kind==='neck'?1250:2050;
     startNaturalMotion(kind,dur);
   },2800+Math.random()*6500);
 }
 function blinkEyes(ctx,color){
   // Eyelids cover (not merely dim) both eyes on the existing horse photograph.
   for(const [x,y,rot] of [[191,337,-.12],[378,335,.12]]){
     ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rot);
     ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,17,10,0,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.fill();
     ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(38,22,18,.95)';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.lineCap='round';
     ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-15,0);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,9,15,-1);ctx.stroke();
     ctx.restore();
   }
 }
 function warpHorseRegion(ctx,kind,strength){
   // Tiny local displacement of the actual horse pixels, with stable background & secretary.
   const patch=kind==='ear'?{x:166,y:82,w:279,h:175,amp:6}:
     kind==='neck'?{x:128,y:205,w:337,h:480,amp:4}:
     {x:132,y:660,w:324,h:575,amp:2};
   ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.ellipse(patch.x+patch.w/2,patch.y+patch.h/2,patch.w/2,patch.h/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);
   ctx.clip();
   for(let yy=patch.y;yy<patch.y+patch.h;yy+=3){
     const rel=(yy-patch.y)/patch.h;
     const envelope=Math.sin(Math.PI*rel)**2;
     const delta=patch.amp*strength*envelope;
     ctx.drawImage(sceneImage,patch.x-delta,yy,patch.w,3,patch.x,yy,patch.w,3);
   }
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function startNaturalMotion(kind,duration){
   if(!sceneImage.complete||!sceneImage.naturalWidth||!motionVisible()){scheduleNaturalMotion();return}
   cancelAnimationFrame(frameRequest);
   const begun=performance.now();ongoingMotion=kind;
   function frame(now){
     if(!motionVisible()){motionCanvas.style.opacity='0';ongoingMotion=null;scheduleNaturalMotion();return}
     if(!sceneImage.complete||!sceneImage.naturalWidth){motionCanvas.style.opacity='0';ongoingMotion=null;scheduleNaturalMotion();return}
     const progress=Math.min((now-begun)/duration,1);
     const strength=Math.sin(Math.PI*progress);
     motionContext.clearRect(0,0,1024,1536);
     motionContext.drawImage(sceneImage,0,0,1024,1536);
     if(kind==='blink')blinkEyes(motionContext,motionPalette[activeHorseCoat]||motionPalette.red);
     else warpHorseRegion(motionContext,kind,strength);
     motionCanvas.style.opacity='1';
     if(progress<1)frameRequest=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
     else{motionCanvas.style.opacity='0';ongoingMotion=null;scheduleNaturalMotion()}
   }
   frameRequest=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 }
 let activeHorseCoat='red';
 scheduleNaturalMotion();
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
   if(document.hidden){cancelAnimationFrame(frameRequest);motionCanvas.style.opacity='0'}
   else scheduleNaturalMotion();
 });

 function df157StartDrag(panel,btn){
  // Inline value is a fallback for mobile WebView; the new CSS selector below
  // overrides #premiumFarmSkin button{touch-action:manipulation} as well.
  btn.style.setProperty('touch-action','none','important');
  btn.style.webkitUserSelect='none';
  btn.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
   if(e.button!==0||df157ModeDragging)return;
   df157SuppressClick=false;
   df157ModeDragging={id:e.pointerId,startX:e.clientX,startY:e.clientY,
    left:parseFloat(panel.style.left)||8,top:parseFloat(panel.style.top)||8,moved:false};
   try{btn.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_e){}
  });
  btn.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
   const drag=df157ModeDragging;
   if(!drag||drag.id!==e.pointerId)return;
   const dx=e.clientX-drag.startX,dy=e.clientY-drag.startY;
   if(!drag.moved&&Math.hypot(dx,dy)<7)return;
   drag.moved=true;e.preventDefault();
   const {maxX,maxY}=df158ModeLimits(panel);
   panel.style.left=Math.max(6,Math.min(maxX,drag.left+dx))+'px';
   panel.style.top=Math.max(6,Math.min(maxY,drag.top+dy))+'px';
   const choices=panel.querySelector('#df155ModeChoices');
   if(choices)choices.hidden=true;
   btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  });
  const finish=e=>{
   const drag=df157ModeDragging;
   if(!drag||drag.id!==e.pointerId)return;
   if(drag.moved){
    df157SuppressClick=true;
    df157SaveModePosition(panel);
   }
   df157ModeDragging=null;
   try{btn.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_e){}
  };
  btn.addEventListener('pointerup',finish);
  btn.addEventListener('pointercancel',finish);
  window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{df157ModeDragging=null;});
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>df157PositionMode(panel));
 }

  const run=()=>{replay=true;try{b.click()}finally{replay=false}};
  busy=true;layer.classList.add('df-v2-active');
  if(typeof document.startViewTransition==='function'){
   try{document.startViewTransition(run).finished.catch(()=>{}).finally(()=>{layer.classList.remove('df-v2-active');busy=false})}
   catch(_){layer.classList.remove('df-v2-active');busy=false;run()}
  }else{
   document.body.classList.add('df-v2-fade-out');
   setTimeout(()=>{run();document.body.classList.remove('df-v2-fade-out');document.body.classList.add('df-v2-fade-in');
    setTimeout(()=>{document.body.classList.remove('df-v2-fade-in');layer.classList.remove('df-v2-active');busy=false},1100);
   },700);
  }
 },true);
})();

<script id="dfV9OwnedPageBehavior">
(()=>{

 root.appendChild(layer);
 let page=0,view='horse',requestSeq=0,pending=null,careers={},calendarReturn=null;
 const escape=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
 const s=()=>bridge.getState();
 const yearAge=(h,st)=>Math.max(0,Number(st.calendarYear||1)-Number(h.birthGameYear||1));
  function horseClass(h,c){
    if(h.named===false)return '未命名';
    const wins=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(c?.wins??h.totalWins)||0));
    const starts=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(c?.starts??h.totalStarts)||0));
    return wins===0?(starts?'未勝利':'新馬'):wins===1?'1勝クラス':wins===2?'2勝クラス':wins===3?'3勝クラス':'オープン';
  }
  function careerText(h,c){
    if(!c&&!Number.isFinite(Number(h.totalStarts)))return '戦績を確認中';
    const starts=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(c?.starts??h.totalStarts)||0));
    const wins=Math.max(0,Math.min(starts,Math.floor(Number(c?.wins??h.totalWins)||0)));
    return `${starts}戦${wins}勝${starts-wins}敗`;
  }
  const aptitudeText=h=>{
    const a=Number(h.aptMin),b=Number(h.aptMax);
    return Number.isFinite(a)&&Number.isFinite(b)?`${escape(a)}〜${escape(b)}m`:'未設定';
  };
  const DF_V20_KEYS=Object.freeze(['sp','sta','kick','grit']);
  const DF_V20_LABELS=Object.freeze({sp:'スピード',sta:'スタミナ',kick:'瞬発力',grit:'勝負根性'});
  function dfV20Order(h){
    if(Array.isArray(h.v20RevealOrder)&&h.v20RevealOrder.length===4&&new Set(h.v20RevealOrder).size===4&&DF_V20_KEYS.every(k=>h.v20RevealOrder.includes(k)))return h.v20RevealOrder.slice();
    const order=DF_V20_KEYS.slice();
    for(let i=order.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[order[i],order[j]]=[order[j],order[i]];}
    return order;
  }
  function dfV20Unlocked(h,key){
    const n=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Number(h.v20RevealStage)||0));
    if(key==='distance')return n>=6;
    const index=(h.v20RevealOrder||[]).indexOf(key);
    return index>=0 && n>=index+2;
  }
  function visibleAbilities(h){
    const values=bridge.getOpHorseAbilities?.(h.id)||[];
    const vmap=Object.fromEntries(values.map(v=>[v.key,v]));
    return DF_V20_KEYS.map(key=>{
      const active=dfV20Unlocked(h,key),v=vmap[key];
      // Ver.134: use the same growing base + unique Pt total as the race selection screen.
      const amount=active&&v?(Math.round(Number(v.total)*10)/10).toLocaleString('ja-JP',{maximumFractionDigits:1}):'';
      return `<div class="df-v18-ability ${active?'df-v20-revealed':'df-v19-hidden-ability'}"><small>${DF_V20_LABELS[key]}</small><strong ${active?'':'aria-label="未判明"'}>${escape(amount)}</strong></div>`;
    }).join('');
  }
  function dfV20Notice(h,code){
    if(code==='growth')return `オーナー！${h.name}の成長タイプがわかりました。${h.growth}タイプです。`;
    if(code==='distance')return `オーナー！${h.name}の距離適性がわかりました！ ${Number(h.aptMin)}〜${Number(h.aptMax)}mです♡`;
    return `オーナー！${h.name}の${DF_V20_LABELS[code]||'能力'}がわかりました！ 所有馬の能力欄をご覧ください♡`;
  }
  function dfV20UpdateFromRace(entries){
    const counts=new Map();
    for(const e of entries||[]){
      const id=String(e?.horseId||''),n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(e?.starts)||0));
      if(id&&n>0)counts.set(id,Math.max(n,counts.get(id)||0));
    }
    if(!counts.size)return;
    const state=s();let changed=false;
    const horses=(state.horses||[]).map(h=>{
      const starts=counts.get(String(h.id));if(!starts)return h;
      let stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Number(h.v20RevealStage)||0));
      const limit=Math.min(6,starts);if(stage>=limit)return h;
      const order=dfV20Order(h),queue=Array.isArray(h.v20RevealNotices)?h.v20RevealNotices.slice():[];
      for(let step=stage+1;step<=limit;step++)queue.push(step===1?'growth':step===6?'distance':order[step-2]);
      changed=true;
      return {...h,v20RevealStage:limit,v20RevealOrder:order,v20RevealNotices:queue.slice(0,6),growthRevealed:true,
        growthAnnouncementPending:false};
    });
    if(changed)bridge.setState({horses});
  }
  function dfV20MigrateOldCareer(h,starts){
    // Past completed races: reveal what was already learned, but do not invent old announcements.
    if(!h||h.v20RevealStage>0||starts<=0)return;
    const st=s(),order=dfV20Order(h),stage=Math.min(6,Math.floor(starts));
    bridge.setState({horses:st.horses.map(x=>x.id===h.id?{
      ...x,v20RevealOrder:order,v20RevealStage:stage,
      growthRevealed:true
    }:x)});
  }
  function raceHistory(h,c){

    if(!history.length)return '<p class="df-v18-none">出走したレースの記録はありません。</p>';
    return `<div class="df-v18-history-scroll"><table class="df-v18-table"><thead><tr><th>年月</th><th>レース</th><th>着順</th><th>賞金</th></tr></thead><tbody>${history.slice().reverse().map(r=>{
     const year=Number(r.year),month=Number(r.month),place=Number(r.place);
     const when=Number.isFinite(year)&&Number.isFinite(month)?`${year}年${month}月`:'—';
     const pos=Number.isFinite(place)&&place>0?place+'着':'—';
     const prize=Number.isFinite(Number(r.prize))&&r.prize!==undefined?dfFormatAmount(r.prize):'記録なし';
     return `<tr><td>${escape(when)}</td><td>${escape(r.name||'レース')}</td><td class="${place===1?'df-v18-win':''}">${escape(pos)}</td><td>${escape(prize)}</td></tr>`;
    }).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
  }

  const dfV19Images=Object.freeze({gray:'data:image/webp;base64,',dark:'data:image/webp;base64,',bay:'data:image/webp;base64,',chestnut:'data:image/webp;base64,'});
  window.dfV45NoticeArt=dfV19Images.bay; // text-free existing secretary-and-horse portrait for VS notices

  function dfV19HasDebuted(h){

  }
  function dfV19Comment(h,st){
    const fatigue=Number(h.fatigue)||0, form=Number(h.form)||75;
    if(fatigue>=60)return '少し疲れているみたいです。ゆっくり休ませてあげましょうね♡';
    if(form>=90)return '今日はとても調子が良さそうです！次のレースが楽しみですね♪';
    if(Number(careers[h.id]?.wins)>0)return 'この子の勝利、とても嬉しかったですね！次も応援しています♡';
    if(!dfV19HasDebuted(h))return 'オーナー！初出走の日が待ち遠しいですね♡';
    const words=['今日も元気に過ごしていますよ♪','成長が楽しみですね、オーナー♡','この子と一緒に頑張りましょう！','毛づやがきれいですね♡'];
    let n=Number(st.calendarYear||1)*12+Number(st.calendarMonth||1);

  const df153ItemLabel=it=>DF160_CONSUMABLES[it.kind]?`${escape(it.name)}（${escape(DF160_CONSUMABLES[it.kind].description)}）`:`${escape(it.name)}（${Object.entries(it.bonus||{}).map(([k,v])=>k==='formRecoveryMultiplier'?'調子回復×'+v:(k==='form'?'調子':FARM_STAT_NAMES[k]||k)+'+'+v).join('・')}）`;
  function df153GearPanel(type,id,st){
