   const slots=equipped.map((it,i)=>`<div class="df153-slot"><span>${i+1}. ${df153ItemLabel(it)}</span><button data-df153-remove="${escape(it.uid)}" type="button">外す</button><button type="button" data-df173-discard="${escape(it.uid)}">捨てる</button></div>`).join('');
   return `<details class="df-v18-slab df153-gear df-ui-accordion"><summary>装着アイテム <small>${equipped.length}/10・金の蹄鉄 ${goldCount}/4</small></summary><div class="df153-slots">${slots||'<p class="df-ui-empty">装備中のアイテムはありません。</p>'}</div>
     ${equipped.length<10&&free.length?`<div class="df153-equipline"><select data-df153-pick="${escape(type)}:${escape(id)}">${free.map(x=>`<option value="${escape(x.uid)}">${df153ItemLabel(x)}</option>`).join('')}</select><button type="button" data-df153-equip="${escape(type)}:${escape(id)}">装着する</button></div>`:`<p>${equipped.length>=10?'装備枠は満杯です。':'倉庫に装備できるアイテムがありません。'}</p>`}
     ${type==='vs'?'<p>VS登録馬の装備はいつでも外せます。外したアイテムは倉庫に戻り、再装備できます。</p>':''}
   </details>`;
  }
  function df153InventoryView(st){
   const items=st.df153Items||[];
   const choices=[...(st.horses||[]).map(h=>({type:'owner',id:h.id,label:'現役：'+h.name})),...(st.battleHorses||[]).map(h=>({type:'vs',id:h.snapshotId,label:'VS：'+h.name}))];
    const freeConsumables=items.filter(it=>!it.holderType&&DF160_CONSUMABLES[it.kind]);
    const defaultTicket=freeConsumables[0]?.kind==='tactic_ticket';
    const usePanel=`<section class="df160-consumable-panel"><h3>使い切りアイテムを使用</h3>
      <p>現役馬を選ぶ → アイテムを選ぶ → 使用</p>
      ${freeConsumables.length&&(st.horses||[]).length?`<label>馬を選ぶ<select id="df160ConsumableHorse">${(st.horses||[]).map(h=>`<option value="${escape(h.id)}" ${h.df173ConsumableUsed?'disabled':''}>${escape(h.name)}（${h.df173ConsumableUsed?'生涯使用済み':'調子'+Math.round(Number(h.form)||0)}）</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
      <label>アイテム<select id="df160ConsumableItem">${freeConsumables.map(it=>`<option value="${escape(it.uid)}">${df153ItemLabel(it)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
      <label id="df160TacticField" ${defaultTicket?'':'hidden'}>次のレースの脚質<select id="df160TacticChoice">${DF160_TACTICS.map(t=>`<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
      <button type="button" data-df160-use ${(st.horses||[]).some(h=>!h.df173ConsumableUsed)?'':'disabled'}>使用</button><p>消費アイテムは1頭につき生涯1個までです。</p>`:'<p>使用できるアイテムか現役馬がありません。</p>'}
     </section>`;
   return `<div class="df-v9-inner">${navButtons()}<h2 class="df-v9-title">アイテム倉庫</h2>
     <p class="df-v21-help">総所持 ${items.length}個</p>
     ${items.length?items.map(it=>`<div class="df153-stockitem"><strong>${df153ItemLabel(it)}</strong><small>${it.holderType?it.holderType==='vs'?'VS登録馬に装備中（取り外し可能）':'現役馬に装着中':'倉庫内'}</small>${!DF160_CONSUMABLES[it.kind]?`<button type="button" data-df173-discard="${escape(it.uid)}">捨てる</button>`:''}</div>`).join(''):'<p class="df-v21-help">まだアイテムを持っていません。</p>'}
      ${usePanel}
     ${choices.length?`<h3>アイテム装着先を選ぶ</h3><select id="df153WarehouseTarget">${choices.map(x=>`<option value="${escape(x.type)}:${escape(x.id)}">${escape(x.label)}</option>`).join('')}</select><button type="button" data-df153-go-target>装備枠へ</button>`:''}
     <p class="df-v21-help">装備は従来どおり最大10個。金の蹄鉄のみ、1頭につき最大4個です。</p></div>`;
  }

 function navButtons(){return `<div class="df-v9-topnav"><button type="button" class="df-v9-smallbtn ${view==='horse'?'active':''}" data-v9="owner">現役所有馬</button><button type="button" class="df-v9-smallbtn ${view==='breeding'?'active':''}" data-v9="breeding">繁殖馬</button><button type="button" class="df-v9-smallbtn ${view==='battle'?'active':''}" data-v9="battle">対戦馬一覧</button>${s().df153BlackMode?`<button type="button" class="df-v9-smallbtn ${view==='items'?'active':''}" data-v9="items">アイテム倉庫</button>`:''}</div>`}
 // Ver.21: a frozen copy of the current horse, not a live reference to the racing/farm state.
 let dfV21Feedback='';
 function dfV21CreateSnapshot(h,st,previousId){
   const abilities=bridge.getOpHorseAbilities?.(h.id)||[];
   if(abilities.length!==7)throw Error('7能力の取得に失敗したため、保存しませんでした。');
   const frozen=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(h));
   const career=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(careers[h.id]||{}));
   const stamp=new Date().toISOString();
   return {
     format:'derby-fantasy-battle-horse',schema:1,
     snapshotId:previousId||String(h.id)+'@'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9),
     origin:'owned-horse',sourceHorseId:String(h.id),
     savedAt:stamp,savedGameYear:st.calendarYear,savedGameMonth:st.calendarMonth,
     name:String(h.name||''),sex:String(h.sex||''),coatType:String(h.coatType||''),
     age:yearAge(h,st),growth:String(h.growth||''),
     horse:frozen,career,
     raceStats:Object.fromEntries(abilities.map(a=>[a.key,{
       label:a.label,base:Number(a.base),unique:Number(a.unique),
       item:0,total:Number(a.base)+Number(a.unique),
       initial:Number(a.initial),maximum:Number(a.maximum)
     }])),
     raceContext:{form:Number(h.form),fatigue:Number(h.fatigue),
       aptMin:Number(h.aptMin),aptMax:Number(h.aptMax),bestDistance:Number(h.bestDistance),
       surface:h.surface,tactic:h.tactic,goingAptitude:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(h.goingAptitude||{})),
       temperament:Number(h.temperament),health:Number(h.health),constitution:Number(h.constitution),
       recovery:Number(h.recovery),formStability:Number(h.formStability),luck:Number(h.luck)}
   };
 }
 function dfV21SaveBattle(h){
   if(!s().v43VsUnlocked){dfV21Feedback='VS機能が解放されると現役中でも登録できます。';paint();return;}
   if(!h||h.named===false){dfV21Feedback='名前が決まった所有馬を選択してください。';paint();return;}
   const st=s(),items=Array.isArray(st.battleHorses)?st.battleHorses.slice():[];
   const i=items.findIndex(x=>x.origin==='owned-horse'&&String(x.sourceHorseId)===String(h.id));
   if(i>=0&&(st.df153Items||[]).some(x=>x.holderType==='vs'&&x.holderId===items[i].snapshotId)){dfV21Feedback='VS登録馬を更新するには、先に装備アイテムを外してください。';paint();return;}
    if(i>=0&&!confirm(`${h.name}の対戦用データを、現在の能力で保存し直しますか？\n以前の保存能力は上書きされます。`))return;
   if(i<0&&items.length>=300){dfV21Feedback='対戦用データは300頭まで保存できます。';paint();return;}
   try{
     const entry=dfV21CreateSnapshot(h,st,i>=0?items[i].snapshotId:null);
     if(i>=0)items[i]=entry;else items.push(entry);
     bridge.setState({battleHorses:items});
     const updated=s().battleHorses||[];
     if(!updated.some(x=>x.snapshotId===entry.snapshotId))throw Error('保存を確認できませんでした。');
     if(bridge.verifyBattleSnapshot&&!bridge.verifyBattleSnapshot(entry.snapshotId))throw Error('端末への保存に失敗しました。容量や保存権限を確認してください。');
     dfV21Feedback=`${h.name}の対戦用データを${i>=0?'更新':'保存'}しました（${entry.savedGameYear}年目${entry.savedGameMonth}月・${entry.age}歳の能力）。`;
     paint();
   }catch(err){dfV21Feedback='保存できませんでした：'+(err?.message||String(err));paint();}
 }
 function dfV21ExportBattle(id){
   const entry=bridge.df153BattleEntry?.(id)||(s().battleHorses||[]).find(x=>x.snapshotId===id);
   if(!entry)return;
   const file='derby_fantasy_battle_'+String(entry.sourceHorseId).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,'').slice(0,28)+'_'+String(entry.savedGameYear)+'y'+String(entry.savedGameMonth)+'m.json';
   try{
     // The outer game document owns the download and the Android Flutter save channel.
     window.parent.postMessage({channel:'df-v21-battle-export',filename:file,
       contents:JSON.stringify(entry,null,2)},'*');
     dfV21Feedback='JSONファイルの書き出しを依頼しました。保存先を確認してください。';
   }catch(err){dfV21Feedback='書き出しを依頼できませんでした：'+(err?.message||String(err));}
   paint();
 }
 function dfUiHorseQuickFacts(stats,aptMin,aptMax,tactic,growth){
   const labels=[['sp','スピード'],['sta','スタミナ'],['kick','瞬発力'],['grit','勝負根性']];
   const val=v=>v!==null&&v!==undefined&&v!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(v))?escape(Math.round(Number(v))):'—';
   const validDist=v=>v!==null&&v!==undefined&&v!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(v))&&Number(v)>0;
   const distance=validDist(aptMin)&&validDist(aptMax)?`${escape(Math.round(Number(aptMin)))}〜${escape(Math.round(Number(aptMax)))}m`:'記録なし';
   return `<div class="df-ui-quickfacts" aria-label="4能力・距離適性・脚質・成長型">
     <div class="df-ui-fourstats">${labels.map(([key,label])=>`<div class="df-ui-stat"><small>${label}</small><strong>${val(stats?.[key])}</strong></div>`).join('')}</div>
     <div class="df-ui-quickmeta"><span><small>距離適性</small><strong>${distance}</strong></span><span><small>脚質</small><strong>${escape(tactic||'記録なし')}</strong></span><span><small>成長型</small><strong>${escape(growth||'記録なし')}</strong></span></div>
   </div>`;
 }

      ${dfUiHorseQuickFacts(Object.fromEntries(['sp','sta','kick','grit'].map(k=>[k,effective.raceStats?.[k]?.total])),effective.raceContext?.aptMin??x.horse?.aptMin,effective.raceContext?.aptMax??x.horse?.aptMax,effective.raceContext?.tactic??x.horse?.tactic,x.growth||x.horse?.growth)}
      <p>装備反映後の能力を表示中 ／ 調子 ${escape(Math.round(Number(effective.raceContext?.form)||0))} ／ 装備 ${escape(effective.df153Equipment?.length||0)}個</p>

      <button class="df-v21-export" type="button" data-v21-export="${escape(x.snapshotId)}">この馬のJSONを書き出す</button><button type="button" data-df153-unregister="${escape(x.snapshotId)}">VS登録抹消（装備返却）</button>
    </article>`;}).join(''):'<div class="df-v21-empty">まだ対戦用の馬は保存されていません。<br>所有馬画面の「対戦馬として保存」から登録できます。</div>';   return `<div class="df-v9-inner">${navButtons()}<div class="df-v9-topline">DERBY FANTASY · BATTLE HORSES</div>
    <h2 class="df-v9-title">対戦馬一覧</h2><p class="df-v9-subtitle">保存済み ${entries.length}頭 ／ 所有馬5頭枠とは別</p>
    <p class="df-v21-help df-v21-library-note">登録時の基本能力は固定です。装備アイテムの補正は一覧・VSレースに反映され、持ち出しJSONには書き出した時点の補正後能力が保存されます。装備を外すと補正は解除されます。</p>
    ${dfV21Feedback?`<p class="df-v21-feedback" role="status">${escape(dfV21Feedback)}</p>`:''}
    <div class="df-v21-library">${cards}</div></div>`;
 }
 const DF38_TITLE_ICONS=Object.freeze({"junior":"data:image/png;base64,","colt":"data:image/png;base64,","filly":"data:image/png;base64,","autumn":"data:image/png;base64,","grandprix":"data:image/png;base64,","tenno":"data:image/png;base64,","arima":"data:image/png;base64,","spring":"data:image/png;base64,","fall":"data:image/png;base64,","japan":"data:image/png;base64,","five":"data:image/png;base64,","fiveage":"data:image/png;base64,"});
 window.DF39TitleEmblemIcons=DF38_TITLE_ICONS;
 function df37OwnedTitles(h,career){
  const titles=h.df37Titles&&Object.keys(h.df37Titles).length?h.df37Titles:career?.fullRaceHorse?.df37Titles;
  if(!titles||!Object.keys(titles).length)return '';
  const entries=Object.entries(titles).map(([id,item])=>({id,name:typeof item==='string'?item:item?.name||''})).filter(x=>x.name);
  if(!entries.length)return '';
  return `<section class="df-v18-slab" aria-label="獲得称号"><h4>🏆 獲得称号 <small>HONORS</small></h4>
    <div class="df38-emblem-list">${entries.map(x=>DF38_TITLE_ICONS[x.id]
       ?`<div class="df38-emblem-item" title="${escape(x.name)}"><img src="${DF38_TITLE_ICONS[x.id]}" alt="${escape(x.name)}" loading="lazy"><span>${escape(x.name)}</span></div>`
       :`<div class="df38-emblem-text">🏆 ${escape(x.name)}</div>`).join('')}</div></section>`;
 }
  function df142BirthRecord(h,{pedigree=false}={}){
    if(!h)return '';
    const price=Number(h.birthSalePrice);
    const validPrice=h.birthSalePrice!==null&&h.birthSalePrice!==undefined&&Number.isSafeInteger(price)&&price>=0;
    const effects=Array.isArray(h.birthPairEffects)?h.birthPairEffects.filter(x=>typeof x==='string'&&x.trim()):[];
    if(!validPrice&&!pedigree&&!effects.length)return '';
    const parents=pedigree?`<p>父：${escape(h.sire||'記録なし')} ／ 母：${escape(h.dam||'記録なし')}</p>`:'';
    return `<details class="df-v18-slab df142-birth-record df-ui-accordion" aria-label="出生時の配合情報"><summary>誕生時の情報</summary>
      ${validPrice?`<p class="df142-birth-price">誕生時の売却価格：<strong>${dfFormatAmount(price)}</strong></p>`:''}
      ${parents}
      ${effects.length?`<div class="df142-birth-effects"><strong>配合効果</strong>${effects.map(x=>`<p>${escape(x)}</p>`).join('')}</div>`:''}
      ${!effects.length&&pedigree?'<p>出生時の配合効果の記録はありません。</p>':''}
    </details>`;
  }
  function df142CareerRecord(h,record){
    const c=record&&typeof record==='object'?record:{};
    const starts=Number(c.starts??h?.racingStarts??h?.totalStarts);
    const wins=Number(c.wins??h?.racingWins??h?.totalWins);
    const g1=Number(h?.g1Wins);
    const cash=Number(c.prize??h?.earnedPrize??h?.prize);
    const parts=[];
    if(Number.isFinite(starts))parts.push(`${Math.max(0,Math.floor(starts))}戦`);
    if(Number.isFinite(wins))parts.push(`${Math.max(0,Math.floor(wins))}勝`);
    if(Number.isFinite(g1))parts.push(`GⅠ ${Math.max(0,Math.floor(g1))}勝`);
    const details=Array.isArray(c.monthlyHistory)&&c.monthlyHistory.length?raceHistory(h,c):'<p class="df-v18-none">レース別の戦歴記録はありません。</p>';
    return `<details class="df-v18-slab df142-career-record df-ui-accordion"><summary>戦歴・詳細</summary><p>${escape(parts.join(' / ')||'通算成績の記録なし')}</p>
      ${Number.isFinite(cash)?`<p>獲得総賞金：${dfFormatAmount(cash)}</p>`:''}${details}</details>`;
  }
  function df137OwnerBreedingView(){

  function paint(){
   if(layer.hidden)return;
   const st=s(),hs=st.horses||[];
   // Ver.157: old/normal saves must not reveal the warehouse tab or inventory screen.
   if(view==='items'&&!st.df153BlackMode)view='horse';
  if(view==='items'){
    layer.innerHTML=df153InventoryView(st);
   } else if(view==='battle'){
    layer.innerHTML=dfV21BattleLibrary(st);
   } else if(view==='breeding'){
    layer.innerHTML=df137OwnerBreedingView();
  } else {
   page=Math.max(0,Math.min(4,page));const h=hs[page];
   const hero=h?`<div class="df-v20-date"><small>ゲーム内カレンダー</small><strong>${escape(st.calendarYear)}年目 ${escape(st.calendarMonth)}月</strong></div><article class="df-v9-horsecard df-v18-profile">
 <div class="df-v18-head">
  <span class="df-v18-eyebrow">DERBY FANTASY · OWNER'S STABLE</span>
  <div class="df-v18-namebar"><h3>${escape(h.name||'未命名の馬')}</h3><span class="df-v20-form">調子 ${escape(Math.round(h.form===null||h.form===undefined||h.form===''?75:Number(h.form)))}</span><span class="df-v18-class">${escape(horseClass(h,careers[h.id]))}</span></div>
  <p class="df-v18-intro">${escape(h.sex||'—')} <span>·</span> ${yearAge(h,st)}歳 <span>·</span> ${escape(h.coatType||'—')}</p>
 </div>
 <div class="df-v9-body df-v18-main">
  ${dfV19Portrait(h,st)}
  <section class="df-v18-slab" aria-label="血統情報"><h4>血統 <small>LINEAGE</small></h4>
   <div class="df-v18-pedigree"><div><small>父馬</small><strong>${escape(h.sire||'記録なし')}</strong></div><div><small>母馬</small><strong>${escape(h.dam||'記録なし')}</strong></div></div>
  </section>
  <section class="df-v18-slab" aria-label="通算成績"><h4>競走成績 <small>RACING RECORD</small></h4>
   <p class="df-v18-record-number">${careerText(h,careers[h.id])}</p>
   <div class="df-v18-prize"><small>累計獲得賞金</small><strong>${dfFormatAmount(Math.max(Number(h.prize)||0,Number(careers[h.id]?.prize)||0))}</strong></div>
  </section>
   ${df37OwnedTitles(h,careers[h.id])}
  ${df142BirthRecord(h)}
  <section class="df-v18-slab" aria-label="適性"><h4>適性と成長 <small>APTITUDE</small></h4>
   <div class="df-v18-apt-grid"><div><small>成長タイプ</small><strong>${dfV19HasDebuted(h)?escape(h.growth||'—'):'？？？'}</strong>${dfV19HasDebuted(h)?`<span class="df142-retire-label">${window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h)}歳12月まで現役可能</span>`:''}</div><div><small>脚質</small><strong>${escape(h.tactic||'—')}</strong>${h.df160PendingTactic?`<small style="display:block;color:#ffe19e;font-weight:700">次走のみ：${escape(h.df160PendingTactic)}</small>`:''}</div><div class="df-v18-wide"><small>距離適性</small><strong>${dfV20Unlocked(h,'distance')?aptitudeText(h):''}</strong></div></div>
  </section>
  <section class="df-v18-slab" aria-label="主要4能力"><h4>主要4能力 <small>ABILITY</small></h4>
   <div class="df-v18-abilities">${visibleAbilities(h)}</div>

 function df160RewardKindLabel(item){
  const names={stamina_drink:'スタミナドリンク',tactic_ticket:'脚質変更券',
    gold_horseshoe:'金の蹄鉄'};
  return names[item.kind]||String(item.name||'アイテム').slice(0,50);
 }
 function df160RewardGroupItems(items){
  const grouped=[];
  for(const item of items){
   if(!item||typeof item!=='object')continue;
   const kind=String(item.kind||'');
   // A horseshoe has its own persistent random bonuses, so never combine two of them.
   const canCombine=kind==='stamina_drink'||kind==='tactic_ticket';
   const previous=canCombine?grouped.find(g=>g.item.kind===kind):null;
   if(previous){previous.quantity++;continue;}
   grouped.push({item,quantity:1});
  }
  return grouped;
 }
 function df160RewardShowNext(){
  if(df160RewardShowing||!df160RewardQueue.length||!document.body)return;
  // First and second BLACK MODE unlock announcements take precedence.
  if(document.getElementById('df153BlackUnlock')||document.getElementById('df155Black2Unlock')){
   if(!df160RewardBlockedWatcher){
    df160RewardBlockedWatcher=new MutationObserver(()=>{
     if(!document.getElementById('df153BlackUnlock')&&!document.getElementById('df155Black2Unlock')){
      df160RewardBlockedWatcher?.disconnect();df160RewardBlockedWatcher=null;df160RewardShowNext();
     }
    });
    df160RewardBlockedWatcher.observe(document.body,{childList:true});
   }
   return;
  }
  const groups=df160RewardGroupItems(df160RewardQueue.shift());
  if(!groups.length){df160RewardShowNext();return;}
  df160RewardShowing=true;
  df160RewardPrepareStyle();
  const oldFocus=document.activeElement;
  const overlay=document.createElement('section');overlay.className='df160-reward-overlay';
  overlay.id='df160ItemRewardOverlay';
  const dialog=document.createElement('div');dialog.className='df160-reward-dialog';
  dialog.setAttribute('role','dialog');dialog.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  dialog.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','df160ItemRewardTitle');
  const header=document.createElement('h2');header.className='df160-reward-head';
  header.id='df160ItemRewardTitle';header.textContent='✨ アイテム獲得！';dialog.appendChild(header);
  const layout=document.createElement('div');layout.className='df160-reward-layout';
  const secretary=document.createElement('div');secretary.className='df160-reward-secretary';
  const portrait=document.createElement('img');portrait.alt='アイテム獲得を祝う秘書';
  portrait.src=df160RewardSecretaryImage();secretary.appendChild(portrait);
  const portraitLabel=document.createElement('span');portraitLabel.className='df160-reward-secretary-label';
  portraitLabel.textContent='おめでとうございます！';secretary.appendChild(portraitLabel);
  const prizes=document.createElement('div');prizes.className='df160-reward-prizes';
  const intro=document.createElement('p');intro.className='df160-reward-intro';
  intro.textContent=groups.length>1?'アイテムを同時に獲得しました！':'新しいアイテムを獲得しました！';
  prizes.appendChild(intro);
  const cards=document.createElement('div');cards.className='df160-reward-items';
  cards.dataset.multiple=String(groups.length>1);
  groups.forEach((group,i)=>{
   const item=group.item;
   const kind=String(item.kind||'');
   const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='df160-reward-card';
   if(kind==='gold_horseshoe')card.classList.add('df160-reward-card--gold');
   else if(kind==='tactic_ticket')card.classList.add('df160-reward-card--ticket');
   else if(kind==='stamina_drink')card.classList.add('df160-reward-card--drink');
   const icon=document.createElement('div');icon.className='df160-reward-icon';
   icon.innerHTML=df160RewardIcon(kind,i);card.appendChild(icon);
   const name=document.createElement('p');name.className='df160-reward-name';
   name.textContent=df160RewardKindLabel(item);card.appendChild(name);
   const quantity=document.createElement('div');quantity.className='df160-reward-qty';
   quantity.textContent='× '+group.quantity;card.appendChild(quantity);
   if(kind==='gold_horseshoe'){
    const bonus=item.bonus||{};
    const extras=document.createElement('p');extras.className='df160-reward-bonuses';
    const toBonus=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Math.max(0,Math.min(5,Math.floor(Number(v)))):0;
    extras.textContent=`スピード +${toBonus(bonus.sp)}・スタミナ +${toBonus(bonus.sta)}・調子 +${toBonus(bonus.form)}`;
    card.appendChild(extras);
   }
   cards.appendChild(card);
  });
  prizes.appendChild(cards);layout.append(secretary,prizes);dialog.appendChild(layout);
  const closeButton=document.createElement('button');closeButton.type='button';
  closeButton.className='df160-reward-close';closeButton.textContent='タップして閉じる';
  dialog.appendChild(closeButton);
  const note=document.createElement('p');note.className='df160-reward-note';
  note.textContent='獲得アイテムは倉庫に保存されました';dialog.appendChild(note);
  overlay.appendChild(dialog);
  let closed=false;
  function close(){
   if(closed)return;closed=true;
   document.removeEventListener('keydown',onKeydown,true);
   overlay.remove();df160RewardShowing=false;
   try{if(oldFocus?.isConnected)oldFocus.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(_e){}
   df160RewardShowNext();
  }
  function onKeydown(e){if(e.key==='Escape'||e.key==='Enter'&&document.activeElement===closeButton){e.preventDefault();close();}}
  overlay.addEventListener('click',close);
  document.addEventListener('keydown',onKeydown,true);
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  try{closeButton.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(_e){}
 }

  df160RewardQueue.push(items.slice());
  df160RewardShowNext();
  return true;
 };

 function df156GetFarmDoc(){
  try{ return df156GetFarmFrame()?.contentWindow?.document || null; }catch(_e){ return null; }

 function df156SeasonImageKey(seasonText){
  const s=String(seasonText||'');
  if(s.includes('春'))return 'farm_spring';
  if(s.includes('夏'))return 'farm_summer';
  if(s.includes('秋'))return 'farm_autumn';
  if(s.includes('冬'))return 'farm_winter';
  return 'generic_a';
 }
 function df156ChooseSecretaryImageByComment(commentText, seasonText){
  const text=String(commentText||'');
  if(/おめでとう|祝|優勝|勝利|1着|ＧⅠ|GⅠ|GI|G1/.test(text))return 'celebration';
  if(/分析|レース|着|払戻|掲示板/.test(text))return 'race_result';
  if(/名前|オーナー|聞かせ/.test(text))return 'naming';
  if(/贈り物|使ってください|資金援助/.test(text))return 'aid';
  return df156SeasonImageKey(seasonText);
 }
 function df156ApplyNamingArt(){
  const art=document.querySelector('.secretary-naming-art');
  if(!art)return;
  // A stable choice for each naming dialog node. The 400ms observer must not
  // keep changing the portrait while the player is typing.
  if(!art.__df201RandomPortrait){
   art.__df201RandomPortrait=window.DF201SecretaryImages?.next()||DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES.naming;
  }
  if(art.getAttribute('src')!==art.__df201RandomPortrait)art.src=art.__df201RandomPortrait;
 }
 function df156ApplyAidArt(){
  const art=document.getElementById('dfV21AidPortrait');
  if(art && art.getAttribute('src')!==DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES.aid) art.src=DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES.aid;
 }
 function df156ApplyRaceAdviceArt(){
  const panel=document.getElementById('df132SecretaryAdvice');
  if(!panel) return;
  const img=panel.querySelector('img');
  if(!img) return;
  let key='race_result';
  try{
   if(typeof finished!=='undefined' && Array.isArray(finished)){
    const ownerResult=finished.findIndex(h=>h && h.owner);
    if(ownerResult===0) key='celebration';
    else if(ownerResult>0) key='race_result';
   }
  }catch(_e){}
  if(img.getAttribute('src')!==DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES[key]) img.src=DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES[key];
 }
 function df156ApplyFarmSecretaryArt(){
  const doc=df156GetFarmDoc();
  if(!doc) return;
  const win=doc.defaultView;
  const portrait=doc.getElementById('farmSecretaryPortrait');
  if(!portrait) return;
  const commentText=doc.getElementById('farmSecretaryComment')?.textContent || '';
  let seasonText='';
  try{
   if(doc.defaultView && typeof doc.defaultView.seasonKey==='function') seasonText=doc.defaultView.seasonKey();
  }catch(_e){}
  if(!seasonText) seasonText=document.getElementById('seasonBadge')?.textContent || '';
  const key=df156ChooseSecretaryImageByComment(commentText, seasonText);
  let desiredImage=DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES[key] || DF156_SECRETARY_IMAGES.generic_a;
  // DF201: only the normal spring portrait is randomized. The original
  // naming/owner comment (key='naming') and other special notices stay intact.
  const date=doc.defaultView?.FarmHomeBridge?.getState?.();
  // The farm's seasonKey() returns English labels (and needs a month), so
  // use the authoritative calendar month rather than that legacy label.
  const springNormal=[3,4,5].includes(Number(date?.calendarMonth))&&
    !['naming','celebration','race_result','aid'].includes(key);
  if(springNormal){
   const token=String(date?.calendarYear||'')+'-'+String(date?.calendarMonth||'')+'|'+commentText;
   if(portrait.__df201SpringToken!==token){
    portrait.__df201SpringToken=token;
    portrait.__df201SpringImage=win.DF201SecretaryImages?.next()||desiredImage;
   }
   desiredImage=portrait.__df201SpringImage||desiredImage;
  }
  if(portrait.getAttribute('src')!==desiredImage) portrait.src=desiredImage;
 }
 function df156PatchFarmFrame(){
  const frame=df156GetFarmFrame();
  const win=frame?.contentWindow;
  const doc=df156GetFarmDoc();
  if(!frame || !win || !doc) return false;
  if(!win.__df156SecretaryPatched){
   try{
    if(typeof win.updateSecretary==='function'){
      const original=win.updateSecretary;
      win.updateSecretary=function(){
        const result=original.apply(this, arguments);
        try{ df156ApplyFarmSecretaryArt(); }catch(_e){}
        return result;
      };
    }
    win.__df156SecretaryPatched=true;
   }catch(_e){}
   try{
    const mo=new MutationObserver(()=>df156ApplyFarmSecretaryArt());
    const target=doc.getElementById('farmSecretaryComment') || doc.body;

 function df156CountDownButton(btn, stateKey, seconds, finalText){
  if(!btn) return;
  if(DF156_STATE[stateKey+'Done']===finalText) return;
  clearInterval(DF156_STATE[stateKey+'Timer']);
  DF156_STATE[stateKey+'Done']=finalText;
  let remain=seconds;
  btn.disabled=true;
  const prefix=finalText.startsWith('⚔') ? '⚔' : '▶';
  const tick=()=>{
   if(remain>0){
    btn.textContent=`${prefix} 次へまで${remain}秒`;
    remain--;
   }else{
    clearInterval(DF156_STATE[stateKey+'Timer']);
    btn.disabled=false;
    btn.textContent=finalText;
   }
  };
  tick();
  DF156_STATE[stateKey+'Timer']=setInterval(tick,1000);
 }
 function df156WatchNextButtons(){
  const startBtn=document.getElementById('start');

   df156CountDownButton(startBtn,'nextCountdown',3,startBtn.textContent);
  }
  const homeBtn=document.getElementById('resultToRaceHome');
  if(homeBtn && !homeBtn.hidden && !homeBtn.disabled && document.body?.dataset?.gameScreen==='results'){
   df156CountDownButton(homeBtn,'resultHome',3,'📅 レースホームへ戻る・次のレースを選ぶ');
  }
 }

 }
 function df156AdjustRaceCamera(instant){
  try{
   if(typeof camera==='undefined' || typeof runners==='undefined' || !camera || !runners || !runners.length) return;
   if(typeof dfFollowCamera!=='undefined' && dfFollowCamera.active) return;
   if(typeof selectShot!=='function' || typeof trackOffset!=='function' || typeof ranks!=='function') return;
   if(typeof dfV47World!=='undefined' && dfV47World) return;
   const shot=selectShot();
   if(!['finish','sweep','side','front5'].includes(shot)) return;
   const order=ranks();
   if(!order || !order.length) return;
   const leader=order[0];
   const portrait=$('viewport') ? ($('viewport').clientWidth/Math.max(1,$('viewport').clientHeight) < .88) : false;
   let focusDist=leader.dist;
   if(shot==='sweep'){
    const tail=order[order.length-1];
    focusDist=(leader.dist + tail.dist) * 0.5;
   } else if(shot==='side' || shot==='front5'){
    const group=order.slice(0, shot==='front5' ? 5 : 3);
    focusDist=group.reduce((a,h)=>a+h.dist,0)/Math.max(1,group.length);
   } else if(shot==='finish'){
    focusDist=Math.max(0, Math.min((typeof GOAL_RUNOUT_METERS!=='undefined'?TOTAL+GOAL_RUNOUT_METERS:TOTAL), TOTAL-18));
   }
   const sign=(currentCourse && currentCourse.direction==='左') ? -1 : 1;
   const eyeDist=Math.max(0, focusDist - (shot==='finish' ? 18 : 14));
   const lookDist=Math.min((typeof GOAL_RUNOUT_METERS!=='undefined'?TOTAL+GOAL_RUNOUT_METERS:TOTAL), focusDist + (shot==='finish' ? 20 : 16));
   const eye=trackOffset(eyeDist, sign*(shot==='finish'?11:13));
   const look=trackOffset(lookDist, sign*2);
   eye.y=portrait ? 4.5 : 4.0;
   look.y=2.45;
   const fov=shot==='finish' ? (portrait?56:50) : (portrait?60:53);
   const alpha=instant ? 1 : 0.18;
   if(typeof viewTarget!=='undefined' && viewTarget) viewTarget.lerp(look,alpha); else camera.lookAt(look);
   camera.position.lerp(eye,alpha);
   camera.fov += (fov-camera.fov)*alpha;
   if(typeof viewTarget!=='undefined' && viewTarget) camera.lookAt(viewTarget); else camera.lookAt(look);
   camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
   try{ if($('camname')) $('camname').textContent = shot==='finish' ? 'CAM 05　柵近く・低めの斜めゴール前' : 'CAM 02　柵近く・低めの斜め追走'; }catch(_e){}
  }catch(_e){}
 }

<script>
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const PREFIX='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.';
 const META=PREFIX+'v6.';
 const AUTO=META+'autosave_slot';
 const MANUAL=META+'manual_export_slot';
 const GUARD=META+'progress_guard_v163';
 const RECOVERY=META+'restore_recovery';
 const PENDING=META+'df151_pending_newspaper_loss';
 const BACKUP_NUMBER=META+'backup_serial_v170';
 const RESTORE_DAY=META+'restore_day_v170';
 const FREE_MANUAL_DAY=META+'manual_free_backup_day_v190';
 const FORMAT='derby-fantasy-new-html-save';
 const MAX_IMPORT_BYTES=8*1024*1024;
 const MAX_EXPORT_BYTES=MAX_IMPORT_BYTES;
 const el=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const panel=el('dfV6SaveDialog'), output=el('dfV6SaveStatus');
 function status(message,error=false){output.textContent=message;output.style.color=error?'#ffb8a9':'#e9daaf';}
 function keyAllowed(k){return typeof k==='string'&&k.startsWith(PREFIX)&&!k.startsWith(META)&&k.length<170;}
 function gameKeys(){const r=[];for(let i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){const k=localStorage.key(i);if(keyAllowed(k))r.push(k);}return r.sort();}
 function collect(){const o=Object.create(null);for(const k of gameKeys()){const v=localStorage.getItem(k);if(v!==null)o[k]=v;}return o;}
 function fingerprint(keys){const json=JSON.stringify(Object.keys(keys).sort().map(k=>[k,keys[k]]));let v=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<json.length;i++)v=Math.imul(v^json.charCodeAt(i),16777619)>>>0;return ('00000000'+v.toString(16)).slice(-8);}
 // A device-local forward-only ledger. It is intentionally stored outside the
 // exported game keys. It blocks ordinary old-file restores on this installation;
 // deleting application data also deletes this ledger, so this is NOT server-grade.
 function freshGuard(checksum){
  return {schema:1,lineage:'df163-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),revision:1,checksum};
 }
 function readGuard(){
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(GUARD);if(!raw)return null;
  let g;try{g=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(_){throw Error('進行記録が破損しています。データを上書きせずに保護しました。');}
  if(!g||g.schema!==1||typeof g.lineage!=='string'||g.lineage.length<10||!Number.isSafeInteger(g.revision)||g.revision<1||!(/^[0-9a-f]{8}$/).test(g.checksum))
   throw Error('進行記録が不正です。データを上書きせずに保護しました。');
  return g;
 }
 function syncGuard(force=false){
  const keys=collect();if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(keys,PREFIX+'farm'))return readGuard();
  const checksum=fingerprint(keys);let g=readGuard();
  if(!g){
   // A completely fresh installation may import a backup before starting play.
   if(!force&&!localStorage.getItem(AUTO)&&!localStorage.getItem(MANUAL))return null;
   g=freshGuard(checksum);localStorage.setItem(GUARD,JSON.stringify(g));return g;
  }
  if(g.checksum!==checksum){
   if(g.revision>=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)throw Error('進行番号の上限です');
   g={...g,revision:g.revision+1,checksum};
   localStorage.setItem(GUARD,JSON.stringify(g));
  }
  return g;
 }
 function allowedRestore(data){
  const g=syncGuard(false);
  if(!g)return null; // New installation/data reset: recovery is allowed, but cannot establish true rollback protection.
  const sameState=data.checksum===g.checksum;
  const sameRevision=data.rollbackGuard?.schema===1&&data.rollbackGuard?.lineage===g.lineage&&
    data.rollbackGuard?.revision===g.revision&&data.rollbackGuard?.checksum===g.checksum;
  if(!sameState||(!sameRevision&&data.rollbackGuard))
   throw Error('過去のバックアップには戻せません。現在より古い進行状況です。');
  // Legacy Ver.162 backups are accepted only if their full game state is unchanged.
  return g;
 }
 function snapshot(reason,detail){
  // The first new game may have an in-memory pasture before its first ordinary save.
  if(!localStorage.getItem(PREFIX+'farm')){try{const farm=el('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge?.getState?.();if(farm)localStorage.setItem(PREFIX+'farm',JSON.stringify(farm));}catch(_){}}
  const keys=collect();if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(keys,PREFIX+'farm'))throw Error('牧場のデータが保存されていません');
  const g=syncGuard(true);
  return {format:FORMAT,schema:1,game:'derby-fantasy-new-html',version:170,
    savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),keys,checksum:fingerprint(keys),
    rollbackGuard:g?{schema:1,lineage:g.lineage,revision:g.revision,checksum:g.checksum}:null,
    checkpoint:{reason,detail:detail&&typeof detail==='object'?detail:null}};
 }
 function validate(raw){
  const data=typeof raw==='string'?JSON.parse(raw):raw;
  if(!data||data.format!==FORMAT||data.schema!==1||!data.keys||typeof data.keys!=='object'||Array.isArray(data.keys))throw Error('対応していないセーブファイルです');
  const keys=data.keys,names=Object.keys(keys);
  if(!names.length||names.length>100||!names.includes(PREFIX+'farm')||names.some(k=>!keyAllowed(k)||typeof keys[k]!=='string'||keys[k].length>MAX_IMPORT_BYTES))throw Error('保存データに不正な項目があります');
  for(const k of names){if(k.endsWith('.farm')||k.endsWith('.stable')||k.endsWith('.wallet')||k.endsWith('.calendar')){
    try{const obj=JSON.parse(keys[k]);if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object'||Array.isArray(obj))throw Error();}catch(_){throw Error('保存データが破損しています');}
  }}
  if(data.checksum!==fingerprint(keys))throw Error('チェックサムが一致しません');
  if(data.backupNumber!=null&&(!Number.isSafeInteger(data.backupNumber)||data.backupNumber<1))throw Error('バックアップ番号が不正です');
  if(data.rollbackGuard!=null){const g=data.rollbackGuard;
   if(g.schema!==1||typeof g.lineage!=='string'||g.lineage.length<10||!Number.isSafeInteger(g.revision)||g.revision<1||g.checksum!==data.checksum)throw Error('バックアップの進行記録が不正です');
  }
  return data;
 }
 function readBackupNumber(){
  const n=Number(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_NUMBER)||'0');
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<0)throw Error('バックアップ番号の記録が不正です。');
  return n;
 }
 function nextBackupNumber(){const n=readBackupNumber();if(n>=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)throw Error('バックアップ回数の上限です。');return n+1;}
 function setBackupNumber(n){
  localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_NUMBER,String(n));
  if(readBackupNumber()!==n)throw Error('バックアップ番号を保存できませんでした。');
 }
 function jstNow(){
  const parts=Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{
   timeZone:'Asia/Tokyo',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'
  }).formatToParts(new Date()).map(x=>[x.type,x.value]));
  const day=`${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`;
  return {day,minute:Number(parts.hour)*60+Number(parts.minute),epoch:Date.now()};
 }
 // Ver.190: one successful manual export per JST calendar day is free.
 // Stored outside exported game keys so restoring a backup does not restore the quota.
 function readFreeManualDay(){
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(FREE_MANUAL_DAY);if(!raw)return null;
  try{
   const d=JSON.parse(raw);
   if(!d||typeof d.day!=='string'||!/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/.test(d.day)||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(d.epoch)||d.epoch<0)throw Error();
   return d;
  }catch(_){throw Error('無料バックアップの回数記録が破損しています。安全のため手動保存を停止しました。');}
 }
 function manualFeeState(){
  const now=jstNow(),last=readFreeManualDay();
  if(last&&(now.day<last.day||now.epoch<last.epoch))
   throw Error('端末の日時が前回の無料バックアップより前です。日時をご確認ください。');
  return {day:now.day,epoch:now.epoch,isFree:!last||last.day!==now.day};
 }
 function updateManualFeeNotice(){
  const state=manualFeeState();
  el('df181FeeNotice').textContent=state.isFree?
   '本日の手動バックアップは1回無料です。保存に成功した場合だけ無料枠を使用します。自動バックアップと復元は無料です。':
   '本日の無料枠は使用済みです。手動バックアップは所持金の10％がかかります。キャンセル・保存失敗時は徴収しません。自動バックアップと復元は無料です。';
  return state;
 }
 function readRestoreDay(){
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(RESTORE_DAY);if(!raw)return null;
  try{
   const d=JSON.parse(raw);
   if(!d||!/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/.test(d.day)||!Number.isFinite(d.epoch))throw Error();
   return d;
  }catch(_){throw Error('復元回数の記録が不正です。安全のため復元を停止しました。');}
 }
 function assertRestoreWindow(){
  const now=jstNow(),last=readRestoreDay();
  if(last&&now.epoch<last.epoch)throw Error('端末の日時が前回復元より前です。日時をご確認ください。');
  if(last&&now.day===last.day)throw Error('本日の復元は1回使用済みです。翌日まで復元できません。');
  if(!((now.minute>=480&&now.minute<490)||(now.minute>=1200&&now.minute<1210)))
   throw Error('復元できるのは毎日08:00〜08:10・20:00〜20:10（日本時間）のみです。');
  return now;
 }
 function assertBackupNumber(data){
  const latest=readBackupNumber();
  // Legacy backups remain eligible only under the strict Ver.163 checksum guard.
  if(latest>0&&Number(data.backupNumber||0)<latest)
   throw Error('このバックアップは最新番号より古いため復元できません。');
 }
 function readableDate(s){if(!s)return 'まだありません';const d=new Date(s);return Number.isNaN(d.getTime())?'不明':d.toLocaleString('ja-JP');}
 function updateButtons(){let auto=null,g=null;try{
   const s=localStorage.getItem(AUTO);if(s)auto=validate(s);
   g=readGuard();
  }catch(e){status(e.message,true);}
  el('dfV6SaveTime').textContent=auto?readableDate(auto.savedAt)+'（'+({breeding:'種付け',birth:'仔馬誕生',month:'月替わり',newspaper:'競馬新聞'}[auto.checkpoint?.reason]||'過去の保存')+'／第'+(auto.backupNumber||'旧版')+'回）':'まだありません';
  const sameState=auto&&(!g||(auto.checksum===g.checksum&&(!auto.rollbackGuard||
    (auto.rollbackGuard.lineage===g.lineage&&auto.rollbackGuard.revision===g.revision))));
  el('dfV6AutoLoad').disabled=!sameState;
  try{assertRestoreWindow();if(auto)assertBackupNumber(auto);}catch(_){el('dfV6AutoLoad').disabled=true;}
 }
 function checkpoint(reason,detail){
  if(!['breeding','birth','newspaper','month'].includes(reason))return false;
  try{
   const saved=snapshot(reason,detail),n=nextBackupNumber();
   saved.backupNumber=n;
   localStorage.setItem(AUTO,JSON.stringify(saved));
   validate(localStorage.getItem(AUTO));
   setBackupNumber(n);
   updateButtons();return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Ver.151 自動バックアップ更新失敗:',e);return false;}
 }
 function restore(data){
  const checked=validate(data);
  // Persisted progression beats timestamps, which can be rolled back or edited.
  // An imported file from the current state is harmless; any different old state
  // is refused even when it was saved after the last automatic checkpoint.
  const restoreWindow=assertRestoreWindow();
  assertBackupNumber(checked);
  const priorGuard=allowedRestore(checked);
  const old=collect();
  if(localStorage.getItem(RECOVERY))throw Error('未完了の復旧処理があります');
  localStorage.setItem(RECOVERY,JSON.stringify({format:'df-v6-recovery',keys:old}));
  try{
   for(const k of gameKeys())localStorage.removeItem(k);
   for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(checked.keys))localStorage.setItem(k,v);
   for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(checked.keys))if(localStorage.getItem(k)!==v)throw Error('データの書込検証に失敗しました');
   // Only an explicit manual restore invokes the penalty, never app startup.
   const d=checked.checkpoint?.reason==='newspaper'?checked.checkpoint.detail:null;
   if(d&&typeof d.raceId==='string'&&d.raceId){localStorage.setItem(PENDING,JSON.stringify(d));}
   else localStorage.removeItem(PENDING);
   if(!priorGuard){
    const imported=checked.rollbackGuard;
    const newG=imported?{schema:1,lineage:imported.lineage,revision:imported.revision,checksum:checked.checksum}:freshGuard(checked.checksum);
    localStorage.setItem(GUARD,JSON.stringify(newG));
   }
   // Commit the daily limit only after all game keys have passed verification.
   localStorage.setItem(RESTORE_DAY,JSON.stringify(restoreWindow));
   if(readRestoreDay()?.day!==restoreWindow.day)throw Error('復元回数を保存できませんでした。');
   if(!priorGuard&&Number.isSafeInteger(checked.backupNumber)&&checked.backupNumber>readBackupNumber())setBackupNumber(checked.backupNumber);
   localStorage.removeItem(RECOVERY);
  }catch(e){
   try{for(const k of gameKeys())localStorage.removeItem(k);for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(old))localStorage.setItem(k,v);localStorage.removeItem(RECOVERY);}catch(rollback){console.error('復旧用コピーを保持',rollback);}
   throw e;
  }
  window.location.reload();return true;
 }
 function askAndRestore(raw,label){
   assertRestoreWindow();
   const data=validate(raw);assertBackupNumber(data);
   allowedRestore(data);

      (isPaper?'\n※競馬新聞のレースは所有馬が最下位となり、再出走できません。':'')+'\n続けますか？';

 }
 async function importFile(file){if(!file)return;if(file.size>MAX_IMPORT_BYTES)throw Error('8MBを超えるバックアップは読み込めません');
   return askAndRestore(await file.text(),'バックアップファイル');}
 // Ver.190: prepare the export with its final cash balance. A free export
 // has no cash mutation and must not advance the rollback-guard revision.
 function feePaidSnapshot(saved,expected,fee){
  const farmKey=PREFIX+'farm',walletKey=PREFIX+'wallet';
  const farm=JSON.parse(saved.keys[farmKey]||'null');
  const wallet=JSON.parse(saved.keys[walletKey]||'null');
  if(!farm||!wallet||farm.walletCash!==expected||wallet.balance!==expected||
     !Number.isSafeInteger(wallet.pending)||wallet.pending!==0)
   throw Error('牧場と所持金の記録が一致しません。牧場画面で保存し直してください。');
  farm.walletCash=expected-fee;
  wallet.balance=expected-fee;
  saved.keys[farmKey]=JSON.stringify(farm);
  saved.keys[walletKey]=JSON.stringify(wallet);
  saved.checksum=fingerprint(saved.keys);
  if(fee>0&&saved.rollbackGuard){
   if(saved.rollbackGuard.revision>=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)throw Error('進行番号の上限です。');
   saved.rollbackGuard={...saved.rollbackGuard,revision:saved.rollbackGuard.revision+1,checksum:saved.checksum};
  }
  saved.version=190;
  saved.checkpoint.detail={manualFeeYen:fee,feeBasis:'walletCash',balanceAfter:expected-fee};
  return saved;
 }
 async function exportManual(){
  const cashApi=window.DF181BackupMoney;
  if(!cashApi?.getBalance||!cashApi?.charge)throw Error('資金情報を取得できません。');
  const quote=manualFeeState();
  const expected=cashApi.getBalance();
  const fee=quote.isFree?0:Math.floor(expected/10);
  const formatted=value=>new Intl.NumberFormat('ja-JP').format(value)+'円';
  if(!window.confirm((quote.isFree?'本日1回目の手動バックアップは無料です。':'本日の無料枠は使用済みです。手動バックアップの手数料は所持資金の10％です。')+'\n'+
      '現在の所持資金：'+formatted(expected)+'\n'+
      '手数料：'+formatted(fee)+'\n'+
      '保存後の所持資金：'+formatted(expected-fee)+'\n'+
      (quote.isFree?'保存成功時だけ本日の無料枠を使用します。':'保存成功時だけ手数料を徴収します。')+'続けますか？'))return false;
  const initial=snapshot('manual'), n=nextBackupNumber();
  // Confirm the wallet still equals the game snapshot before creating the file.
  if(cashApi.getBalance()!==expected)throw Error('所持資金が変更されました。もう一度お試しください。');
  const baselineChecksum=initial.checksum;
  const saved=feePaidSnapshot(initial,expected,fee);
  saved.backupNumber=n;
  const contents=JSON.stringify(saved);
  if(new Blob([contents]).size>MAX_EXPORT_BYTES)throw Error('8MBを超えるバックアップは保存できません');
  const filename='derby_fantasy_backup_'+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g,'').replace(/\..*/,'').replace('T','_')+'.json';
  const btn=el('dfV6BackupExport');btn.disabled=true;
  try{
   if(window.DFSaveNative&&typeof window.DFSaveNative.postMessage==='function'){
    const result=await window.DFSaveNative.postMessage(JSON.stringify({action:'exportGameBackup',filename,contents}));
    if(!result?.ok){status(result?.cancelled?'保存先の選択をキャンセルしました。手数料はかかりません。':(result?.error||'バックアップの保存に失敗しました。手数料はかかりません。'),!result?.cancelled);return false;}
   }else if(typeof window.showSaveFilePicker==='function'){
    try{
     const handle=await window.showSaveFilePicker({suggestedName:filename,types:[{description:'セーブデータ',accept:{'application/json':['.json']}}]});
     const writer=await handle.createWritable();await writer.write(contents);await writer.close();
    }catch(e){if(e?.name==='AbortError'){status('保存をキャンセルしました。手数料はかかりません。');return false;}throw e;}
   }else{
    // Browsers without a save-picker API cannot confirm a completed download.
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([contents],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'}));
    try{const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(link);link.click();link.remove();}
    finally{setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),15000);}
   }
   // A month change while the file picker is open must never charge the wrong
   // balance or overwrite a newer backup counter.
   const currentQuote=manualFeeState();
   if(readBackupNumber()!==n-1||fingerprint(collect())!==baselineChecksum||cashApi.getBalance()!==expected||
      currentQuote.day!==quote.day||currentQuote.isFree!==quote.isFree){
    status('保存中に日付またはゲームの状態が変わりました。無料枠・手数料は使用していません。もう一度保存してください。',true);
    return false;
   }
   let charged=false;
   const priorNumber=localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_NUMBER);
   const priorManual=localStorage.getItem(MANUAL);
   const priorFreeDay=localStorage.getItem(FREE_MANUAL_DAY);
   try{
    if(fee>0){cashApi.charge(expected,fee);charged=true;}
    // The exported file must match the actual game state on this device.
    if(fingerprint(collect())!==saved.checksum)throw Error('保存後のゲーム状態とファイルが一致しません。');
    syncGuard(true);
    setBackupNumber(n);
    localStorage.setItem(MANUAL,contents);
    if(localStorage.getItem(MANUAL)!==contents)throw Error('バックアップ記録の保存を確認できませんでした。');
    if(quote.isFree){
     const atCommit=jstNow();
     if(atCommit.day!==quote.day)throw Error('保存中に日付が変わりました。無料枠は使用していません。もう一度保存してください。');
     const committed={day:quote.day,epoch:atCommit.epoch};
     localStorage.setItem(FREE_MANUAL_DAY,JSON.stringify(committed));
     if(readFreeManualDay()?.day!==committed.day)throw Error('無料バックアップの回数記録を保存できませんでした。');
    }
    status(quote.isFree?'第'+n+'回 手動バックアップを無料で保存しました。本日の無料枠を使用しました。':
       '第'+n+'回 手動バックアップを保存しました。手数料 '+formatted(fee)+' を徴収しました。');
    updateManualFeeNotice();
    return true;
   }catch(e){
    // Roll back the local export metadata if the commit did not finish.
    for(const [key,old] of [[BACKUP_NUMBER,priorNumber],[MANUAL,priorManual],[FREE_MANUAL_DAY,priorFreeDay]]){
     try{
      if(localStorage.getItem(key)===old)continue;
      if(old===null)localStorage.removeItem(key);else localStorage.setItem(key,old);
     }catch(rollbackError){console.error('Ver.190 バックアップ記録の復旧に失敗',rollbackError);}
    }
    if(charged){
     try{cashApi.refund(expected,fee);}catch(refundError){
      throw Error('手数料の復旧に失敗しました。現在の所持資金をご確認ください：'+refundError.message);
     }
     syncGuard(true);
    }
    // The file may have been saved, but a failed local commit does not
    // consume the free quota or charge the wallet.
    throw e;
   }
  }finally{btn.disabled=false;}
 }

  // Locally embedded, layered PCM designs compressed with Opus; no external assets.

    if(!ctx){const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return null;
      try{ctx=new AC({latencyHint:'interactive'});master=ctx.createGain();master.gain.value=muted?0:volume*.55;master.connect(ctx.destination);}catch(_){ctx=null;return null;}
    }

  async function get(name){
    if(cache.has(name))return cache.get(name);
    if(pending.has(name))return pending.get(name);
    const context=audioContext();if(!context||!AUDIO[name])return null;
    const promise=Promise.resolve().then(()=>{
      const raw=atob(AUDIO[name]);const bytes=new Uint8Array(raw.length);
      for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)bytes[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);
      return context.decodeAudioData(bytes.buffer);
    }).then(buffer=>{cache.set(name,buffer);return buffer;}).catch(err=>{console.warn('効果音の読み込みに失敗:',name,err);return null;}).finally(()=>pending.delete(name));
    pending.set(name,promise);return promise;
  }
  function makeVoice(name,level=1,rate=1,loop=false){
    const context=audioContext();if(!context)return Promise.resolve(null);
    return get(name).then(buffer=>{
      if(!buffer||!isAllowed()||!ctx||ctx.state!=='running')return null;
      const source=ctx.createBufferSource();source.buffer=buffer;source.loop=loop;
      source.playbackRate.value=Math.max(.35,Math.min(2.5,rate));
      const gain=ctx.createGain();gain.gain.value=0;source.connect(gain);gain.connect(master);
      gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(level,ctx.currentTime,.014);
      source.start();
      return {source,gain};
    });
  }
  function play(name,level=1,rate=1){
    if(!isAllowed())return;
    if(name==='click'&&now()-rapidLast<78)return;
    if(name==='click')rapidLast=now();
    makeVoice(name,level,rate,false);
  }
  // DBF18: short cash-register chime, different timbre for income/expense.
  // Uses the existing master gain, mute and volume settings.
  function playMoney(direction){
    if(!isAllowed())return false;
    const context=audioContext();if(!context||context.state!=='running')return false;
    const income=direction==='in',t=context.currentTime;
    try{
      const pitches=income?[1318.51,1760]:[987.77,783.99];
      pitches.forEach((freq,i)=>{
        const start=t+i*.085,end=start+.24;
        const osc=context.createOscillator(),gain=context.createGain();
        osc.type=i===0?'triangle':'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,start);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,start);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(i===0?.20:.16,start+.008);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,end);
        osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(master);osc.start(start);osc.stop(end+.01);
      });
      return true;
    }catch(_){return false;}
  }
  // Ver.179: the sound engine runs outside the race module; cash variables
  // are module-local. Receive the starting balances from that module instead
  // of referring to undeclared variables (which broke SFX initialization).
  const df175LastCash={normal:null,vs:null,farm:null};
  window.df175InitCash=function(normal,vs,farm){
    for(const [kind,value] of [['normal',normal],['vs',vs],['farm',farm]]){
      const n=Number(value);
      if(Number.isSafeInteger(n)&&n>=0)df175LastCash[kind]=n;
    }
  };
  const df18FarmSyncReasons=new Set(['external-set','restore','load','initialize','init','sync']);
  // Compare the cash after successful commits, not after screen redraws or reloads.
  window.df175MoneyTrack=function(kind,raw,reason=''){
    if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(df175LastCash,kind))return false;
    const value=Number(raw);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(value)||value<0)return false;
    const old=df175LastCash[kind];df175LastCash[kind]=value;
    if(old===null||value===old||reason==='silent')return false;
    if(kind==='farm'){
      // External parent-to-farm synchronization and save restore are not new transactions.
      if(df18FarmSyncReasons.has(reason)){
        df175LastCash.normal=value;
        return false;
      }
      // The farm owns this change. The parent mirror must not ring the coin twice.
      df175LastCash.normal=value;
    }
    playMoney(value>old?'in':'out');
    return true;
  };
  function fadeStop(name){
    const item=loops.get(name);if(!item)return;
    loops.delete(name);
    if(!ctx)return;
    const t=ctx.currentTime;
    try{item.gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);item.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,.045);item.source.stop(t+.20);}catch(_){}
  }
  function loopStart(name,level,rate=1){
    const present=loops.get(name);if(present){present.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(level,ctx.currentTime,.14);present.source.playbackRate.setTargetAtTime(rate,ctx.currentTime,.20);return;}
    if(startingLoops.has(name))return;
    startingLoops.add(name);
    const token=loopSequence;
    makeVoice(name,level,rate,true).then(item=>{
      if(!item)return;
      if(token!==loopSequence||!raceActive||!isAllowed()){
        try{item.source.stop();}catch(_){}return;
      }
      loops.set(name,item);
    }).finally(()=>startingLoops.delete(name));
  }
  function stopRace(){
    raceActive=false;loopSequence++;startingLoops.clear();
    for(const name of [...loops.keys()])fadeStop(name);
  }
  function syncRace(state,remaining,speed){
    const racing=(state==='running')&&document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='race-view';
    if(!racing){if(raceActive||loops.size)stopRace();return;}
    if(!isAllowed())return;
    if(!raceActive){raceActive=true;loopSequence++;sprintPlayed=false;}
    const sprint=Number(remaining)<450;
    loopStart('hooves',sprint?.39:.32,Math.min(1.48,.85+Number(speed||1)*.16));
    loopStart('crowd',sprint?.23:.095,1);
    if(sprint&&!sprintPlayed){sprintPlayed=true;play('sprint',.25);}
  }
  function beginRace(){stopRace();play('gate',.95);}
  function finishRace(){stopRace();play('finish',.87);}
  function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify({muted,volume}));}catch(_){}syncMaster();}
  function updateUI(){
    const summary=document.getElementById('dfV25SfxSummary');
    const mute=document.getElementById('dfV25SfxMute');
    const range=document.getElementById('dfV25SfxVolume');
    const pc=document.getElementById('dfV25SfxPercent');
    if(summary)summary.textContent=muted||!volume?'🔇 効果音':'🔊 効果音';
    if(mute)mute.textContent=muted?'効果音をオン':'効果音をオフ';
    if(range)range.value=String(Math.round(volume*100));
    if(pc)pc.textContent=Math.round(volume*100)+'%';
  }
  window.df25Sfx={play,playMoney,beginRace,finishRace,stopRace,syncRace,setMuted(v){muted=!!v;save();updateUI();},setVolume(v){volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(v)||0));save();updateUI();},get status(){return {muted,volume,raceActive,loops:[...loops.keys()]}}};
  function setup(){

    const range=document.getElementById('dfV25SfxVolume'),mute=document.getElementById('dfV25SfxMute');

    function suspendWhenLeaving(){stopRace();if(ctx&&ctx.state==='running'){try{ctx.suspend().catch(()=>{});}catch(_){}}}
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)suspendWhenLeaving();});
    window.addEventListener('pagehide',suspendWhenLeaving);
    document.addEventListener('freeze',suspendWhenLeaving);
    document.addEventListener('click',event=>{

      else play('click',.21);
    },true);
    attachFarm();
  }
  function attachFarm(){
    const frame=document.getElementById('standaloneFarmV62Frame');if(!frame)return;
    let boundDoc=null;
    const connect=()=>{
      let doc;
      try{doc=frame.contentDocument;}catch(_){return;}
      if(!doc||doc===boundDoc||!doc.getElementById('barnPage'))return;
      boundDoc=doc;
      doc.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{if(!muted)audioContext();},{capture:true,passive:true});
      doc.addEventListener('click',event=>{
        const target=event.target.closest('button,[role=button],summary');if(!target||target.disabled)return;
        if(target.closest('[data-v19-ack]')){play('secretary',.42);return;}
        if(target.closest('[data-v21-export]')){play('purchase',.28);return;}
        if(target.id==='barnNextMonth')return; // farm emits confirmed 'next-month'
        if(target.id==='commitBreeding'||target.matches('[data-sale-buy]')){play('click',.21);return;}
        if(target.closest('.exact-five-button,.barn-main-action,.barn-game-menu,.df-v19-portrait'))play('transition',.20);
        else play('click',.19);
      },true);
      doc.addEventListener('farm-home:action',event=>{
        const type=event.detail?.type;
        if(type==='next-month')play('calendar',.50);
        else if(type==='foal-named')play('secretary',.52);
      });
      doc.addEventListener('farm-home:statechange',event=>{
        const reason=event.detail?.reason;
        if(event.detail?.saved!==false)window.df175MoneyTrack?.('farm',event.detail?.state?.walletCash,reason);
        if(reason==='breed-success')play('breeding',.75);
        if(reason==='name-new-foal')play('secretary',.43);
        if(reason==='save-battle')play('purchase',.48);
      });
      const birth=doc.getElementById('foalBirthEvent');
      if(birth){let wasVisible=!birth.hidden;
        new MutationObserver(()=>{const visible=!birth.hidden;if(visible&&!wasVisible)play('birth',.92);wasVisible=visible;}).observe(birth,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['hidden']});
      }
      const owned=doc.getElementById('premiumFarmSkin');
      if(owned){let currentNotice='';let nextCheck=false;
        const inspect=()=>{nextCheck=false;
          const message=owned.querySelector('.df-v19-discovery p');
          const notice=message?.textContent.trim()||'';
          if(notice&&notice!==currentNotice){play('reveal',.65);currentNotice=notice;}
          if(!notice)currentNotice='';
        };
        new MutationObserver(()=>{if(!nextCheck){nextCheck=true;queueMicrotask(inspect);}}).observe(owned,{childList:true,subtree:true});
        inspect();
      }
    };
    frame.addEventListener('load',connect);
    connect();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',setup,{once:true});else setup();
})();

<script id="df-v31-vs-selection">
(()=>{
 'use strict';
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const overlay=$('dfV28VsOverlay');
 if(!overlay)return;
 const STORAGE='derby_fantasy_new_html_v28.vsImports';
 const MAX_IMPORTS=60, MAX_BYTES=1048576;
 let saved=[],imports=[],selected=new Set();
 const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
 const num=(x,def=80)=>Number.isFinite(Number(x))?Number(x):def;
 const clean=s=>String(s??'').replace(/・(?:初年度同期|\d+期|\d+年目(?:GⅠ|補充)?)$/,'');
 function isValid(entry){
   if(!entry||entry.format!=='derby-fantasy-battle-horse'||entry.schema!==1||!entry.horse||!entry.raceStats)return false;
   if(typeof entry.name!=='string'||entry.name.length>90||typeof entry.snapshotId!=='string'||entry.snapshotId.length>180||!entry.snapshotId)return false;
   return ['sp','sta','kick'].every(k=>Number.isFinite(Number(entry.raceStats[k]?.total)));
 }
 function readImports(){try{const value=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE)||'[]');return Array.isArray(value)?value.filter(isValid).slice(0,MAX_IMPORTS):[];}catch(_){return [];}}
 function say(msg){$('dfV28VsMessage').textContent=msg;}
 function allHorses(){
   const map=new Map();for(const [i,h] of [...saved,...imports].entries()){
    if(!isValid(h))continue;
    map.set(String(h.snapshotId||h.name+'#'+i),h);
   }return [...map].map(([key,horse])=>({key,horse}));
 }
 function esc(t){const d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=String(t||'');return d.innerHTML;}
 function escAttr(t){return esc(t).replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');}
 function displayEntries(){
  const entries=allHorses();$('dfV28VsCount').textContent=`（${entries.length}頭登録）`;
  $('dfV28VsList').innerHTML=entries.length?entries.map(({key,horse})=>`<label class="vs-entry"><input type="checkbox" data-vs-key="${escAttr(key)}" ${selected.has(key)?'checked':''}><span><strong>${esc(clean(horse.name))}</strong><small>${esc(horse.age)}歳・${esc(horse.sex)}・${esc(horse.coatType)}${imports.includes(horse)?'（受取馬）':''}</small></span></label>`).join(''):'<p class="vs-empty">対戦馬がまだ登録されていません。牧場の「所有馬」から「対戦馬として保存」を選ぶか、受け取ったJSONを読み込んでください。</p>';
   $('dfV28VsStart').disabled=false;
   updateComHint();
 }
 function targetFieldSize(){return clamp(num($('dfV29VsFieldSize').value,16),1,18);}
 function updateComHint(){
   const slots=Math.max(selected.size,targetFieldSize());
   $('dfV29ComHint').textContent=`出走予定：登録馬${selected.size}頭 ＋ COM・Sクラス${slots-selected.size}頭 ＝ ${slots}頭立て`;
 }
 function open(entries){
   if(window.DFV43CanVS&&!window.DFV43CanVS()){window.DFV43LockedVS?.();return;}
   // The farm's only job is to send read-only frozen snapshots.
   saved=Array.isArray(entries)?entries.filter(isValid).slice(0,300):[];
   imports=readImports();selected=new Set();$('dfV28VsSelection').hidden=false;
   overlay.hidden=false;displayEntries();say('登録馬を選択してください。不足枠はCOMのSクラス馬が出走します。');window.scrollTo(0,0);
   window.df25Sfx?.play('transition',.30);
 }
 function close(){overlay.hidden=true;window.DFV30SharedRace?.goFarm?.();window.df25Sfx?.play('transition',.30);}
 function score(h,key){return clamp(num(h.raceStats?.[key]?.total,num(h.horse?.[key],80)),0,500);}
 function starters(distance){
   const list=allHorses();const field=list.filter(x=>selected.has(x.key)).map(({horse,key},i)=>({
      id:key,name:clean(horse.name),coatType:horse.coatType||'鹿毛',age:num(horse.age,4),growth:horse.growth||horse.horse?.growth||'普通',
      g1Wins:num(horse.horse?.g1Wins,0),g1WinsStatus:horse.horse?.g1WinsStatus||'',
      g1AverageMarginMeasured:horse.horse?.g1AverageMarginMeasured??null,
      g1AverageMarginForGame:num(horse.horse?.g1AverageMarginForGame,0),
      bestDistance:num(horse.raceContext?.bestDistance,distance),number:i+1,sex:horse.sex||'',
      tactic:horse.raceContext?.tactic||horse.horse?.tactic||'先行',
      speed:score(horse,'sp'),sta:score(horse,'sta'),kick:score(horse,'kick'),
      early:score(horse,'early'),sustain:score(horse,'sustain'),grit:score(horse,'grit'),
      stability:score(horse,'stability'),
      earnedPrize:Math.max(0,num(horse.horse?.prize,0),num(horse.career?.prize,0)),
      health:clamp(num(horse.raceContext?.health,90),0,110),
      temperament:clamp(num(horse.raceContext?.temperament,85),0,110),
      form:clamp(num(horse.raceContext?.form,75),0,100),
      fatigue:clamp(num(horse.raceContext?.fatigue,0),0,100),
      aptMin:num(horse.raceContext?.aptMin,1200),aptMax:num(horse.raceContext?.aptMax,2800),
      going:horse.raceContext?.goingAptitude||{},isCom:false
    }));
   const need=Math.max(0,Math.max(field.length,targetFieldSize())-field.length);
   if(need){
     const pool=window.DFV29ComSHorsesLive?.length>=16?window.DFV29ComSHorsesLive:window.DFV29ComSHorses||[];
     const taken=new Set(field.map(r=>r.name));
     // Randomize each race, prioritize horses suited to the selected distance, never repeat a COM horse.
     const fresh=pool.filter(h=>h.overallRank==='S'&&!taken.has(clean(h.name)));
     for(let i=fresh.length-1;i>0;i--){
       const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
       [fresh[i],fresh[j]]=[fresh[j],fresh[i]];
     }
     const sorted=[...fresh.filter(h=>h.aptMin<=distance&&distance<=h.aptMax),
                   ...fresh.filter(h=>distance<h.aptMin||distance>h.aptMax)];
     for(const h of sorted.slice(0,need)){
       field.push({id:h.id,name:clean(h.name),coatType:h.coatType||'鹿毛',age:4,number:field.length+1,
         sex:h.sex||'',tactic:h.tactic||'先行',speed:num(h.sp),sta:num(h.sta),kick:num(h.kick),
         early:num(h.early),sustain:num(h.sustain),grit:num(h.grit),stability:num(h.stability),
         health:clamp(num(h.health,90),0,110),temperament:clamp(num(h.temperament,85),0,110),
         form:75,fatigue:0,aptMin:num(h.aptMin,1200),aptMax:num(h.aptMax,2800),
         going:h.goingAptitude||{},earnedPrize:Math.max(0,num(h.prize,0)),isCom:true});
     }
   }
   // Ver.34: mix the selected registered horses with the newly drawn S-class COM
   // horses BEFORE giving any horse its gate/horse number. Every fresh VS race
   // draws a complete field order; the newspaper then holds it fixed to the finish.
   for(let i=field.length-1;i>0;i--){
     const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
     [field[i],field[j]]=[field[j],field[i]];
   }
   field.forEach((h,i)=>{h.number=i+1;});
   return field;
 }
 // The normal Three.js race engine handles rendering, physics, camera, audio and results.
 function start(){
  const distance=Number($('dfV28VsDistance').value),going=$('dfV28VsGoing').value;
  const field=starters(distance);
  if(field.length<1||field.length>18){say('1〜18頭の出走馬を準備できませんでした。');return;}
  const shared=window.DFV30SharedRace;
  if(!shared){say('本編の3Dレースシステムを読み込み中です。');return;}
  const outcome=shared.start(field,distance,going);
  if(!outcome?.ok){say(outcome?.error||'VSレースを開始できませんでした。');return;}
  $('dfV28VsSelection').hidden=true;
  overlay.hidden=true;
 }
 function returnToSelection(){
  window.DFV30SharedRace?.leave();
  overlay.hidden=false;
  $('dfV28VsSelection').hidden=false;
  displayEntries();
  say('登録馬を選び直せます。通常レースのエンジンを共用します。');
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
 }
 $('dfV28VsBack').addEventListener('click',close);
 $('dfV28VsList').addEventListener('change',e=>{
   const cb=e.target.closest('[data-vs-key]');if(!cb)return;
   if(cb.checked&&selected.size>=18){cb.checked=false;say('同時出走は最大18頭です。');return;}
   if(cb.checked)selected.add(cb.dataset.vsKey);else selected.delete(cb.dataset.vsKey);
   if(selected.size>targetFieldSize())$('dfV29VsFieldSize').value=String(selected.size);
   updateComHint();say('登録馬 '+selected.size+'頭を選択中。足りない枠はCOMのSクラスが出走します。');
 });
 $('dfV29VsFieldSize').addEventListener('change',()=>{if(targetFieldSize()<selected.size)$('dfV29VsFieldSize').value=String(selected.size);updateComHint();});
 $('dfV28VsStart').addEventListener('click',start);
 $('dfV28VsImportBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>$('dfV28VsImport').click());
 $('dfV28VsImport').addEventListener('change',async e=>{
   const file=e.target.files?.[0];e.target.value='';if(!file)return;
   try{
     if(file.size>MAX_BYTES)throw Error('JSONは1MB以下にしてください。');
     const parsed=JSON.parse(await file.text());
     if(!isValid(parsed))throw Error('対戦馬JSONの形式または能力データが正しくありません。');
     if(imports.length>=MAX_IMPORTS&&!imports.some(x=>x.snapshotId===parsed.snapshotId))throw Error('受取馬の保存上限は60頭です。');
     const h=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(parsed));
     const ix=imports.findIndex(x=>x.snapshotId===h.snapshotId);
     if(ix>=0)imports[ix]=h;else imports.push(h);
     try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(imports));}catch(err){imports=readImports();throw Error('受取馬の保存領域が足りません。');}
     displayEntries();say(clean(h.name)+'を受け取りました。出走馬として選択できます。');window.df25Sfx?.play('purchase',.4);
   }catch(err){say('読み込みできません：'+(err.message||String(err)));}
 });
 window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
   const frame=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame');
   if(!frame||event.source!==frame.contentWindow||event.data?.channel!=='df-v28-vs-open')return;
   open(event.data.entries);
 });
 window.DFV28VS=Object.freeze({open:()=>open($('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge?.df153GetBattleEntries?.()||[]),close,returnToSelection,getStatus:()=>({open:!overlay.hidden,count:allHorses().length,racing:!!window.DFV30SharedRace?.getStatus()?.active})});
})();
</script>
<script id="df-official-vs-record-ui">
/* Small independent controls for the official VS record; no normal-mode UI changes. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const panel=$('dfV28VsSelection');
  if(!panel)return;
  const controls=document.createElement('div');
  controls.className='vs-config';
  controls.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="vs-minor" id="dfOfficialVSImportBtn">📂 公式VSリプレイJSONを読み込む</button>'+
    '<input type="file" id="dfOfficialVSImportFile" class="vs-file" accept=".json,application/json" aria-label="公式VSリプレイJSONを読み込む">'+
    '<button type="button" class="vs-minor" id="dfOfficialVSLastExport">💾 最新のVSレース記録を書き出す</button>';
  const notice=document.createElement('p');notice.className='vs-message';notice.id='dfOfficialVSImportMessage';notice.setAttribute('role','status');
  panel.append(controls,notice);
  $('dfOfficialVSImportBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>$('dfOfficialVSImportFile').click());
  $('dfOfficialVSImportFile').addEventListener('change',async event=>{
    const file=event.target.files?.[0];event.target.value='';if(!file)return;
    try{
      if(file.size>50000000)throw Error('記録ファイルは50MB以下にしてください。');
      const json=JSON.parse(await file.text());
      const result=window.DFOfficialVSReplay.play(json);
      notice.textContent=result.ok?'競馬新聞を表示しました。レース開始で記録を再生できます。':'再生準備に失敗しました。';
    }catch(error){notice.textContent='読み込み失敗：'+String(error.message||error);}
  });
  $('dfOfficialVSLastExport').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    try{
      const ok=await window.DFOfficialVSReplay.downloadLast();
      notice.textContent=ok?'公式VSレース記録を書き出しました。':'書き出せる完走記録がまだありません。';
    }catch(error){notice.textContent='書き出し失敗：'+String(error.message||error);}
  });
  const results=$('postRacePanel');
  if(results){
    const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.hidden=true;
    btn.id='dfOfficialVSResultExport';btn.textContent='💾 このVSレース記録をJSONで書き出す';
    btn.style.cssText='display:block;margin:12px auto;padding:12px 16px;background:#dec084;color:#1d2931;font-weight:900;border:2px solid #ba944f;border-radius:12px;';
    results.appendChild(btn);
    btn.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
      try{if(!await window.DFOfficialVSReplay.downloadLast())alert('完走記録はまだありません。');}
      catch(error){alert('記録の保存に失敗しました：'+String(error.message||error));}
    });
    const hide=()=>{btn.hidden=true;btn.style.display='none';};
    hide();
    window.addEventListener('df-official-vs-replay-ready',()=>{
      if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='results') {btn.hidden=false;btn.style.display='block';}
    });
    window.addEventListener('df-official-vs-playback-prepared',hide);
    const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{
      if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='results')hide();
    });
    observer.observe(document.body,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-game-screen']});
  }
  // The site may supply a finished record to an embedded same-origin game.
  window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
    if(event.origin!==location.origin || event.source!==window.parent ||
       event.data?.channel!=='df-official-vs-play')return;
    try{window.DFOfficialVSReplay.play(event.data.record);}catch(error){

<script id="df113-race-layout-script">
(function(){
 'use strict';
 let raf=0;
 const update=()=>{
  raf=0;
  if(document.body?.dataset.gameScreen!=='race-view')return;
  const vp=document.getElementById('viewport');
  const controls=document.querySelector('.shell > .control-strip');
  if(!vp||!controls)return;
  const vv=window.visualViewport;
  const screenBottom=vv?(vv.offsetTop+vv.height):window.innerHeight;
  const currentBottom=controls.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  if(!screenBottom||!Number.isFinite(currentBottom))return;
  // Increase/decrease only the 3D view so the last controls sit just above
  // the Android/browser navigation edge; leave existing controls and buttons intact.
  const change=screenBottom-6-currentBottom;
  if(Math.abs(change)<2)return;
  const next=Math.max(360,Math.round(vp.getBoundingClientRect().height+change));
  const prior=parseFloat(vp.style.getPropertyValue('--df113-race-height'))||0;
  if(Math.abs(next-prior)>1)vp.style.setProperty('--df113-race-height',next+'px');
 };
 const schedule=()=>{if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(update);};
 const init=()=>{
  if(!document.body)return;
  const observer=new MutationObserver(schedule);
  observer.observe(document.body,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-game-screen']});
  window.addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});
  window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});
  window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});
  schedule();
 };
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});
 else init();
})();
</script>

<script id="df115-opening-newspaper-bgm">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function install(){
    const audio=document.getElementById('derbyOpeningBgm');
    const opening=document.getElementById('derbyOpening');
    const bgm=window.DF116Bgm;
    if(!audio||!opening||!bgm)return;
    audio.loop=true;
    let inNewspaper=false, pending=0, idleHandle=0;
    const isNewspaper=()=>opening.hidden===true&&document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='newspaper';
    function cancelPending(){
      if(pending){clearTimeout(pending);pending=0;}
      if(idleHandle&&window.cancelIdleCallback){cancelIdleCallback(idleHandle);idleHandle=0;}
    }
    function startNewspaper(){
      pending=0;idleHandle=0;
      if(!isNewspaper()||document.hidden)return;
      // Do not seek to zero or start a fresh decode while the race-card is being built.
      bgm.play();
    }
    function afterPaperPaint(){
      cancelPending();
      // Defer media decoding until after layout has painted and main thread is idle.
      // No added UI or pause/restart button.
      pending=setTimeout(()=>{
        pending=0;
        if(!isNewspaper())return;
        if(window.requestIdleCallback)
          idleHandle=requestIdleCallback(startNewspaper,{timeout:1600});
        else startNewspaper();
      },500);
    }
    function updateScreen(){
      const next=isNewspaper();
      if(next===inNewspaper)return;
      inNewspaper=next;
      if(next)afterPaperPaint();
      else{cancelPending();if(opening.hidden)bgm.fadeOut({reset:true});}
    }
    const observer=new MutationObserver(updateScreen);
    observer.observe(document.body,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-game-screen']});
    observer.observe(opening,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['hidden']});
    // When autoplay on newspaper is blocked, the next normal screen touch
    // may start it; do not create any BGM controls.
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
      if(isNewspaper()&&audio.paused&&!pending&&!idleHandle){bgm.play();}
    },{capture:true,passive:true});
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
      if(!document.hidden&&isNewspaper())afterPaperPaint();
    });
    updateScreen();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});
  else install();
})();
</script>
